jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Voice Agent
jobs.description:
Overview
Join our innovative team at Azure Voice AI, where we are at the forefront of AI technology. We are dedicated to creating cutting-edge generative voice and avatar AI models that revolutionize user experiences. The Azure Voice AI team's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to have human like, diverse and delightful AI voices and avatars!

As a Developer for Generative Voice and Avatar AI Models, you will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and implementing state-of-the-art AI models that power our next-generation products.

Responsibilities
Drive omni model development with SOTA ASR and TTS.
Develop SOTA talking avatar models for zero shot and fine tune scenario.
Familiar with latest GenAI modelling technique like diffusion and language modelling.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI models into various applications and platforms.
Conduct research and stay updated with the latest advancements in AI and machine learning to continuously improve our models.
Optimize and fine-tune AI models for performance, scalability, and accuracy.
Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and contribute to the overall improvement of our development processes.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 7+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python.
Experience with machine learning frameworks and libraries (e.g., PyTorch).

Preferred Qualifications
Knowledge of natural language processing (NLP) and computer vision techniques.
Familiarity with generative models, such as GANs, VAEs, diffusion, flow matching or autoregressive models.
Excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for innovation.
Strong communication and teamwork abilities.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer--M365 Work IQ
jobs.description:
Overview
Work IQ is Microsoft 365 Copilot's workplace intelligence layer, enabling AI agents and experiences to securely reason over enterprise data such as emails, meetings, documents, Teams messages, and people signals. Work IQ exposes this intelligence through agent-first interfaces including REST APIs, Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols, CLI tooling, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, enabling developers to build intelligent, enterprise-aware agents and applications.

We, the M365 Core Asia Pacific Copilot Extensibility Engineering team, are looking for a Principal Software Engineer for Work IQ whose primary engineering focus is building the intelligence platform that connects AI agents to Microsoft 365 knowledge. You will own the design and development of Work IQ's REST and A2A APIs, MCP infrastructure, retrieval and orchestration services, and developer tooling. Your work will shape how agents access, reason over, and act on enterprise knowledge, helping establish Work IQ as the foundation for the next generation of Microsoft 365 Copilot and agent experiences.

Responsibilities
Take ownership of critical product and platform areas of the Work IQ API and related agentic components.
Set a high technical and quality bar for agentic systems and developer-facing tooling.
Design and ship performant, reliable terminal experiences that developers depend on for daily work.
Use data, benchmarks, and direct user feedback to guide iteration and investment.
Collaborate across org boundaries to enable other teams to build agentic products on top of a shared foundation.
Influence architecture, technical direction, and engineering standards beyond your immediate team.

Qualifications
Required: Bachelor's in CS or related field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience (C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python). Microsoft Cloud Background Check required.
Preferred: Master's AND 8+ years, or Bachelor's AND 12+ years. Hands-on experience building and operating generative AI or agentic systems in production; experience building customer-facing developer interfaces/products; experience designing, running, and optimizing evaluations for agentic systems (tools, prompts, agent loops); experience building agentic development interfaces or working with related low level primitives is a strong plus.
jobs.notes: 微软上海 M365 Work IQ（Copilot 智能层）Principal 岗：agent-first 接口（REST/A2A 协议/MCP server）+ 检索编排服务，直接定义 Agent 访问企业知识的底座。Principal 级别要求 6-12+ 年且有生产级 agentic 系统经验；仅 11 人申请，是本批级别最高、方向最正的岗位。

jobs.title: AI Solution Architect (R-19393)
jobs.location_raw: 中国 广东省 深圳
jobs.description:
Shape the Future with Dun & Bradstreet

At Dun & Bradstreet, we believe data has the power to create a better tomorrow. As a global leader in business decisioning data and analytics, we help companies worldwide grow, manage risk, and innovate. Since 1841, businesses have trusted us to turn uncertainty into opportunity. We're a diverse, global team that values creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas. Are you ready to make an impact and help shape what's next? Join us! Explore opportunities at dnb.com/careers.

Responsibilties and Requirements

About the Role

At Dun & Bradstreet, data is not just an asset—it is the context layer that powers intelligent decision-making. As our AI Solution Architect in Hong Kong, you will be a Forward Deployed Engineer who sit at the intersection of D&B's global data network, cutting-edge AI infrastructure, and the real-world systems of largest enterprises.

This is not a back-office engineering role. You and your team will be embedded with clients—from multinational banks and Fortune 500 manufacturers to cross-border trade platforms—to architect, deploy, and operationalize AI solutions that integrate D&B's proprietary commercial data directly into their ERP, CRM, SCM, and risk management systems.

You will operate in one of the world's most regulated financial centers, solving high-stakes problems where data privacy, cross-border compliance, and real-time business intelligence converge.

What You'll Do

Own End-to-End AI Deployment
• Scope, architect, and deliver production-grade AI solutions (RAG pipelines, Agent workflows, predictive analytics) using D&B data assets and client infrastructure.
• Operate in 6–12 week timeboxes, moving from ambiguous business requirements to working prototypes that demonstrate measurable ROI.

Be the Technical-Strategic Bridge
• Serve as the senior technical counterpart to C-suite, VP, and Head of Data stakeholders at client organizations.
• Translate complex engineering trade-offs into CFO- and CIO-ready business cases—covering revenue impact, cost reduction, and risk mitigation.

Ensure Enterprise-Grade Compliance
• Guarantee all deployments meet SOC 2, ISO 27001, and regional regulatory standards including China PIPL, Hong Kong PDPO, and financial services sector requirements.
• Navigate cross-border data governance with rigor—D&B's credibility depends on it.

Drive Product-Market Feedback Loops
• Channel live client insights back to D&B's Product and AI Labs teams to refine our data APIs, model performance, and vertical-specific solutions.

Who You Are

Engineering Depth
• 7+ years of product-grade software engineering experience (Python, SQL, Java/Go preferred).
• Proven expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP), data pipelines (Airflow, Spark), and enterprise system integration (SAP, Salesforce, Snowflake, etc.).
• Hands-on experience with the modern GenAI stack: LLMs, vector databases, retrieval architecture, fine-tuning (LoRA), and Agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, DSPy).

Client-Facing Leadership
• 3+ years in consulting, solutions engineering, or client-embedded technical roles.
• A track record of delivering AI/ML projects in production within regulated industries (financial services, credit risk, supply chain, or trade finance highly preferred).
• Demonstrated ability to manage stakeholder complexity and navigate organizational politics to ship outcomes—what we call High Agency.

Strategic & Commercial Acumen
• Comfortable discussing P&L impact, data monetization strategy, and competitive positioning with senior executives.
• Experience building and scaling technical teams in a high-growth or transformation environment.

Language & Compliance
• Business fluency in English and Mandarin (written and spoken). Cantonese is a strong plus.
• Working knowledge of data privacy, security frameworks (SOC 2, FedRAMP, HIPAA), and APAC regulatory landscapes.

Nice-to-Have
• Prior experience at top-tier consulting firms, or AI-native enterprises with embedded deployment models.
• Deep domain expertise in commercial credit data, supply chain risk, KYB/KYC workflows, or trade intelligence.
• Published work, conference speaking, or open-source contributions in applied AI or data engineering.

All Dun & Bradstreet job postings can be found at https://jobs.lever.co/dnb. Official communication from Dun & Bradstreet will come from an email address ending in @dnb.com.

As AI applications rapidly evolve from traditional model serving toward more complex agentic systems, inference infrastructure and optimization are becoming increasingly important to delivering scalable, responsive, and cost-efficient AI services.
We are looking for someone with strong expertise in large language models, AI inference, or distributed AI systems, and a passion for solving emerging challenges in Agentic AI. You will work closely with leading cloud service providers and AI platform teams to design and optimize large-scale inference solutions on NVIDIA accelerated computing platforms. You will also collaborate across NVIDIA Engineering, Product, Sales, and Business Development teams to turn customer requirements into scalable solutions and product improvements.
As a Solutions Architect, you will be the first line of technical expertise between NVIDIA and our customers. Your work will range from architecture design and proof-of-concept development to hands-on performance analysis and optimization of production-scale AI systems. Dynamically engaging with developers, AI researchers, infrastructure engineers, platform architects, and senior technical leaders is a meaningful part of the role.
What You’ll Be Doing
Work with customers to design, deploy, and optimize large-scale LLM and Agentic AI inference systems on NVIDIA accelerated computing platforms.
Analyze end-to-end inference workloads and identify opportunities to improve latency, throughput, scalability, resource utilization, and cost efficiency.

Build proof-of-concepts, performance studies, and reference solutions to validate new architectures and demonstrate the value of NVIDIA technologies in real-world AI workloads.

What We Need To See
MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science/Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of relevant experience in large language models, AI inference, distributed AI systems, or related areas, with hands-on experience in system design, performance optimization, or large-scale AI workloads.
Strong understanding of modern AI systems and the ability to analyze performance across models, software frameworks, compute, memory, communication, and infrastructure.
Strong programming and problem-solving skills, with experience using common AI frameworks and tools. Proficiency in using AI tools or agents to improve engineering productivity is highly valued.
Clear and structured thinking, strong technical communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with both engineering teams and senior technical stakeholders.

Experience with Agentic AI or advanced LLM inference optimization, especially for large-scale production workloads.

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
Responsible for designing and programming a small module or a large component and designing a feature, set of features, or whole feature area. She/he will work independently and contribute to the immediate team and to other teams across business. She/he will Lead design discussion in a limited manner.

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Role Summary
Design, implement, and optimize MRI image reconstruction algorithms and software, spanning classical methods (FFT/parallel imaging/compressed sensing) and deep learning-based reconstructions. Collaborate with physics, clinical, and platform teams to translate prototypes into clinical-grade products.

Key Responsibilities
- Be responsible for the fine-tuning of large language models, including supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and domain-specific model adaptation, to improve model performance and adaptability in vertical scenarios.
- Conduct in-depth research and optimization on Prompt Engineering, design high-efficiency and high-robustness prompt templates, and explore advanced prompt strategies to enhance model output quality and task completion efficiency.
- Optimize the Function Calling capability of large models, improve the accuracy, stability and generalization of model tool invocation, and realize the seamless connection between models and external tools and services.
- Conduct research and implementation on advanced model reasoning technologies, including Chain of Thought (CoT), reflection mechanism, multi-step reasoning, and long context management, to solve complex reasoning tasks and extend the effective context window of models.
- Build a comprehensive LLM evaluation system, conduct all-round testing and evaluation on models, focusing on model hallucination problems, output stability, tool call accuracy, reasoning ability and other core indicators, and put forward targeted optimization plans.
- Track the cutting-edge research progress and technical trends in the field of large language models, introduce advanced algorithms and technologies into business scenarios, and promote the continuous iteration and upgrading of model technology.
- Be responsible for the research and development of the core Agent runtime system, including the design and implementation of execution engine, state machine, memory module and tool call framework, to ensure the efficient, stable and scalable operation of the Agent system.
- Develop and optimize multi-Agent collaboration mechanisms, realize core functions such as dialogue routing, conflict resolution, task decomposition and aggregation, and build a collaborative system for efficient interaction and task division among multiple Agents.
- Optimize the scheduling logic and execution efficiency of the Agent engine, solve the problems of task delay, memory overflow and tool call failure in the Agent operation process, and improve the overall performance of the system.
- Design the Agent system architecture with high availability and high scalability, support the access of various types of large models and external tools, and meet the needs of complex business scenarios.
- Be responsible for the connection and secondary development of mainstream open-source frameworks in the field of Agent, including LangChain, AutoGPT, OpenCWA, etc., and independently develop customized Agent frameworks and components according to business needs.
- Collaborate with product, engineering and other teams to translate algorithm research results into implementable technical solutions, and support the landing and application of large model products.
- Participate in agile processes: planning, estimation, retros, and on-call (as needed)

Qualifications
- MS or PhD degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, Statistics and other related majors, with solid theoretical foundation in natural language processing, machine learning and deep learning.
- More than 3 years of relevant working experience in large language model algorithm research and development, familiar with the training, fine-tuning and inference process of mainstream open-source large models (such as LLaMA, Qwen, ChatGLM series, etc.).
- Proficient in deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, familiar with model fine-tuning tools such as PEFT, LoRA, and have hands-on experience in large model parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
- In-depth understanding of Prompt Engineering, Function Calling, Chain of Thought and other LLM related technologies, with practical project experience in model reasoning optimization and long context processing.
- Experience in building LLM evaluation systems and conducting model hallucination, stability and tool call accuracy testing is preferred.
- Proficient in Python programming, with good data structure and algorithm foundation, and strong code implementation and problem-solving abilities.
- Have strong learning ability and innovative thinking, pay attention to industry cutting-edge dynamics, and have the ability to independently tackle key technical problems.
- Good communication and collaboration skills, able to efficiently cooperate with cross-team members to promote project progress.

- CUDA/CuFFT/CuBLAS, OpenMP, SIMD vectorization
- Experience with git, jenkens, devops, etc.
- Publications/competitions or open-source contributions

Soft Skills
- Self-driven, outcome-oriented, turning research code into production
- Strong communication and cross-disciplinary collaboration
- Documentation and experiment reproducibility mindset

Education Qualification
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or STEM Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math) with advanced experience.

Desired Characteristics (Technical Expertise)
- Strong knowledge of Object Oriented Analysis and Design, Software Design Patterns and Java coding principles
- Hands-on experience in web services (REST, SOAP, WSDL etc.), using Apache Commons Suite & Maven, SQL Database such as Oracle MySQL, PostgreSQL etc.
- Hands-on experience in utilizing Spring Framework (Core, MVC, Integration and Data)
- Experience with Big Data / Hadoop and NoSQL Database is a big plus
- Hands-on experience with web development using HTML5, Java Script, jQuery, CSS. Also, experience in implementing Java OSGi modules and using an OSGi container.

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Content Understanding & Moderation
jobs.description:
Unity Ads serves billions of ad requests across hundreds of thousands of mobile games. Every one of those requests involves content on both sides: an ad creative we are about to show, and a game we are about to show it for.

Understanding that content — what is in it, who it is appropriate for, and whether it belongs on the network at all — underpins both the safety of the marketplace and its relevance. The Content Understanding and Moderation charter covers representation, turning creatives and games into signals our models can use, and enforcement, detecting and acting on content that violates policy, regulation, or advertiser and publisher expectations. These are deliberately a single charter: the same multimodal understanding that improves relevance is what makes moderation possible at scale.

The Role

We are seeking a staff machine learning engineer to define how Unity understands and moderates the content flowing through its ad network. You will work closely with a world-class modeling team to power the recommendation for billions of users, while keeping them safe from bad content.

What You'll Do

- Define the multimodal content representation strategy across video, image, playable, audio, and text, so that one set of foundations serves both relevance and moderation rather than two divergent stacks
- Partner with product, engineering, science teams to translate regulatory and contractual obligations into objectives an ML system can be measured against
- Define what good looks like where labels are scarce, noisy, and genuinely contested, and build the evaluation and labeling infrastructure that makes it measurable
- Build the shared foundations other teams depend on, including content embeddings, game level features, evaluation harnesses, and labeling pipelines
- Lead architectural direction across teams, raise the design and review bar, and mentor senior and mid-level engineers working in the area

What We're Looking For

- Deep experience in multimodal machine learning combining vision and language, with video experience especially relevant
- Extensive experience owning a trust and safety, content moderation, brand safety, or policy enforcement system in production, where being wrong in either direction carried real consequences
- Experience operating where labels are scarce, ambiguous, or disputed, and where the definition of a violation shifts over time
- Experience adapting foundation models for production use, including fine-tuning, distillation, and optimization for latency and cost
- Strong programming skills in Python and experience running production ML systems on a serving path, with fluency in latency, throughput, and cost tradeoffs
- Experience reviewing and remaining accountable for production code, including code produced with AI assistance
- Proven ability to lead technical direction and influence architectural decisions across teams without formal authority

You might also have (optional)

- Familiarity with regulatory and policy regimes affecting advertising content, such as DSA, child-directed treatment, and regional advertising standards
- Strong systems thinking, with the ability to reason about performance, scalability, reliability, and cost tradeoffs in distributed systems

Base Salary Range: ¥831,400 - ¥1,247,000 CNY gross

This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in company incentive plans.

Benefits: comprehensive health/life/disability insurance, commute subsidy, employee stock ownership, retirement plans, generous vacation, parental support, mental health programs, training and development, etc. Benefits eligibility varies by country and employment status.

Life at Unity

Unity [NYSE: U] is the world's leading game engine, powering play for more than 3 billion consumers each month. Unity also enables teams across industries like automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare to design, simulate, and collaborate in 3D.

This position requires sufficient knowledge of English for professional verbal and written exchanges, since the duties require frequent communication with colleagues and partners worldwide whose common language is English.

jobs.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. Team: Edge AI Group, Analog Devices Inc. (ADI)

Analog Devices' Edge AI team is reimagining how machines perceive, decide, and act in the world around them. We're developing intelligent systems that bring together best-in-class sensing with real-time AI.

We're looking for AI/ML Engineers with expertise in learned robot policies, task planning, computer vision and decision-making under uncertainty. Your work will drive how autonomous systems reason about goals, decompose tasks, and adapt in dynamic environments.

You'll be a core contributor to the development of robust and efficient AI-based robot policies, working alongside experts in hardware, embedded systems, and AI software. This is a hands-on role that blends applied research with production-grade engineering.

Responsibilities
- Prototype and deploy AI based robot policy architectures that operate under tight latency and compute constraints at the Edge.
- Develop task policies using techniques such as hierarchical planning, imitation learning, reinforcement learning or hybrid methods.
- Contribute to the evolution of our Edge AI stack by connecting planning with low-level controls and high-level semantic reasoning.
- Work with real-world and simulated sensor data to test and refine models; contribute to internal datasets and benchmarking tools.
- Participate in project planning, code reviews, and architectural discussions; take ownership of technical areas and deliver high-quality, reliable implementations.
- Stay current with trends in AI for robotics (e.g., expert and generalist policies, foundation models), and help integrate relevant advancements into our workflows.

Qualifications
- 3+ years of experience in AI, robotics, or computer vision.
- Master/PhD's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering).
- Knowledgeable in the areas of robot locomotion, robot kinematics and robot dynamics.
- Proficient in Python, with practical experience using ROS, PyTorch or TensorFlow.
- Comfortable working with real-world sensor data (e.g., ToF, vision, IMU) and simulation tools like Gazebo, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, OpenAI Gym or Unreal.
- Experience with DevOps/MLOps tools: Docker, CI/CD pipelines, version control (Git).
- Skilled at communicating technical insights, collaborating with multi-disciplinary teams, and contributing to shared architectural decisions.

Bonus Experience
- Experience integrating perception models with control loops, path planning, or robot operating systems (ROS2).
- Familiarity with industrial robotics, fixed arm robots, or autonomous systems in structured environments.
- Familiarity with teleoperation and/or learning from human demonstration.
- Contributions to open-source robotics or AI frameworks.

Why Join Us?

Join ADI's Edge AI team to help create truly intelligent edge systems - where sensing, learning, and acting happen in real time. You'll work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, solving hard problems with people who care about impact, reliability, and real-world performance.

jobs.location_raw: 中国 广东省 深圳
jobs.description:
Job ID 2026-17483 Date posted 09/10/2026 Location Shanghai, China; Shenzhen, China Category Software Engineering

At Arm, we're enabling AI and applications from the most influence developers in China to run everywhere—from cloud to edge —powering billions of devices worldwide!

This role sits at the intersection of machine learning, systems optimization, and developer experience, with a focus on enabling efficient deployment of AI models on Arm-based devices. You will work hands-on with model optimization techniques such as tiling, quantization, pruning etc. to help developers transform large foundation models into production-ready, resource-efficient versions that run locally on edge and mobile hardware. You will work on developer's applications based on standard software stacks and frameworks by integrating arm-based AI technologies to boost performance of their models and frameworks much earlier before the technologies go to market. You will do in-depth profiling and analysis of the whole solution stack all the way from application usage down to the architecture even before silicon is available to use. You'll work closely with engineering and product teams to identify friction in SDKs, runtimes, tooling or even silicon for app developer adoption of Arm technologies. You will advocate for improvements across areas like on-device inference, model deployment, etc. through high quality contents like white papers, talks, demos etc., in various developer events.

Success of this role means enablement of Arm AI technologies in highly influential AI applications before technologies go to market and equally important to drive in-depth insights based on analysis of the full system behavior to designer better future products.

What You'll Bring

Strong problem solving and analysis skills. Articulate and clarity in technical issues and deliverables in reports or meetings. Ability to explain sophisticated systems to a range of audiences
Understanding of neural network (e.g. LLM, CNN etc.) and deploy efficient AI models on device through optimization techniques and tools like tiling, quantization, pruning, and LoRA/PEFT etc.
Familiarity with ML frameworks (e.g., Pytorch, LiteRT, TensorRT, Core ML) and partner with ML frameworks and tooling ecosystems to optimize runtimes and ensure production readiness.
Develop technical guides, tutorials, and benchmarking and analysis reports focused on performance and efficiency on Arm platforms.
Strong debugging, profiling and analysis skills of full software stacks on arm based devices: mobile (Android) to cloud (server/Linux). Strong experience in Python, Embedded, C/C++.
Passion in the above areas and great flexibility to work on various AI applications from 3rd parties
Contributions to developer ecosystems through high quality contents like white papers, blogs, talks, demos and open source engagements.

Preferences

Experience with automotive/robotics software and applications like Android automotive, IVI or ADAS will be a big PLUS
Understanding of hardware and system architectures (compute, memory, PCIe, mesh, thermal) in a big PLUS
Systems-level understanding of performance optimization on CPUs, NPUs and accelerators.
Experience with edge-to-cloud applications (mobile or IoT + cloud integration)
Familiarity with model formats and optimization (e.g., ONNX, quantization, TFLite)
Familiarity with modern cloud infrastructure (containers, Kubernetes, serverless)

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology.

Use of AI in Your Application: your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities; you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments.

Hybrid Working: Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing; teams determine their own hybrid working patterns.

Equal Opportunities: Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues.

jobs.title: Harness Engineer
jobs.description:
在别处，你优化的是 KPI；在这里，你优化的是智能本身。K3 明天比今天聪明多少，有一部分由你决定。
Elsewhere, you optimize KPIs. Here, you optimize intelligence itself. How much smarter K3 gets tomorrow is, in part, your call.

模型本身不会干活。让它在真实世界里可靠完成任务的，是包裹它的那层 Harness：上下文工程、工具调用、执行环境、评测与反馈回路。你面对的是一批没有标准答案的硬问题——多步任务的失败恢复怎么做、Agent 变强了怎么用数字证明、百万级并发沙箱怎么调度、推理成本怎么继续砍。而你的每一行代码，明天就运行在海量用户的产品里。
Models don't do work by themselves. What makes them reliably complete tasks in the real world is the Harness around them: context engineering, tool calling, execution environments, evaluation and feedback loops. You'll face hard problems with no textbook answers — how to recover from multi-step task failures, how to prove an Agent got stronger with numbers, how to schedule millions of concurrent sandboxes, how to keep cutting inference costs. And every line you write runs in production at massive scale tomorrow.

你会负责一个或多个方向：
- Agent Harness 框架：任务规划、工具调用、上下文工程、多步推理与失败恢复——决定模型"干活能力"上限的那层脚手架
- Eval 与数据闭环：实验、评测、回归——让"模型变强了没有"从感觉变成数字
- 工程基建与效能：Telemetry、执行环境、CI/CD、AI 辅助研发流程
- 或者一个我们还没起名字的方向——我们鼓励这个

You'll own one or more of:
- Agent Harness framework: task planning, tool calling, context engineering, multi-step reasoning and failure recovery — the scaffolding that sets the ceiling of what the model can actually do
- Eval & data loop: experiments, evaluation, regression — turning "is the model stronger?" from a feeling into a number
- Engineering infrastructure: telemetry, execution environments, CI/CD, AI-assisted development workflows
- Or a direction we haven't named yet — we actively encourage that

如果你是这样的人，大概率会在这里如鱼得水：敢于质疑权威、引领而非跟随；知其所以然——不背八股，真正理解系统背后的原理；对代码、文档、架构的美感有执念（加分项：有一个持续维护、认真打磨的个人项目）；看 transcript，不只看 score；遇到问题，你造的是防止整类问题的基建，而不是补丁；有 Harness / Agent / LLM 实战经验（工具编排、Eval、vibe coding 均可）。

You might thrive here if you: question authority and lead rather than follow. You understand the why beneath things — no rote knowledge, just how systems actually work. You set a high bar for code, docs, and architecture (bonus: a personal project you still actively maintain and care about). You read transcripts, not only scores. When you find a problem, you build the infrastructure that prevents its whole class. Hands-on Harness / Agent / LLM experience (tool orchestration, eval, vibe coding all count).

小团队没有"这是别人的活"，你改的 Harness 明天就进海量用户的产品；也没有中层和汇报表演，你和研究员、创始团队直接协作，成果公开署名，支持开源和发 paper。

On a small team there is no "someone else's job" — your Harness changes ship to a massive user base tomorrow. No middle management, no performance theater — you work directly with researchers and the founding team, with public credit for your work, and support for open source and papers.

北京欢迎你！GitHub 比简历重要——直接附链接，我们聊你的代码，不聊八股。不完全匹配也欢迎。
Beijing welcomes you! GitHub matters more than your résumé — send the link and we'll talk about your code, not trivia. Imperfect match welcome.

海绵音乐是由自研SeedMusic大模型驱动的AI音乐创作工具，覆盖iOS/Android/Web三端，核心目标是用AI降低音乐创作门槛，让没有专业制作技能的普通用户也能轻松创作个性化音乐。
产品核心能力包括灵感成曲（一句话生成完整歌曲）、写词成曲（含对话式AI写词）、改编（参考音频/链接一键Remix）、做同款（他人作品二创）、生成MV、相册配乐、专属音色录制等知识库。支持多曲风（流行、民谣、电子、R&B、国风/戏腔、民族风等）与多语种（中英日韩西及中国方言），中文人声是特色优势。在字节跳动音乐生态中与流媒体、顶级版权合作互补，产品既服务普通用户自我表达，也覆盖视频创作者与企业客户的配乐需求。

1、自驱产品需求设计与数据驱动迭代：深入理解创作者场景，将用户反馈与业务目标转化为清晰的产品方案，并推动需求闭环落地，并建设好相关数据埋点和指标分析，以数据驱动产品迭代与效果验证；
2、打造AI原生音乐创作体验：负责海绵音乐的全栈设计与开发，打通前端创作工具、后端服务与AI生成能力，推动核心功能从原型验证到上线迭代的完整交付；
3、建设新一代音乐创作工具：建设音乐生成、编辑与试听等核心创作工具，探索自然语言交互与可视化编辑相结合的创作体验，提升用户的表达效率与创作可控性；
4、主导音乐创作Agent的工程化建设：完善上下文管理、工具调用与任务编排，支持多轮交互和复杂创作任务的可靠执行；
5、让多模态模型真正进入产品：协同算法团队推进大语言模型、音乐生成及音频理解等多模态能力的产品化，建立效果评测与用户反馈闭环，持续优化生成质量和场景适配；
6、解决生成式应用的工程挑战：建设支撑异步生成与长任务执行的服务架构，完善任务调度、状态反馈与稳定性治理，兼顾响应速度、生成成本和规模扩展。

职位要求
1、本科及以上学历，5年以上研发经验，具备完整的全栈项目交付经历，精通Go、Java、Python等至少一种后端语言；
2、熟悉TypeScript及React、Vue等主流前端技术，具备复杂Web应用开发经验，能够将创作流程转化为流畅、易用的交互工具；
3、具备Agent或多模态AI应用落地经验，理解提示词设计、上下文管理、工具编排与效果评测，能够将模型能力转化为稳定可用的产品功能；
4、具备分布式服务设计与优化经验，熟悉异步任务和数据处理链路，能够解决生成式应用中的可靠性、延迟与成本问题；
5、具备产品判断力和独立推进能力，能结合用户反馈快速验证、迭代创作体验；有音乐创作、音视频处理或AI创作工具开发经验者优先。
jobs.notes: 字节海绵音乐（SeedMusic 大模型）全栈岗，主导音乐创作 Agent 工程化（上下文管理/工具调用/任务编排），Go/Java/Python + TS/React 全栈，5 年+经验判 senior。多模态生成+长任务架构是亮点，音乐 domain 较垂直。

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Voice Agent
jobs.description:
Overview
Join our innovative team at Azure Voice AI, where we are at the forefront of AI technology. We are dedicated to creating cutting-edge generative voice and avatar AI models that revolutionize user experiences. The Azure Voice AI team's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to have human like, diverse and delightful AI voices and avatars!

As a Developer for Generative Voice and Avatar AI Models, you will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and implementing state-of-the-art AI models that power our next-generation products.

Responsibilities
Drive omni model development with SOTA ASR and TTS.
Develop SOTA talking avatar models for zero shot and fine tune scenario.
Familiar with latest GenAI modelling technique like diffusion and language modelling.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI models into various applications and platforms.
Conduct research and stay updated with the latest advancements in AI and machine learning to continuously improve our models.
Optimize and fine-tune AI models for performance, scalability, and accuracy.
Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and contribute to the overall improvement of our development processes.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python.
Experience with machine learning frameworks and libraries (e.g., PyTorch).

Preferred Qualifications
Knowledge of natural language processing (NLP) and computer vision techniques.
Familiarity with generative models, such as GANs, VAEs, diffusion, flow matching or autoregressive models.
Excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for innovation.
Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
jobs.notes: 微软 Azure Voice AI 高级岗，做 SOTA ASR/TTS omni 模型与 talking avatar 生成模型（diffusion/flow matching），偏语音生成模型研发而非 Agent 编排。要求 4 年+、PyTorch，定 senior。与 4478523399（SWE II - Voice Agent）同团队不同级别，适合语音/生成模型背景者。

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer--M365 UIPilot team
jobs.description:
Overview
The UIPilot team at Microsoft builds an AI-powered computer-use platform that enables agents to interact with software and carry out tasks across applications and operating systems. We combine AI, cross-platform interaction, and cloud infrastructure to translate human intent into reliable execution—from individual actions to complex, multi-step workflows.

As a Sr. Software Engineer on the UIPilot team, you will build capabilities across agent planning and reasoning, application interaction, execution orchestration, and failure recovery. You will help make computer-use agents more capable, reliable, and scalable, enabling scenarios spanning productivity, workflow automation, and software validation.

Responsibilities
Advance AI-powered computer use: Develop agent capabilities for planning, interacting with applications, evaluating outcomes, and recovering from failures across web and desktop environments.
Build scalable platform capabilities: Design and deliver backend services, APIs, execution orchestration, and user-facing tools that support scenario onboarding and reliable execution across applications and operating systems.
Strengthen reliability and diagnosability: Investigate issues across AI behavior, agent execution, application interactions, and cloud infrastructure. Establish root causes and improve evaluation, observability, performance, and recovery mechanisms.
Accelerate engineering with AI: Use AI-powered coding agents throughout development.
Own end-to-end engineering outcomes: Drive features from problem definition and technical design through implementation and production validation.

Qualifications
Required: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python.
Must pass Microsoft Cloud Background Check.
Preferred: Master's AND 6+ years, or Bachelor's AND 8+ years. Proficiency with AI-powered coding agents; solid engineering fundamentals in Python-based stack; experience building AI-powered agents, tool integrations, or computer-use capabilities, including planning, task evaluation, and execution recovery; familiarity with FastAPI, Playwright, Windows UI automation, or TypeScript/React; familiarity with iOS, Android, MacOS development and automation; experience with distributed execution, containers, Kubernetes/AKS, or Azure services.
jobs.notes: 微软上海 M365 UIPilot 团队：computer-use Agent 平台（规划/执行编排/失败恢复），本批最硬核的 Agent 系统岗之一，Python+FastAPI+Playwright 栈。Sr. 要求 4-8 年定 senior；混合办公、17 人申请，与已抓的 Voice Agent 岗同属微软在华 Agent 布局。

jobs.title: 全栈开发工程师
jobs.company: 梅赛德斯-奔驰租赁有限公司
jobs.description:
该职位来源于猎聘

岗位目标

团队负责为梅赛德斯-奔驰中国设计、开发和运营内部数字化应用，并推动 Tech China 采用 AI 赋能的软件交付模式。全栈开发工程师是团队中的高级个人贡献者，负责所分配的内部应用（例如 OneWeb、小程序和 OCC），包括 Web 端和小程序前端、后端服务、数据层，以及相关的测试和部署流水线。需要在商定的目标架构和团队标准范围内，端到端地设计和实现功能，包括解决方案设计、对象和数据建模、编程、自动化测试、发布和实施支持。该岗位将在由产品负责人、架构师和 DevOps 组成的敏捷跨职能团队中，以独立工作或结对协作的方式开展工作。该岗位需要开发快速原型，以便在短周期迭代中对想法进行测试和改进；同时应用团队批准的 AI 辅助工程工具和实践，并对所交付代码的质量、安全性和可维护性承担全部责任。候选人应具备扎实的增量式和迭代式软件开发经验，例如领域驱动设计、极限编程和快速原型开发。

岗位职责

1. 解决方案设计与实施
- 在商定的目标架构、安全要求和团队标准范围内，为所负责的内部应用（例如 OneWeb、小程序和 OCC）端到端地设计和实现功能。
- 在已批准的标准范围内，独立决定实施方式、组件设计和技术使用（S）；对于会影响目标架构、跨团队接口或安全性的决策，应按照既定审批流程，与相关决策负责人共同作出决定（C）。
- 应用敏捷实践以及团队批准的 AI 辅助工程实践；确保团队和产品负责人能够清楚了解交付状态和存在的障碍。
- 识别并解决开发过程中出现的问题。

2. 理解客户和业务需求
- 理解推动各项计划的业务需求，并与产品负责人共同将这些需求转化为清晰的验收标准。
- 构建可运行的原型，为核心业务目标和业务决策提供支持。
- 与利益相关方密切合作，确保所交付的功能符合其预期。

3. 技术评估与应用
- 评估与所负责应用相关的新兴技术和 AI 辅助开发工具，并交付具体成果，包括经过评估的原型和书面建议（P）。
- 是否将相关技术纳入团队的交付模式，由直属主管共同决定；如果涉及标准或安全性，则按照既定审批流程共同决定（C）。
- 持续更新自身在开发工具、平台和实践方面的知识。

4. 质量、稳定性和生产支持
- 维护本人代码变更对应的自动化测试，评审其他开发人员的变更，并在部署前后验证发布结果。
- 使用代码分析工具和重构方法持续改进代码质量和性能；在商定的时间范围内解决安全问题。
- 按照团队商定的支持安排，对所负责应用的生产事故作出响应，包括服务级别、升级路径以及适用情况下的值班轮班安排。
- 在事故发生后进行根本原因分析，并实施防止问题再次发生的措施。

任职资格

教育背景：计算机科学、软件工程、信息工程或相关专业本科及以上学历，或具备类似资质。

必备经验：
- 具备 5 年以上专业软件开发经验，其中包括 3 年以上在开发岗位中进行应用级解决方案设计的经验，包括组件设计、API 设计和数据设计；不要求承担过正式的架构师职责。
- 具备生产功能的端到端交付经验，覆盖前端框架、后端技术栈、关系型数据库、自动化测试以及 CI/CD 部署流程。
- 具备覆盖软件开发生命周期各个阶段的敏捷软件开发经验。
- 具备使用 AI 辅助开发工具交付软件的实际经验，例如 AI 编程助手和规范驱动开发，并能够对由此产生的代码进行评审、测试和维护。
- 具备在跨国或多元文化环境中工作的经验。

必备专业知识：
- 专业掌握团队使用的至少一种后端语言，包括 Java、Go、Python 或 TypeScript/Node.js；同时掌握一种现代前端框架，例如 React、Vue 或类似框架，并熟悉 HTML5、CSS3、TypeScript/JavaScript、REST 和 JSON。
- 掌握关系型数据库设计和 SQL，以及容器、云原生服务和 CI/CD 流水线。
- 掌握自动化测试，包括单元测试、集成测试和端到端测试，以及代码评审和安全编码实践。
- 掌握领域驱动设计；能够编写可维护、可扩展且易读的代码，并能够在短时间内构建概念验证（PoC）。
- 了解 AI 在软件交付中的应用：能够按照适用的信息处理和合规规定，在软件开发生命周期中使用经批准的 AI 工具，并对每一项 AI 辅助变更的理解、评审、测试和维护承担责任。
- 具备良好的中文口语和书面表达能力，以及商务水平的英语能力。

优先条件：
- 掌握其他后端语言、NoSQL 数据库或函数式编程。
- 具备小程序或移动端开发经验，例如微信小程序、iOS 或 Android。
jobs.notes: 奔驰中国（租赁子公司）内部数字化全栈开发高级岗：OneWeb/小程序/OCC 应用端到端交付，重点是 AI 辅助软件工程（AI 编程助手、规范驱动开发），非 LLM Agent 产品开发。5 年以上经验判 senior，月薪 15-40K，偏传统全栈+AI 工具链。

Solid experience in incremental and iterative software development (e.g. Domain-Driven Design, Extreme Programming, rapid prototyping) is expected.

Quality, stability and production support
- Maintain automated tests for own changes, review changes of other developers and verify releases before and after deployment

- Respond to production incidents for the assigned applications within the team's agreed support arrangement (service levels and escalation path; on-call rota where applicable)
- Perform root-cause analysis after incidents and implement measures that prevent recurrence

Qualification

Experience (essential)

- Practical experience delivering software with AI-assisted development tools (e.g. AI coding assistants, spec-driven development) and reviewing, testing and maintaining the resulting code
- Working experience in a multinational or multicultural environment

Specific Knowledge (essential)

- AI in software delivery: applies approved AI tools within the SDLC in line with applicable information-handling and compliance rules, and remains responsible for understanding, reviewing, testing and maintaining every AI-assisted change
- Good command of spoken and written Chinese and business-level English

Preferred
- Additional back-end languages; NoSQL databases; functional programming
- Mini-program or mobile development (WeChat Mini Program, iOS, Android)

AI4S 是恩和技术先进性的重要战略方向。AI4S 技术团队需要探索面向生物制造的 AI4S 前沿方向——包括虚拟细胞/条件化细胞状态建模、蛋白与酶的生成式设计等，判断哪些方法真正具备落地价值，并为其设计可验证的实验路径；推进 AI 驱动的合成生物学项目，用模型指导菌株、酶与代谢途径的设计，并在实验端完成验证与迭代；建设 WetBench 实验评测平台，建立 AI for Biomanufacturing 的主流任务与评测体系。

1. 主导 AI4S 前沿技术方向的科学定义与验证路径（虚拟细胞方向：条件化细胞状态建模；蛋白与酶设计方向：序列—结构—功能关系、生成式设计与定向进化的实验验证闭环；技术判断与可信评测机制）。
2. 主导代表性任务集合的设计与推进（基因扰动与表型预测、代谢途径设计、途径组合优化、底盘性能改造、发酵过程优化）。
3. 推动 AI 驱动的合成生物学项目落地（DBTL 流程中承担科学主导与实验落地、主动学习/贝叶斯优化迭代筛选）。
4. 建立稳定、高通量的实验与质量体系（SOP、对照体系、跨批次验证、自动化与高通量）。
5. 建设完整、可追溯的实验数据资产（与数据及算法团队共同制定数据规范）。
6. 共同建立可信的 AI 评测机制（zero-shot、few-shot 与迭代优化评测场景、控制数据泄漏）。
7. 实验计划与成果交付。

我们希望你具备：合成生物学、代谢工程、微生物学、生物化工、生物工程或相关专业背景；博士，或硕士并具备扎实的相关研发经验；在至少一种主流微生物底盘上具有系统研发经验；在高通量筛选、遗传扰动文库、代谢途径优化、发酵工程中至少一个方向有深入实践；扎实的实验设计与数据分析能力；能与算法及数据工程团队沟通；加分项：机器学习辅助菌株/酶设计、主动学习、贝叶斯优化或 DBTL 闭环研发，Python/R 数据处理。

【Requirements (Must Have)】
资深工程背景：扎实的 Python 或 TypeScript 功底，具备 3 年以上分布式系统、高并发后端服务开发经验，能独立解决系统级的架构难题。
AI 技术实战：深入掌握 LLM 应用生态，熟练使用 LangChain 等 Agent 开发框架，具备 RAG 系统设计与生产环境部署的完整经验。

深度学习微调：具备大模型精调（如 LoRA/QLoRA）实战经验，或有模型蒸馏、评估体系搭建背景者优先。
咨询交付方法论：熟悉 Agile 或 Lean Inception 等交付模式。
【关于公司】英湃科技（Inspire）源自全球领先的软件及技术咨询先锋Thoughtworks中国本地业务，专注企业级AI与数字化转型。团队汇聚全球顶尖科技企业与咨询机构的核心力量。覆盖汽车、金融、消费、制造、医疗、能源等行业。公司获得知名投资机构支持。

1. 学历背景：本科及以上学历，计算机科学、软件工程、人工智能等相关专业优先。
2. 经验要求：5年及以上后端研发经验，其中2年及以上 AI Agent / 大模型应用平台研发经验，有完整商业化 AI Agent 产品研发经历者优先。
3. 技术能力：精通Python/Go/Java中至少一种主流编程语言，熟练掌握微服务架构、RESTful API 设计与开发；深入理解大模型 Agent 核心原理，熟练使用LangChain/LlamaIndex等 Agent 开发框架，具备工具调用、任务编排、记忆机制开发经验；熟悉主流大模型（GPT 系列、文心一言、通义千问等）的调用与适配，掌握向量数据库（Milvus/FAISS 等）与知识库检索技术；具备高并发、高可用系统设计经验，熟练使用 Docker、Kubernetes 等容器化与编排技术。
4. 软素质：具备较强的问题分析与解决能力，良好的沟通协作意识，能够在快速迭代环境中高效推进工作，对 AI 技术有强烈热情。
【加分项】
1. 有大模型微调、推理加速或多模态融合（文本、语音、图像）研发经验；
2. 参与过企业级 AI Agent 平台架构设计，或有 To B 领域 AI 产品研发经验；
3. 拥有开源项目贡献经历或相关技术专利 / 论文。

jobs.description:
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。
Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。
Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。
岗位职责
1、AI Copilot 系统研发：负责本地化 AI Copilot 系统的架构设计与核心代码编写，实现 AI 辅助翻译、术语推荐、译后编辑（PE）等功能。
2、向量检索与 RAG 落地：负责向量数据库（Vector DB）的选型、搭建与优化；利用检索增强生成（RAG）技术，将现有的翻译记忆库（TM）和术语库（TB）转化为向量，实现高召回、高精准的上下文检索。
3、主流大模型（LLM）接入与性能优化：负责将 Google Cloud（Vertex AI / Gemini）、OpenAI、Claude 等海外主流 AI 模型，通过 API 高效、稳定地接入公司现有的本地化作业平台与 CAT 自动化流水线；并解决大模型调用中的高并发、高延迟、API 限流等问题，优化 Token 消耗成本。
4、Prompt 工程与调优：主导面向多语种（特别是复杂语种，如韩语、泰语、缅甸语、西语等）的 Prompt 设计、微调与评估；通过 Few-shot、COT、Structured Output 等技术，确保 AI 翻译在字数限制、标签（Tag）保留、语气风格上达到工业级游戏本地化标准。
5、本地化 TMS 系统开发与运维：负责本地化 TMS 系统的新特性开发与已有功能的维护、性能优化，实现本地化流程自动化和全球应用。
6、本地化业务支持：理解游戏本地化流程与实践，利用 AI 与工具能力持续优化本地化效率与质量；后续可负责一到多款游戏的多语言本地化，与上游研发团队和发行团队沟通、制定整体本地化计划与预算、交付符合质量要求的本地化多语言版本。
岗位要求
1、本科及以上学历，计算机、语言类、本地化或相关专业，有3年以上实际开发经验。扎实的编程能力，熟练掌握 Python / Go / Node.js 中的至少一种开发语言，具备良好的编码规范。
2、大模型开发经验：熟悉 LangChain、LlamaIndex 等主流 LLM 开发框架，有实际的大模型 API（如 Google Vertex AI, OpenAI）对接与工程化落地经验。
3、向量数据库经验：熟悉至少一种向量数据库（如 Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone, Chroma），理解向量嵌入（Embedding）原理，有 RAG 系统调优经验者优先；同事具备优秀的Prompt 能力，对 Prompt Engineering 有深入理解，能够熟练编写结构化 Prompt，并能通过自动评估或评测集不断迭代 Prompt 效果。
4、游戏本地化认知：了解游戏端内外内容的本地化流程和实践，有游戏本地化版本成功交付经验者优先；熟悉翻译、审校、配音或LQA流程，对游戏本地化有独到的见解，善于利用工具和 AI 能力持续优化本地化效率和质量。
5、熟悉本地化业务：熟悉翻译记忆库（TMX）、术语表（TBX）、CAT 工具；具备MS office等本地化行业常见文档格式处理能力和经验者优先。
6、英语能力：书面或口头交流顺畅，能快速阅读英文技术文档，并与海外团队、供应商顺畅沟通。
腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会
在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会创造更多价值。
jobs.notes: 腾讯 Level Infinite 游戏本地化 AI 工程岗：AI Copilot 翻译系统、向量检索/RAG（TM/TB 向量化）、Vertex AI/Gemini/Claude API 接入与成本优化、多语种 Prompt 工程。大模型应用 + 游戏本地化复合要求，需 3 年开发经验与英语能力，细分领域明确。

jobs.title: AI 算法专家
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day
聚焦AI算法与大模型技术在能源领域尤其是发电领域（包括火电和新能源）场景中的研究与落地。算法功底扎实，对大模型技术有深入理解并能够根据产品需求快速完成从算法选型、开发到工程交付。

How You'll Make an Impact
根据产品团队提出的场景需求，进行算法调研、方案设计与技术选型，输出可落地的算法方案，并推动从原型验证到线上部署的全流程交付。
研发面向时序数据的异常检测、趋势预测、模式识别等核心算法，持续优化模型在准确率、误报率、召回率、泛化性等维度的表现。
深入研究大语言模型（LLM）在能源智能领域的应用，包括但不限于：基于LLM的智能精确诊断问答与推理、运维日志与报警信息的语义理解、结构化知识抽取与知识图谱构建、多轮对话式故障分析Agent、LLM与时序模型的协同架构设计。
探索多模态大模型在能源场景的落地路径，如结合振动频谱图、趋势曲线图等视觉信息与文本信息进行综合诊断推理。
研究自监督学习、迁移学习、无监督学习等方法，解决能源场景中标注数据稀缺、故障样本不均衡的现实问题。
建立规范的算法评估体系与实验管理流程，确保算法迭代的可追溯、可对比、可复现。
与领域工程师紧密协作，将业务侧描述的设备问题转化为明确的算法问题定义。

What You Bring
学历：硕士及以上学历。计算机科学、人工智能、机器学习、统计学、数学、信号处理等相关专业。
经验：5年以上算法研发应用经验，有实际项目从研究到产品落地的完整经历。有能源领域大模型应用研发经验的优先。
算法能力：扎实的机器学习与深度学习理论基础；熟练掌握时序分析相关方法。
大模型能力：对LLM技术栈有体系化理解，包括Prompt Engineering、RAG、Fine-tuning、Function Calling / Tool Use、Agent架构。有实际的LLM应用开发或微调经验，了解主流开源模型的特点与部署方式。
工程落地能力：Python为主力语言，PyTorch熟练使用。能独立完成模型训练、评估、优化到API服务封装的全过程。
加分项：火电、风电、石化、制造业等能源AI项目经验；时序基础模型研究经验；熟悉Dify、LangChain等LLM应用开发框架；有InfluxDB等时序数据库使用经验；有相关方向论文发表、专利或竞赛获奖。
jobs.notes: 西门子能源上海 AI 算法专家：发电场景 LLM 落地（多轮对话故障分析 Agent、RAG、Function Calling、LLM+时序模型协同），硕士+5 年定 senior。工业 Agent 方向扎实且团队配领域工程师，93 人申请热度中高。

jobs.title: AI Framework Engineer
jobs.description:
THE ROLE:
As a core member of the team, you will play a pivotal role in optimizing and developing deep learning frameworks for AMD GPUs. Your experience will be critical in enhancing GPU kernels, deep learning models, and training/inference performance across multi-GPU and multi-node systems. You will engage with both internal GPU library teams and open-source maintainers to ensure seamless integration of optimizations, utilizing cutting-edge compiler technologies and advanced engineering principles to drive continuous improvement.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
End to end optimization: Build and optimize end to end distributed inference (e.g, P/D disaggregation and Large-EP) and RL solutions on mainstream frameworks like vLLM and SGlang.
Collaborate with GPU Library Teams: Work closely with internal teams to analyze and improve training and inference performance on AMD GPUs.
Collaborate with Open-Source Maintainers: Engage with framework maintainers to ensure code changes are aligned with requirements and integrated upstream.
Work in Distributed Computing Environments: Optimize deep learning performance on both scale-up (multi-GPU) and scale-out (multi-node) systems.
Utilize Cutting-Edge Compiler Tech: Leverage advanced compiler technologies to improve deep learning performance.
Optimize Deep Learning Pipeline: Enhance the full pipeline, including integrating graph compilers.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:
GPU Kernel Development & Optimization: Experienced in designing and optimizing GPU kernels for deep learning on AMD GPUs using HIP, CUDA, and assembly (ASM). Strong knowledge of AMD architectures (GCN, RDNA), leveraging tools like Compute Kernel (CK), CUTLASS, and Triton.
Deep Learning Integration: Experienced in integrating optimized GPU performance into ML and LLM frameworks (e.g., vLLM, SGlang, TensorFlow, PyTorch) to accelerate model training and inference.
End to end solution optimization: solid hands-on E2E performance tuning experience on distributed inference (P/D disaggregation and Large-EP) and RL. Experienced in Text to Video or Image to Video is a plus.
Software Engineering: Skilled in Python and C++.
High-Performance Computing: large-scale workloads on heterogeneous computing clusters.
Compiler Optimization: LLVM and ROCm.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS: Bachelor's and/or Master's in CS, CE, EE, or related fields, with professional experience in GPU optimization, performance engineering, and framework development.
jobs.notes: AMD 上海 AI Framework 岗：vLLM/SGLang 分布式推理（P/D 分离、Large-EP）与 RL 训练优化，ROCm/HIP/Triton 内核开发，直接对接开源社区。LLM Infra 硬核方向，发布 3 天仅 6 人申请，是推理优化背景进入外企 GPU 厂的窗口。

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Assistance Engineering
jobs.description:
Your Location:
This position is CHINA BASED. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. Your recruiter will inform you what cities you are able to work from depending on your personal legal working identity and Airbnb internal policies.

The Community You Will Join

Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence are at the heart of the Airbnb product. From Trust to Payments, and from Customer Service to Marketing we rely on ML to ensure that guests and hosts have the best possible experience with Airbnb.

The Community Support Products (CSP) Machine Learning team is the core team responsible for driving CSxAI (Customer Support x Artificial Intelligence) initiatives by adopting the Generative AI technologies to enable an intelligent, scalable and exceptional service experience. The team develops and enhances various AI models, ML services and tools including LLM fine-tuning and optimization, RAG/Search, LLM evaluation and testing automation, feedback-based learning and guardrail for a wide range of applications in Airbnb.

The richness of Airbnb's data, the complexity of its marketplace and the variety innate in our product mean that we need to operate at the state of the art of AI practice. We are committed to investing in long term innovation to solve the complex problems we face, and to do that we need the very best experts in ML and AI to join us.

The Difference You Will Make

We believe our current customer experiences in these domains are only scratching the surface of the innovations that are possible, and that science is at the heart of delivering a step-function change for our Guest and and Host on Airbnb.

You will build and leverage cutting edge AI technologies to transform Airbnb’s customer service by delivering personalized, easy-to-use and proactive customer service experience.

Many of the initiatives you’ll tackle are in their early conceptual stages. You will have the opportunity to shape these ideas from inception to production, turning visionary concepts into impactful realities.

A Typical Day

Envision, champion, and support the development of novel ML systems, product integrations, and performance optimizations to solve real-world problems
Work cross-functionally with product, design, and other engineering counterparts to design and build efficient AI solutions for Airbnb CS products
Learn and share the latest AI/ML technologies with the team across regions( China and the US).

Your Expertise

PhD/Master’s degree, preferably in CS, or equivalent experience
2-4 years of ML engineering experience, with ownership responsibility over large-scale software systems.
Background in the design and development of AI and ML systems and services, and a deep passion for building efficient and scalable ML-powered products
Experience with LLM driven chatbot and Agentic AI products would be a big plus
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team and with teams across the engineering, product & design organizations
Fluency in both English and Mandarin is essential.
jobs.notes: Airbnb 客服 AI（CSxAI）团队 MLE，做 LLM 微调/RAG/eval/guardrail，Agentic AI 产品经验加分。2-4 年经验 mid，中国远程办公，需中英双语。大厂远程坑稀缺。

jobs.title: Large Language Model R&D Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Develop and optimize LLM, VLM, embedding, and audio multimodal models based on open-source foundation models. Build GUI-recognition and automated-control agents for medical post-processing software and medical devices, meeting product design, performance, and compliance-validation requirements. This role does not involve large-scale foundation-model pretraining.

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description

Multimodal Fine-Tuning & Agent Development
- Fine-tune LLM, VLM, embedding, and audio models using PEFT methods including LoRA/QLoRA, SFT, and DPO.
- Deliver GUI recognition, UI-element localization, instruction understanding, task planning, and tool-calling capabilities for device and software automation.

Data, Evaluation & Traceability
- Build multimodal datasets from software screenshots, workflows, device commands, and audio interactions; perform collection, cleaning, annotation, and augmentation.
- Establish automated evaluation for recognition accuracy, instruction-following success, hallucination rate, and robustness; maintain versioning and experiment records for R&D traceability.

Model Optimization & Deployment
- Apply distillation, pruning, and INT4/INT8 quantization (PTQ/QAT) to reduce model size, memory, and compute cost while preserving accuracy.
- Optimize inference through KV cache, operator fusion, and memory reuse; convert and deploy models locally using TensorRT and ONNX Runtime to meet latency and throughput targets.

Integration, Validation & Research
- Integrate VLM interface recognition, LLM planning, embedding retrieval, and ASR understanding into an automated agent loop with engineering teams.
- Support model verification, performance validation, technical documentation, risk analysis, boundary-case analysis, and evaluation of emerging VLM, Agent, GUI, and lightweight-model technologies.

Qualifications

Education
Master's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Pattern Recognition, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field.

Fundamental Knowledge
- Strong understanding of Transformer architectures, LLMs, VLMs, and PyTorch.
- Hands-on end-to-end experience with SFT and parameter-efficient fine-tuning such as LoRA/QLoRA.

Required Technical Skills
- Experience with VLMs (for example, LLaVA), GUI/screenshot visual understanding, and automated-control tasks.
- Knowledge of embedding models, RAG, and ASR model tuning.
- Knowledge of distillation, quantization, pruning, TensorRT, and ONNX Runtime.
- Proficiency in Python and Linux; ability to independently build datasets, train and evaluate models, and complete model conversion and deployment.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in medical devices, medical-imaging post-processing software, medical-device AI, or medical-device software quality systems.
- Practical experience with agent development, tool calling, and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph.
- Experience optimizing models for embedded or compute-constrained local devices; familiarity with C++, inference SDKs, or vector databases.

Professional Competencies
- Strong focus on experiment traceability, model boundaries, and risk management.
- Sound engineering judgment to balance accuracy, latency, and hardware cost.
- Effective cross-functional collaboration with device software, Product, and Quality teams.

Inclusion and Diversity
GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership - always with unyielding integrity.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. You'll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

jobs.description:
About XGEN Labs

XGEN Labs is advancing Generative World Simulation, moving AI beyond content generation toward world simulation.

We are building the backend services and AI infrastructure that enable our models to run reliably and efficiently. We are looking for an engineer who combines backend development, model serving, and infrastructure engineering to help build and scale our model API platform.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of backend systems, generative AI, and GPU infrastructure, collaborating closely with research and product teams to turn model capabilities into reliable, high-performance services.

What You'll Do

Backend Development: Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs for large language models (LLMs) and generative AI models, enabling reliable integration with internal systems and products.
Model Serving & Deployment: Deploy, manage, and operate LLMs and diffusion models on GPU infrastructure, supporting multiple models, instances, and distributed inference workloads.
Production Reliability: Build and maintain monitoring, logging, alerting, health checks, and failure recovery mechanisms. Troubleshoot production issues and continuously improve service reliability and availability.
Inference Performance Optimization: Optimize inference throughput, latency, concurrency, and GPU utilization using frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, and TensorRT-LLM, applying techniques such as continuous batching, KV caching, tensor parallelism, and quantization.
GPU Infrastructure & Automation: Contribute to GPU resource management, workload scheduling, load balancing, autoscaling, CI/CD, observability, and performance benchmarking.
Service Architecture: Improve high-concurrency request handling, asynchronous task execution, request queuing, streaming responses, and fault-tolerant mechanisms to support reliable model serving at scale.

What We're Looking For

A bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, with 1–3 years of experience in backend development, distributed systems, or AI infrastructure.
Strong Python programming skills and hands-on experience with backend frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask, RESTful API design, asynchronous programming, and concurrent services.
Practical experience deploying and operating services in production environments, with proficiency in Linux and Docker and familiarity with Kubernetes.
Hands-on experience deploying GPU-based model inference services using at least one major framework, such as vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM.
A solid understanding of common inference optimization techniques, including continuous batching, KV cache management, tensor parallelism, and model quantization, with some experience in performance profiling and tuning.
Familiarity with backend infrastructure components such as Redis, message queues, Nginx, and databases, as well as load balancing, rate limiting, retries, circuit breakers, and fault tolerance.
A working understanding of LLM and diffusion model architectures and inference workflows, including model deployment, API integration, and service delivery.
Strong engineering fundamentals, system design skills, and problem-solving abilities, with a strong sense of ownership for service reliability and performance.

Nice to Have

Experience deploying, operating, or scheduling large GPU clusters, ranging from dozens to hundreds of GPUs.
Experience building high-concurrency, low-latency, highly available backend services, including model gateways, API authentication, request routing, rate limiting, and load balancing.
Familiarity with NVIDIA GPU architecture and technologies such as CUDA, NCCL, NVLink, and InfiniBand.
Experience deploying or optimizing inference for diffusion models, DiT architectures, image generation, or video generation.
Familiarity with monitoring and orchestration tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Ray, KubeRay, or Slurm.
Experience with multi-node distributed inference, elastic model serving, GPU resource pooling, or inference cost optimization.
Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM or SGLang, or hands-on experience optimizing inference frameworks.

Why This Role

Work on real-world infrastructure challenges at the intersection of backend engineering and generative AI.
Help build the model serving platform that supports our research and product development.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Core AI
jobs.description:
Overview

Are you a software engineer who loves code, moves fast, and enjoys solving problems at scale? Are you excited about AI and want to build the platform that makes AI reliable, resilient, and effortless to operate at global scale?

Do you want to work with cutting-edge open-source and cloud technologies and build systems that are fault-tolerant, self-managing, self-healing, and highly scalable across public and private datacenters around the world? Do AI, Big Data, cloud infrastructure, Docker, Kubernetes, and distributed systems excite you?

If yes, come build with us.

Join the Azure Intelligent Container Platform team within CoreAI and help shape the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI-powered cloud services.

Azure AI Services enable customers to build intelligent applications with powerful capabilities to see, hear, speak, understand, and interpret using AI. Our mission is to transform these breakthrough AI technologies into production-ready, first-class Azure services—delivering the reliability, scale, simplicity, and performance customers need to bring AI innovations to life.

Responsibilities

This role offers end-to-end ownership and real-world impact. You will work closely with leading technology providers and engineering teams to bring cutting-edge AI technologies to Azure—from architecture and productization to platform engineering, deployment, performance, reliability, security, and customer experience.

You will solve challenging problems across the entire software stack and have the opportunity to influence both how the technology is built and how millions of customers experience AI at Azure scale.

You Will

Build for massive scale: Design and develop highly available, scalable distributed systems running across global public and private datacenters.
Engineer for resilience: Build platforms that are fault-tolerant, self-managing, self-healing, and designed for operational excellence.
Push cloud-native innovation: Leverage Docker, Kubernetes, open-source technologies, and cloud platforms to solve complex infrastructure challenges.
Make AI production-ready: Turn rapidly evolving AI and cognitive technologies into reliable, secure, performant, and easy-to-use Azure services.
Own the full lifecycle: Drive solutions from architecture and system design through implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Solve hard problems: Tackle challenges in distributed systems, performance, availability, scalability, security, privacy, and user experience.
Ship technology that matters: Build products and platforms that enable AI experiences for customers around the world.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

AI-native mindset: Proficient in modern AI technologies and tools, with hands-on experience using generative AI, AI coding assistants/agents, and AI/ML frameworks in day-to-day engineering. You actively explore new AI capabilities and use AI to accelerate development, automate workflows, solve complex problems, and build smarter products.
Strong engineering fundamentals: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, a strong quality mindset, and a passion for designing and building robust, maintainable, production-grade software.
Education: BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
Industry experience: 3–5+ years of experience in software development, architecture, system design, object-oriented design, or product engineering.
Programming: Strong hands-on programming experience in one or more of C#, Python, or Go.
Production engineering: Experience with Web APIs, performance/load testing, security, and privacy, with an understanding of building reliable services for production environments.
Ownership & collaboration: Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global engineering environment and drive projects from concept to production.

Nice to Have

Experience building, developing, or operating cloud platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure.
Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized applications.
Experience with large-scale distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, AI/ML infrastructure, or platform engineering.
Experience working with or contributing to open-source technologies and communities.
Experience building highly available, fault-tolerant, self-managing, or self-healing systems.
Experience with Big Data, AI infrastructure, or large-scale data/compute platforms.
Fluency in English and/or Chinese.

CoreAI is building the AI-first application stack at the center of Microsoft's AI platform strategy, bringing together models, agents, tools, data, evaluation, security, governance, and developer experiences.

Microsoft Foundry Service is a unified, production-ready platform that enables developers and enterprises to build, deploy, evaluate, publish, and operate AI applications and agents at scale. You may work on managed agent runtimes, secure and isolated execution, agent session lifecycle, workload scheduling and autoscaling, identity and networking integration, tools and model connectivity, observability, evaluation, publishing, and support for customer-managed compute such as Azure Kubernetes Service. jobs.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 工作内容 1.负责 AI 应用的方案设计、开发与落地，完成从业务需求分析、数据处理、模型开发到系统部署和效果评估的全流程工作。 2.基于 YOLO 等目标检测算法开展模型训练、调优与工程化应用，解决工业视觉检测、目标识别、缺陷检测等实际问题。 3.结合设备运行数据、传感器时序数据及历史故障数据，参与预测性维护、故障预测、异常检测和设备健康状态评估等应用的开发与落地。 4.重点负责 AI Agent Harness 的设计与开发，包括任务编排、工具调用、上下文管理、状态管理、权限控制、执行追踪、异常恢复及评估机制建设。 5.运用 Loop Engineering 方法构建"执行—评估—反馈—优化"的持续迭代闭环，不断提升 Agent 的任务成功率、稳定性和执行效率。 6.负责大模型、视觉模型及时序预测模型的本地化部署、推理服务搭建和性能优化，满足数据安全、低延迟、高可用及离线运行等业务需求。 7.推动 AI 算法与现有业务系统、生产设备及内部平台集成，解决算法从实验环境进入实际生产环境过程中的工程问题。 8.建立模型及 Agent 的测试、评估、监控和回归验证体系，持续分析失败案例并优化模型、提示词、工具链和执行流程。 任职要求 1.精通 .NET，Python 后端开发，具备良好的代码编写习惯与面向对象设计能力。 2.精通 MSSQL、Oracle、Pgsql 数据库，具备复杂的数据库设计、查询优化及SQL编写能力。 3.熟练使用 Python，掌握 PyTorch 等深度学习框架，具备完整的 AI 应用开发能力。 4.熟练掌握 YOLO 系列目标检测算法，具备数据集构建、模型训练、参数调优、效果评估、推理优化及部署经验。 5.了解预测性维护的基本业务流程，熟悉常见时序预测及异常检测算法，如 ARIMA、XGBoost、LSTM、TCN、Transformer 等，能够处理设备传感器时序数据。 6.具备实际的算法落地经验，能够独立完成从业务问题定义、算法选型、模型开发到生产环境部署和效果验证的完整流程。 7.具备较强的 AI Agent Harness 设计与开发能力，能够构建包含模型、工具、任务编排、上下文、记忆、状态、权限、可观测性及异常恢复机制的 Agent 运行框架。 8.具备大模型、视觉模型或时序模型的本地部署经验，熟悉 Linux、Docker，并掌握 ONNX、TensorRT、vLLM、Ollama 等一种或多种推理部署及优化技术。 9.理解并能够实践 Loop Engineering，能够通过自动评估、失败分析、反馈回流、回归测试和持续迭代提升 AI 系统效果。 10.熟悉 Prompt Engineering、RAG、MCP、Function Calling、工作流编排等 AI 应用开发技术，并能够根据实际场景完成工程化集成。 11.具备深厚的平台框架维护经验及解决复杂生产环境问题的调试能力。
jobs.notes: 法雷奥（汽车零部件）工业 AI 岗：YOLO 视觉检测、预测性维护 + AI Agent Harness 设计（任务编排/工具调用/Loop Engineering），本地化部署 vLLM/Ollama。要求 .NET/Python/MSSQL 全能，覆盖面广但薪资仅 15-20K，性价比存疑。

岗位定位：该岗位不以训练新模型、发表算法论文为主要目标，而是负责将公司已有及持续产生的AI算法能力，稳定、标准化地测评、沉淀、封装为可复用的Package、Webserver、Portal、Agent、Workflow、Harness、Tool / API 及内部AI能力组件，形成公司的AI工程资产和能力沉淀。

主要职责
1. Agent 工程化
- 将内部算法、模型、API及外部大模型能力封装为可复用Agent。
- 设计Agent的Tool Calling、Memory、Context、Prompt、权限、状态管理和异常处理机制。
- 支持单Agent、多Agent及人机协同场景。
2. Workflow / Harness 建设
- 将算法研发过程中重复出现的流程抽象成标准Workflow。
- 建设模型调用、数据处理、算法执行、结果验证、评估等统一Harness。
- 降低算法从Notebook / Demo进入生产环境的成本。
3. AI能力平台化沉淀
- 对公司现有模型和算法进行标准化，benchmark性能，封装。
- 建设内部AI能力库 / Agent Registry / Tool Registry。
- 将零散Prompt、脚本、模型能力、算法模块沉淀成标准化组件。
- 建立版本管理、配置管理、调用规范和接口标准。
4. RSI / 自动迭代机制
- 参与设计Agent的自动评估、反馈、反思和迭代机制。
- 建设Eval、Benchmark、Regression Test等体系。
- 探索在明确约束下的Agent自优化、Workflow优化与持续改进机制。
5. 算法服务封装
- 与算法工程师合作，将模型、算法、推理服务封装为稳定API / Service / Tool。
- 处理超时、重试、并发、缓存、Fallback、日志和Tracing等工程问题。
- 保证上层Agent调用算法服务时具备稳定性和可观测性。
6. AI工程规范
- 建立Agent / Workflow开发规范、模板和实践。
- 建设Prompt、Agent、Workflow的版本管理及测试体系。
- 推动AI能力从"个人脚本"变成"公司基础设施"。

我们希望你具备
1、计算机、软件工程、人工智能或相关专业背景。
2、扎实的Python工程能力。
3、有至少2年的LLM Application / Agent / Workflow实际开发经验。
4、熟悉至少一种Agent或Workflow相关技术体系，如 LangGraph、LangChain、AutoGen、CrewAI、OpenAI Agents SDK 或自主开发框架。
5、熟悉REST API、RPC、异步任务、消息队列等基本后端工程能力。
6、熟悉Docker及基本Linux环境。
7、理解LLM的Context、Tool Calling、Structured Output、RAG、Memory、Eval等核心机制。
8、能够把模糊、实验性的算法能力抽象为稳定的软件接口。

加分项
1、做过内部AI平台、Agent Platform或LLMOps平台。
2、有模型评测、Agent Eval、自动化Benchmark经验。
3、熟悉MCP、Tool Protocol、模型Gateway等新型AI基础设施。
4、有生物信息、药物研发、计算化学、医学AI等领域经验。
5、有复杂Workflow编排、任务调度或分布式任务系统经验。
6、有AI Coding Agent、Research Agent或科研自动化系统经验。
7、对Agent自我改进、自动评估、RSI相关方向有实践或深入理解。

这个岗位不是什么
1、不是纯算法研究岗位。
2、不要求你主要负责训练基础模型。
3、不是普通业务后端开发。
4、不是单纯写Prompt。

我们希望找到的是一个AI原生的软件工程师 / Agent Engineer：能够理解算法，同时具备足够强的软件抽象和工程能力，把算法团队不断产生的新能力沉淀成公司的长期AI资产。

jobs.title: Developer Technology Engineer - AI
jobs.description:

Working directly with key application developers to understand the current and future problems they are solving. 2+ years of work experience.
Solid understanding of C, C++, Python, or Fortran.
Strong knowledge of software development, programming techniques, and algorithms.
Strong mathematical fundamentals, including linear algebra and numerical methods.
Background in parallel programming and accelerated computing; experience in GPU programming is desirable.
Experience in full-stack performance analysis and optimization within large language models or HPC; expertise from operator-level through framework-level to algorithm-level optimization strongly preferred.

Solid software engineering fundamentals and system architecture thinking.
Strong communication and cooperation abilities.

Work as an important MADE team representative to connect operations needs with practical AI implementation.

Identify and evaluate AI use cases in manufacturing, quality, supply chain, engineering and office workflows.
Design, develop and deploy AI solutions such as computer vision inspection, OCR, predictive analytics, generative AI assistants and AI agents.
Work with stakeholders to translate business problems into AI solution requirements, data requirements and measurable outcomes.
Support data collection, data cleaning, annotation, model evaluation and performance optimization activities.
Develop AI workflows, prompt strategies, agent logic and integration methods to improve task automation and decision support.
Collaborate with digitalization and automation teams to integrate AI solutions into MES, ERP, vision systems, office tools and production workflows.
Conduct testing, validation and monitoring of deployed AI solutions to ensure reliability, accuracy and usability.
Troubleshoot AI model, data or workflow issues and drive continuous improvement actions.

Ensure AI solutions are aligned with business objectives, compliance requirements and data governance expectations.

Occasional travel is required, including domestic and international travel.

Educational Qualifications:
Bachelor Degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Automation, Engineering or related field; Master degree is preferred.

Experience Qualifications:
3-5 years direct experience in AI engineering, data science, machine learning, computer vision or intelligent automation role.
Experience in biotech, pharmaceutical, manufacturing or industrial AI application is preferred.
Direct experience in computer vision, OCR, machine learning model deployment, LLM application or AI-agent development is preferred.
Familiarity with Python and common AI or ML frameworks and deployment workflows is preferred.
Experience with manufacturing, quality or supply chain business scenarios is highly preferred.
Proficient with Microsoft tools; Word, Excel, Power Point; experience with Python, SQL, Power BI or AI platforms is preferred.
Strong analytical, problem solving and teamwork skills are required.
Experience with structured problem solving and model performance analysis.
Demonstrated knowledge of AI lifecycle management, model validation and continuous improvement methodologies.
Excellent oral and written communication skill in English, be able to work in a multicultural environment.
Practical experience in integrating AI tools with enterprise or manufacturing systems is preferred.

Metrics:
Number of AI solutions deployed and adopted.
AI model or workflow accuracy and stability.
Productivity or HC saving enabled by AI.
Defect detection improvement or decision efficiency improvement.
User adoption and business impact of AI solutions.

jobs.title: AI Application Architect
jobs.description:
As an important member of the R&D team, the AI Application Architect will develop, integrate, test, and maintain the AI R&D QMS Harness platform used to support controlled AI workflows in medical-device R&D. The role focuses on building production-grade AI services, enterprise integrations, prompt and retrieval pipelines, and governed workflow agents that improve quality-system efficiency without bypassing formal QMS controls.

Your Role
Develop AI/LLM application services for the controlled AI Harness, including prompt pipelines, RAG services, workflow orchestration, evidence generation, and reviewer-facing outputs.
Build and maintain read-only integrations to enterprise systems such as DOORS, ALM, ClearQuest, Windchill, SOP/document repositories, and DHF repositories.
Implement AI agents for requirement-quality checks, traceability gap detection, DHF completeness review, defect/change impact analysis, compliance checks, and draft evidence generation.
Create and maintain prompt libraries, retrieval pipelines, metadata schemas, source-citation mechanisms, and output templates aligned with approved QMS workflows.
Implement audit logging, model routing, access control, project isolation, and evidence packaging needed for controlled and traceable AI usage.
Support OQ/PQ activities by building test harnesses, representative datasets, prompt regression tests, hallucination checks, and workflow validation evidence.
Partner with SMEs, QA, RA, Software Quality, and Validation teams to refine use cases, acceptance criteria, and reviewer workflows.
Optimize system performance, reliability, and observability across model calls, document processing, retrieval quality, and application integrations.

You're The Right Fit If
You have acquired 3+ years of experience in software engineering, AI application development, LLM integration, workflow automation, or enterprise systems integration.
Strong programming experience in Python, plus practical experience with APIs, backend services, structured data processing, and AI/LLM application development.
Hands-on experience building RAG pipelines, prompt-based applications, evaluation workflows, or agent-style systems for business or engineering use cases.
Familiar with vector search, document chunking, metadata filtering, citation generation, and prompt/version management.
Experience working with cloud AI platforms, model APIs, or local/private inference environments in enterprise settings.
Understand good engineering practices for logging, testing, reproducibility, access control, and deployment in controlled environments.
