jobs.title: AI Engr I
jobs.location_raw: 中国 广东省 广州
jobs.description:
关于这个岗位： 我们正在推动 AI 从个人效率工具融入可重复的研发流程，并将有效实践沉淀为团队级工程能力。你将与领域专家合作，把真实需求转化为实用的 AI 方案和可复用资产。 你的使命： 将工程知识和流程转化为 Prompt、Skill、Agent、知识资产与自动化工具；整合零散资源，验证新方法，并通过试点、文档、分享和培训推动采用。

岗位职责

需求共创与流程梳理
与 Function 团队负责人和领域专家明确目标、输入、输出、规则、异常及验收标准，判断适合采用 Prompt、Skill、Agent、知识库、确定性脚本或人工审核的环节。

AI 应用原型与工程实现
使用 Python、Git、API 及公司批准的 AI 工具，开发并集成 Prompt、Skill、Agent、自动化脚本和组合工作流，定义上下文边界、工具调用、输入输出、异常处理及审核点。

测试、评估与质量改进
建立代表性测试集，执行回归测试并记录失败，识别问题来自 Prompt、Context、Knowledge、Tool、Mapping、Model 或流程设计，并将验证后的改进沉淀回共享资产。

AI 资产整理与治理
盘点项目、代码仓库和知识库中的 Prompt、Skill、Agent、模板与脚本，补充统一的元数据、Owner、Reviewer、版本、示例、范围、状态、反馈及下线说明，提升复用和可发现性。

前沿 AI 探索与 PoC
持续关注生成式 AI、Agent、RAG、MCP 和 LLM Evaluation 等前沿技术与实践，围绕真实研发需求开展小型 PoC，通过测试证据和用户反馈验证价值，并输出可复用的评估结论与指导。

文档、赋能与推广
编写快速入门、示例、FAQ、贡献指南和故障排查说明。将技术调研与 PoC 结果转化为技术分享、Workshop、Office Hour 和团队培训，并通过受控试点、反馈收集和持续迭代推动采用。

你将如何工作
研发团队负责人负责岗位方向、需求优先级和跨团队协调。
Function 团队负责人和领域专家提供流程、规则、样例、风险边界和验收标准。
你负责结构化输入，并交付原型、测试、文档、版本管理和试点支持。
影响产品质量、安全、合规或客户交付的输出，必须由相关领域专家审核批准。
以采用效果、证据、效率、质量和返工减少衡量成功，而不仅是 Agent 或 Skill 数量。

我们看重的工作方式
先来源，后工具 先理解问题和事实来源，再选择解决方法。
事实胜于假设 区分事实、假设和推断，不让 AI 补全未知规则。
证据胜于演示 展示失败、分析原因、验证修改并快速迭代。
复用胜于一次性 将成功尝试沉淀为可治理、可采用的资产。
与专家共创 尊重领域判断，同时提出清晰问题和改进建议。

你将获得
直接与研发团队负责人合作，参与 AI 应用优先级讨论。
与嵌入式软件、软件、硬件、结构、测试和系统架构等领域专家协作。
在真实研发流程中将想法从 PoC 推进到团队级复用。
系统提升 AI 应用工程、研发自动化、质量评估、知识治理和技术赋能能力。

任职要求

基本要求
本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程、电子信息、自动化、人工智能或相关专业。
应届毕业生或毕业 1 年以内。
具备良好的编程基础，能够使用 Python 或其他常用语言完成脚本、数据处理或简单 API 集成。
熟悉 Git 基本操作，理解版本、分支、Commit 和代码 Review。
实际使用过生成式 AI 完成课程项目、毕业设计、实习、开发、研究或自动化任务。
了解生成式 AI 与 Agent 领域的前沿技术和实践趋势，能够通过 PoC、测试证据和真实场景反馈验证方案，并将结论转化为团队分享或培训。
能够将模糊问题结构化为目标、输入、输出、步骤、约束、异常和验收条件。
具备良好的学习、沟通、技术写作和演示能力，愿意进入陌生工程领域。
重视测试、证据、人工审核和持续改进。
具有良好的英语读写能力，能够阅读技术资料并进行基本工作沟通。

优先考虑
有 GitHub Copilot、Claude Code、Codex 或其他 Agent 类编码工具使用经验。
有 Agent、RAG、Tool Calling、Workflow、MCP 或 LLM Evaluation 项目经验。
有 Python 自动化、测试框架、CI/CD、GitHub Actions、内部工具或 Developer Experience 经验。
接触过嵌入式开发、单片机、电子设计、硬件测试、机器人或软硬件集成。
能通过课程项目、毕业设计、竞赛、开源或实习展示代码、测试、文档和迭代过程。
做过供他人使用的工具或工作流，并有技术分享、Workshop、助教或培训经验。

招聘流程
通过初步筛选的候选人将参加基于研发场景的实践型 Hackathon 面试，重点考察需求理解、AI 工具应用、原型实现、测试验证、文档表达和现场迭代。候选人可在遵守数据和工具使用要求的前提下使用熟悉的 AI 辅助开发工具。

申请建议
请在简历或作品集中重点展示 1 至 3 个项目，说明所解决的问题、需求澄清方式、AI 与确定性代码的分工、测试方法、失败与迭代，以及成果是否被他人实际使用。若使用过 GitHub Copilot、Claude Code、Codex 或类似工具，请说明具体场景和产出。

合作对象：嵌入式软件、软件、硬件、结构、测试和系统架构团队
核心目标：将分散的 AI 实践转化为团队可复用的工程能力
成长路径：AI Asset Engineer → AI Workflow Engineer → AI Application Co-creation Lead
jobs.notes: 霍尼韦尔研发流程 AI 化方向（Prompt/Skill/Agent 资产沉淀与治理），应届或毕业 1 年内，entry 级。面试为 Hackathon 形式，偏研发赋能/DevEx 而非核心 Agent 产品研发。

jobs.title: ai agent 算法工程
jobs.description:
该职位来源于猎聘
岗位职责
1、Agent核心架构开发：负责Agent核心模块（任务规划、上下文管理、长期/短期记忆、工具调用）的设计与开发，构建高可靠、低延迟的智能体底层框架；
2、应用效果调优：主导RAG知识库建设与交互环境构建，精通Prompt工程与工作流编排，持续优化大模型在复杂业务场景下的生成效果、稳定性与可控性；
3、高性能工程链路建设：参与高并发、高可用分布式系统设计，优化Agent及RAG链路的系统性能，设计与落地缓存机制、消息队列、异步调度等核心组件，保障系统在海量请求下的稳定性；
4、安全与可观测性体系：建设完善的Agent安全防护机制（意图识别、输出过滤、权限控制、沙箱执行）及全链路评估可观测体系（成功率、延迟、Token消耗、业务转化率等）；
5、前沿技术探索：紧跟LLM及Agent前沿技术（如MCP协议、多智能体协同、长文本处理等），主导技术调研、复现与业务落地验证。
任职要求
1、2027届应届毕业生，本科及以上学历，计算机、软件、人工智能、数学等相关专业优先；
2、编程底子厚：熟练使用 Python/Java/Go/C++ 中至少一门语言，编程基础扎实，熟悉常用数据结构与算法，具备优秀的代码编写与工程实践能力；
3、AI工程能力：具备“AI原生”思维，熟练使用 Cursor、Claude Code 等AI编程工具提效；具备扎实的Prompt编写与调优能力，有结合多智能体、MCP、Function Calling等进行实际项目开发的经验；
4、框架与原理：深入理解 LLM/Agent/RAG 核心原理，熟悉 LangChain、LlamaIndex、AutoGen、Dify 等主流大模型应用开发框架；
5、极强的自驱力与好奇心，优秀的团队协作与沟通能力，能够拥抱快速迭代的业务节奏，对技术落地和业务结果具有双重责任感。
加分项
1、有大模型应用、智能体或 AI 开源项目核心贡献经验，或在相关技术社区有较高影响力；
2、具备扎实的计算机视觉（CV）与自然语言处理（NLP）算法基础，有大模型后训练（Post-training）经验，包括但不限于 SFT（监督微调）、RLHF/DPO 等对齐技术；
3、在ACM/ICPC、Kaggle、天池等算法或程序设计竞赛中获得优异成绩；
4、有AI核心业务线实习经历，或主导过完整的大模型应用从0到1落地经验；
5、熟悉分布式系统设计，有高并发、大流量系统后端开发及性能调优经验。
jobs.notes: 拼多多 Agent 核心架构校招岗（2027 届应届），覆盖任务规划/记忆/工具调用/RAG/安全与可观测全链路，技术栈全面且薪资高（30-60K/月）。明确面向应届，校招属性。JD 来自猎聘转载。

jobs.title: New Grad-Radio Embedded SW Developer-BJ
jobs.description:
Join our Team

About The Opportunity

At Ericsson, you will contribute to leading-edge 5G and future 6G radio products that help create connections that make the unimaginable possible. We are looking for a Software Developer to join Product Engineering Unit Radio in China, working with global teams to develop intelligent, high-performing and reliable radio solutions across the product lifecycle, with a focus on software engineering, AI/ML and advanced algorithms.

You will join a collaborative R&D environment in Beijing or Chengdu and work with experts across Ericsson sites in China, Sweden, Canada and other locations. Your work may cover areas such as Massive MIMO, remote radio, embedded software, cloud-native applications, radio resource management, signal processing, network automation and AI-enabled innovation.

What You Will Do

 Develop, integrate and verify software solutions for Ericsson radio products.
 Implement complex algorithms and system functions using C, C++, Java or Python.
 Contribute to software architecture design, optimization, quality, scalability and performance.
 Participate in requirement analysis, design, implementation, simulation, integration, verification and troubleshooting.
 Work on advanced algorithms for radio resource management, signal processing, predictive network operations and automation.
 Contribute to AI/ML work, including AI algorithms and models, AI model test platforms, and AI application frameworks covering data preprocessing, model loading and test result analysis.
 Collaborate with global teams, own technical deliveries, contribute to design reviews and improve engineering practices.

The Skills You Bring

 Master's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Automation, Electronic Engineering, Telecommunications or a related discipline.
 Strong development capability in C, C++, Java or Python.
 Experience in embedded software, application software, system architecture, object-oriented design or Linux/Unix environments.
 Knowledge of AI/ML algorithms and frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
 Experience with deep learning models such as CNN, DNN, RNN or reinforcement learning.
 Knowledge of telecommunications algorithms, radio resource management, signal processing, cloud-native software, automated testing or full-stack development.
 Familiarity with Linux/Unix tools such as GCC, GDB and Makefile, and inter-process or inter-thread communication.
 Experience in processor sub-systems, DDR, PCIe, driver or low-level software, Linux kernel, file systems, TCP/IP, Python, Shell or SQL is a plus.
 Analytical thinking, problem-solving ability, accountability, self-motivation, curiosity, courage to innovate and good English communication skills.

Why join Ericsson? At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world's toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won't be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

Primary country and city: China (CN) || Beijing

Req ID: 790359

jobs.title: Developer Technology Engineer - New College Graduate 2027
jobs.description:
Intelligent machines powered by AI computers that can learn, reason and interact with people are no longer science fiction. Today, a self-driving car can meander through a country road at night and find its way. An AI-powered robot can learn motor skills through trial and error. This is truly an extraordinary time - the era of AI has begun. Image recognition and speech recognition - GPU Deep Learning has provided the foundation for machines to learn, perceive, reason and solve problems. The GPU started out as the engine for simulating human creativity, conjuring up the amazing virtual worlds of video games and Hollywood films. Now, NVIDIA's GPU runs Deep Learning algorithms, simulating human intelligence, and acts as the brain of computers, robots and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Just as human creativity and intelligence are linked, computer graphics and artificial intelligence come together in our architecture. Two modes of the human brain, two modes of the GPU. This may explain why NVIDIA GPUs are used broadly for Deep Learning, and NVIDIA is increasingly known as "the AI computing company." Come join a team full of world-class computer scientists to work in its Compute Developer Technology team as an AI Developer Technology Engineer.

What You Will Be Doing
- Study and develop cutting-edge techniques in deep learning, graphs, machine learning, and data analytics, and perform in-depth analysis and optimization to ensure the best possible performance on current- and next-generation GPU architectures.
- Work directly with key customers to understand the current and future problems they are solving and provide the best AI solutions using GPUs.
- Collaborate closely with the architecture, research, libraries, tools, and system software teams at NVIDIA to influence the design of next-generation architectures, software platforms, and programming models.

What We Need To See
- A degree from a leading university in an engineering or computer science related discipline (BS; MS or PhD preferred)
- Strong knowledge of C/C++, software design, programming techniques, and AI algorithms
- Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and organization skills, with a logical approach to problem solving, time management, and task prioritization skills
- Some travel is required for conferences and for on-site visits with customers.

With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology industry's most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people on the planet working with us and our engineering teams are expanding fast. If you're a creative and autonomous computer scientist with a genuine passion for parallel computing, we want to hear from you.

#deeplearning, JR2023566
jobs.notes: 英伟达 Compute Developer Technology 团队 2027 新毕业生 AI Developer Technology Engineer：深度学习/图机器学习的 GPU 性能分析与优化，直接服务大客户并影响下一代 GPU 架构设计，属于 AI 基础设施与深度学习方向（非 Agent 应用层）。New College Graduate 岗，判校招。亮点是 NVIDIA 平台 + AI/DL 深度优化路径；无薪资信息。

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Client - Wild Rift
jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

Riot engineers bring deep knowledge of specific technical areas but also value the opportunity to work in a variety of broader domains. We work with both new and current technology, creating innovative solutions to solve complex, large-scale challenges and deliver player value. As a Principal Software Engineer, you’ll lead the development of key features and model high standards of engineering excellence.

As a Principal Software Engineer on Wild Rift, you will leverage your deep technical expertise and vision to define the direction of the client across core architecture, rendering, performance, and device scalability, enhancing the player experience across the game. You will work closely with the leadership team to set the client architecture vision, multi-year roadmap, engineering standards, and architectural guardrails, while aligning stakeholders across Riot and co-development partners to turn that direction into shipped outcomes. Joining a passionate and driven team, you will help shape the premier mobile League of Legends experience enjoyed by millions of players worldwide, delivering high-impact results and memorable moments that last a lifetime.

Responsibilities


Define the client technical strategy, architecture, and multi-year roadmap, and set the engineering standards and architectural guardrails the client team builds to.
Own the client’s non-functional quality bar, including frame time, memory, startup time, crash rate, thermal behavior, and device-tier quality across a fragmented mobile hardware matrix.
Lead the architecture of Unity client systems and frameworks, including gameplay-facing systems, UI, content/runtime boundaries, asset management, and rendering/performance foundations.
Drive rendering and graphics direction, including quality tiers, visual budgets, shader and asset constraints, and tooling needed to scale from flagship to low-spec devices.
Lead the toughest cross-cutting client problems hands-on, from investigation and technical design through rollout and post-launch validation.
Establish the profiling, observability, and automated quality/performance gates needed to measure, protect, and continuously improve the client.
Establish and maintain the Unity engine optimization pipeline, with the ability to diagnose and resolve underlying performance overhead caused by engine-level issues. 
Raise engineering quality through RFCs, design reviews, code reviews, technical standards, and mentorship across the client organization.
Partner closely with gameplay, tech art, design, QA, release, platform, and co-development teams to align execution and raise the technical bar across the full client surface.


Required Qualifications


BS in Computer Science, computer engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
4+ years as a tech lead or principal engineer setting technical direction for a mobile game client.
8+ years deep experience building and shipping large-scale Unity-based mobile game clients (iOS and Android), or equivalent experience extending and operating a commercial game engine at the runtime, rendering, or client architecture layer.
Strong modern C# and a track record of architecting large, live client codebases.
Proven, measurable quality and performance wins on constrained, low-spec hardware across a wide device matrix.
Hands-on experience profiling and optimizing CPU, GPU, and memory behavior using industry-standard tooling.
Experience leading technical design reviews, setting engineering standards, and driving strategy across teams.

Shader authoring and PBR pipeline experience, or close technical art collaboration on a high-quality art style.
Experience supporting emerging markets and fragmented Android hardware.
Familiarity with applying machine learning to rendering or asset pipelines.

Edge NPU Architect

Location

Beijing/Shanghai China

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated NPU Architect to lead the development of next-generation high-performance, low-power Neural Processing Unit (NPU) architectures for edge AI applications.

The ideal candidate will play a key role in building scalable AI acceleration solutions based on open-source NPU technologies, enabling efficient execution of small and medium-sized LLMs (Large Language Models) on resource-constrained edge devices.

Optimize NPU architecture for:
Transformer inference
KV cache handling
Attention acceleration
Memory bandwidth efficiency
Sparse computation
Quantized AI models (INT8/INT4/FP8)

Compiler
Runtime
Kernel libraries

Performance profiling and debugging infrastructure

Analyze workload bottlenecks and optimize system-level power/performance/area (PPA)
Work closely with system architects to define heterogeneous computing architectures integrating CPU, NPU, memory, and interconnect subsystems
Contribute to future AI architecture roadmap and technology strategy

Qualifications

Required

MS or PhD in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
More than 3 years strong experience in AI accelerator, NPU, GPU, DSP, or heterogeneous compute architecture
Deep understanding of:
Transformer architectures
LLM inference
Neural network acceleration
Memory hierarchy optimization
Dataflow architecture
Experience with AI model optimization techniques including:
Quantization
Pruning
Sparsity
Operator fusion
Solid understanding of hardware/software co-design methodologies
Familiarity with compiler and runtime stacks for AI acceleration
Experience with RTL architecture and performance modeling

Experience with high-performance RISC-V CPU architecture or SoC design
Experience with vector processors, SIMD/SIMT architectures, or AI instruction extensions
Familiarity with MLIR, TVM, ONNX, LLVM, or related AI compiler frameworks
Experience enabling LLMs on edge or embedded AI platforms
Experience with low-power SoC architecture and mobile/edge AI optimization
Familiarity with chiplet, NoC, or advanced memory architectures
Experience with open-source AI acceleration ecosystems

What We’re Looking For

Passion for AI computing and next-generation semiconductor technologies
Strong system-level thinking and architectural vision

Hands-on mindset with strong execution capability
Self-driven and collaborative team player

Why Join Us

You will have the opportunity to shape the future of edge AI computing by building cutting-edge AI acceleration technologies that enable real-world deployment of LLMs and generative AI on power-constrained devices.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Distributed Query Engines - Analytics and Data Intelligence
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people.

Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

We're looking for outstanding engineers and scientists to join NVIDIA’s Analytics and Data Intelligence (ADI) team. This is an outstanding chance to employ your parallel programming skills to accelerate open-source software libraries for GPU data processing. You will have the opportunity to support high-performance structured data processing on hardware from single workstations to rack-scale GPU supercomputers. You will contribute significantly to building the computational core for dataframe and database accelerators by developing highly optimized C++ and CUDA libraries. These libraries use the parallel power of GPUs to speed up tasks such as data loading, parsing, joins, aggregations, and more. Bring your creativity and problem-solving skills to our open-source software suite, and become our next major contributor!

What You’ll Be Doing

Creating and improving C++ and CUDA libraries for high-performance data processing, including end-to-end data paths from storage to GPU compute engines
Accelerating operations such as data loading, parsing, joins, aggregations, as well as I/O, data movement, memory management, and concurrency optimization
Collaborating with the Sales/DevRel team to support partner integration, PoCs, performance tuning, and production issue resolution with partners in China
Implementing highly performant solutions for warehouse and Lakehouse workloads across compute, networking, and distributed storage
Working with a globally distributed and highly technical team to drive software initiatives from architecture to delivery
Applying deep experience with data analytics and ETL ecosystems to optimize GPU-accelerated data processing pipelines

What We Need To See

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience in practice
15+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including substantial work in systems software, distributed data platforms, storage, databases, or accelerated computing
Proven proficiency in C++ and CUDA programming
Strong knowledge of data processing, data analytics, and storage environments
Deep expertise in at least one of the following: distributed storage, database/query engine internals, high-performance I/O, accelerated computing, or large-scale data platforms
Experience driving efficient I/O and data-movement paths across distributed/object storage, table formats (e.g., Iceberg, Parquet), Lakehouse architectures, and analytical engines
Familiarity with, or contributions to, SiriusDB, GPU-accelerated query engines, or related projects

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Familiarity with RAPIDS cuDF
Familiarity with S3, Parquet, and Iceberg
Experience with cross-stack performance optimization spanning storage, networking, and CPU/GPU compute
Proven ability to diagnose and resolve production issues in complex distributed systems
Ability to both define technical direction and personally implement critical components while driving cross-team delivery

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

jobs.title: Principal Architect, AI Inference Networking - NIXL and Dynamo
jobs.location_raw: 中国 广东省 深圳
jobs.description:
Inference has become a networking problem. With disaggregated serving, where prefill runs on one set of GPUs, decode on another, and KV cache streams between them, performance depends on how fast you can move tensors between GPUs, across nodes, and in and out of storage. Performance is only half of it. These deployments are elastic, so the data path needs dynamic APIs that let workers join and leave, connections form and tear down, and transfers reroute at runtime without stalling the pipeline. NIXL, NVIDIA's open source Inference Xfer Library, is the layer that solves this, and it sits underneath NVIDIA Dynamo and a growing list of inference engines.

China is where some of the world's most demanding inference deployments are being built. We are hiring a senior architect to work directly with the platform teams building them, understanding what breaks at scale and turning that into upstream code and roadmap. You will work daily with core NIXL and Dynamo engineers in Israel and the US.

What You'll Be Doing

Drive NIXL adoption in China, from the first architecture conversation through prototype and benchmark to production rollout and upstream contribution.
Profile customer inference stacks and fix what's costing throughput and TTFT: KV cache movement, memory registration, transfer scheduling.
Write NIXL backends and plugins, extend Dynamo integrations, and contribute optimizations upstream to NIXL and GPUDirect class data paths.
Help define the APIs that make the data path dynamic, supporting elastic scaling, worker churn and runtime rerouting in production inference clusters.
Bring the region's requirements into NVIDIA's roadmap with enough technical authority to change it.
Grow the local community around NIXL through talks, benchmarks and reference architectures.

What We Need To See

M.Sc. or Ph.D. in CS/EE/CE, or equivalent depth earned in industry.
12+ years building or optimizing large scale distributed systems: AI inference or training infrastructure, communication libraries, high performance networking, or HPC runtimes.
Strong systems programming in C++ and Python, with performance critical code shipped.
Hands on experience with RDMA networking (InfiniBand or RoCE) and GPU memory movement.
Working knowledge of modern LLM serving, including prefill/decode disaggregation, KV cache management, tensor and pipeline parallelism, and at least one serving stack (Dynamo, TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, SGLang, Triton).
Strong communication skills, with the technical credibility to be taken seriously by customer engineering teams and by NVIDIA's core library maintainers.
Fluent Mandarin and professional English, and comfortable working across China, Israel and US time zones.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Open source contributions to NIXL, Dynamo, NCCL, vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM or Mooncake. We will read your commits.
Inference at genuine scale: thousands of GPUs, multi tenant clusters, strict SLOs.
CUDA, and comfort reading kernel and driver level code when the answer is down there.
A community you've built: a project people adopted, a talk people still cite.

You will help shape how NIXL is adopted across China, working alongside the engineers who design the transport layer itself. The work is public, and disaggregated inference is being defined right now.
jobs.notes: 英伟达 NVIDIA，深圳 Principal Architect（AI 推理网络 NIXL 与 Dynamo），负责 disaggregated LLM serving 数据通路（KV cache 传输、RDMA/InfiniBand/RoCE、GPU 内存搬移）在中国区落地与上游开源贡献。技术栈 C++/Python + RDMA + LLM serving 栈（Dynamo/TensorRT-LLM/vLLM/SGLang/Triton）。senior 依据为 Principal Architect 头衔+12年+ 分布式系统。强 AI/大模型核心基础设施，最值得关注岗位之一。亮点是英伟达核心推理网络、上游开源贡献，风险是 12年+ 系统级门槛极高、跨时区。

Mentor engineers and drive improvements in software quality, system performance and development efficiency.

jobs.title: Cloud Service - Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about leading enterprise-scale data architecture initiatives that enable analytics, AI, and data-driven decision-making?

Do you enjoy shaping long-term data platform strategies while mentoring teams and influencing business outcomes?

SoftwareOne is a global leader in cloud and software services. We’re hiring a Senior Data Architect to lead the design and evolution of enterprise data platforms, enabling scalable analytics and AI solutions for our customers.

The Role
Lead the design and evolution of enterprise data architectures, covering data ingestion, storage, processing, governance, and consumption.
Define and drive data platform strategies using modern cloud and analytics technologies (e.g., Azure, Databricks, Synapse, Snowflake).
Establish and enforce data architecture standards, governance frameworks, and best practices for security, quality, and scalability.
Translate complex business requirements into robust data architecture solutions that support analytics, BI, and AI use cases.
Provide technical leadership across projects, including architecture reviews, solution validation, and risk assessment.
Mentor and guide data engineers and architects, contributing to capability building and reusable architectural assets.
Job Requirements
Proven experience leading data architecture design for enterprise environments and large-scale data platforms.
Strong expertise in cloud data ecosystems, including data lakes, data warehouses, and real-time or batch processing architectures.
Solid knowledge of data modeling, data governance, data quality, and data security, with hands-on implementation experience.
Proficiency in one or more programming or query languages (e.g., Python, SQL, Scala) used in data engineering workflows.
Experience integrating data platforms with AI/ML and advanced analytics scenarios.
Exposure to multi-cloud or hybrid data architectures.
Background in consulting or working with multinational/global teams.
Company description

SoftwareOne and Crayon have come together to form a global, AI-powered software and cloud solutions provider with a bold vision for the future. With a footprint in over 70 countries and a diverse team of 13,000+ professionals, we offer unparalleled opportunities for talent to grow, make an impact, and shape the future of technology. At the heart of our business is our people. We empower our teams to work across borders, innovate fearlessly, and continuously develop their skills through world-class learning and development programs. Whether you're passionate about cloud, software, data, AI, or building meaningful client relationships, you’ll find a place to thrive here. Join us and be part of a purpose-driven culture where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your career can go global.
jobs.notes: SoftwareOne 高级数据架构师（页面标题为 Cloud Service - Solution Architect），方向为企业数据平台架构：数据湖/数仓、治理、Azure/Databricks/Synapse/Snowflake，技术栈 Python/SQL/Scala。要求领导企业级数据架构设计并指导团队，判为 architect。AI 相关：JD 明确要支撑 analytics 与 AI/ML 用例、数据平台与 AI 集成，但属数据底座而非大模型/Agent 开发。咨询/服务商性质，可能偏客户项目交付。

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
You will be the primary technical partner for automotive OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, and autonomous-driving technology companies integrating TomTom ADAS maps, services, and SDKs. You will translate customer use cases into scalable solution architectures, lead technical discovery and proof-of-concept delivery, and connect Greater China customer requirements with global product and engineering teams.

What You'll Do

Own the end-to-end technical solution for ADAS map and SDK opportunities, from discovery and architecture through PoC, integration, validation, production readiness, and post-launch evolution.
Lead customer workshops to understand ADAS and automated-driving use cases, vehicle architecture, target markets, safety requirements, software platforms, and integration constraints.
Design solution architectures combining ADAS road and lane models, map streaming, dynamic services, eHorizon , map matching, route projection, and ADASIS-based data exchange.
Guide OEM and Tier-1 engineering teams in integrating map data and SDK components into IVI, ADAS domain controllers, middleware, and cloud-to-vehicle platforms.
Build and present reference architectures, interface designs, integration plans, data flows, trade-off analyses, and technical proposals for customer decision makers.
Lead technical PoCs and demonstrations, define acceptance criteria, identify dependencies and risks, and coordinate delivery across product, map, SDK, validation, sales, and program teams.
Troubleshoot complex integration issues across map data, APIs, SDKs, embedded platforms, networking, positioning, routing, and sensor/ perception interfaces.
Represent the voice of Greater China customers to product teams, converting market feedback and technical gaps into clear product requirements and roadmap recommendations.
Create reusable integration assets, including sample code, architecture patterns, technical documentation, FAQs, and bilingual customer enablement material.
Mentor support engineers and sales teams, improving technical readiness, solution consistency, and customer self-sufficiency.

What You'll Need

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science , Software Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Robotics, Geomatics, or a related discipline.
Typically 7+ years of relevant experience, including 3+ years in automotive ADAS, autonomous driving, digital maps, navigation, or in-vehicle software architecture.
Strong understanding of ADAS or automated-driving system architecture, including localization, planning, perception interfaces, eHorizon , map-aided driving functions, and vehicle-domain integration.
Hands-on knowledge of digital map concepts such as road topology, lane geometry, connectivity, speed restrictions, curvature, gradient, traffic signs, road objects, and dynamic road conditions.
Experience with automotive map or exchange standards and formats such as NDS, NDS.Live , ADASIS v2/v3, OGP, PBF, OpenLR , or equivalent proprietary formats.
Strong software engineering skills in C++ and/or Java/Kotlin; working knowledge of Python for tooling, data inspection, or automation.
Experience integrating or supporting software on Linux, QNX, Android Automotive, AUTOSAR Adaptive, ROS 2, or comparable embedded automotive platforms.
Ability to diagnose distributed-system and embedded integration issues using logs, traces, API analysis, network tools, and structured root-cause methods.
Excellent customer-facing communication, architecture storytelling, technical writing, and stakeholder-influencing skills.
Fluent Chinese and English, with the ability to create and deliver technical content in both languages; willingness to travel for customer workshops and critical milestones.
Based in Shanghai or Beijing.

What's Nice To Have

Experience at a digital map, navigation, location-platform, ADAS, autonomous-driving algorithm, automotive middleware, or intelligent-vehicle company.
Track record supporting China OEMs, AD Tier-1 suppliers, or autonomous-driving companies from PoC to SOP.
Experience with automotive SoCs and compute platforms such as Qualcomm Snapdragon Ride, NVIDIA DRIVE, Mobileye EyeQ , Horizon Robotics Journey, or Black Sesame.
Knowledge of functional-safety and safety-of-the- intended-functionality practices, including ISO 26262 and SOTIF, plus awareness of ISA or Euro NCAP use cases.
Familiarity with map-data visualization, GIS tools, simulation environments, vehicle testing, or sensor-derived map validation.

What We Offer

A competitive compensation package, of course.

Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning.

Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities.

Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.

Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance.

Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping.

Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday.

Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world.

Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom!

Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location.

Meet your team

We’re TomTom Automotive. On our team, your work – together with our 30+ years of experience in delivering connected navigation software, traffic information and highly accurate digital maps – will accelerate the future of driving. Car manufacturers trust us to provide the modular components they need to create competitive, tailor-made infotainment systems, and the mapping technology that are enabling self-driving cars to see beyond their sensors.

At TomTom...

You’ll help people find their way in the world. In 2004, TomTom revolutionized how the world moves with the introduction of the first portable navigation device. Now, we intend to do it again by engineering the first-ever real-time map, the smartest and most useful map on the planet.

Work with a team of 3,300+ unique, curious and passionate problem-solvers. Together, we’ll open up a world of possibilities for car manufacturers, enterprises and developers to help people understand and get closer to the world around them.

After you apply

Our recruitment team will work hard to give you a meaningful experience throughout your journey with us, no matter the outcome. Your application will be screened closely and you can rest assured that all follow-up actions will be thorough, from assessments and interviews all the way through onboarding. To find out more about our application process, check out our hiring FAQs .

TomTom is an equal opportunity employer

TomTom is where you can find your place in the world. Every day we welcome, nurture and celebrate differences. Why? Because your uniqueness is what makes you, you. No matter your culture or background, you’ll find your impact at TomTom. Research also shows that sometimes women and underrepresented communities can be hesitant to apply for positions unless they believe they meet 100% of the criteria. If you can relate to this, please know that we’d love to hear from you.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
jobs.notes: TomTom 大中华区 ADAS 地图/SDK 解决方案架构师，面向车企与 Tier-1 做技术售前与集成，技术栈 C++/Java/Kotlin、Python，涉及 NDS.Live、ADASIS、eHorizon 等地图标准与 QNX/Android Automotive/AUTOSAR 平台。7+ 年经验且为 Solution Architect 头衔，判为 architect。不涉及大模型/Agent，仅服务自动驾驶地图数据链路。混合办公（每周 2 天到岗），需中英双语与出差。

jobs.title: Senior Networking Solutions Architect - Spectrum-X
jobs.location_raw: 中国 广东省 深圳
jobs.description:
NVIDIA Networking Solutions Architects team is looking for a Networking Solutions Architect to join the team and support the Spectrum-X networking platform, which is a revolutionary solution for building multi-tenant, hyperscale AI clouds with Ethernet. This role focuses on customers who build their own switch software stacks — running SONiC or in-house network operating systems on Spectrum-based whitebox switches, integrating through SAI, and developing directly against the NVIDIA Spectrum SDK. As a Networking Solutions Architect you will have a real impact on the business, while working closely with our customers, marketing and R&D teams.

What You’ll Be Doing

Work as customer technical specialist to address customer requirements and technical challenges during the pre-sales activities of the Spectrum-X solution, with emphasis on whitebox switches.
Guide customers bringing up SONiC or their own NOS on NVIDIA Spectrum whitebox platforms — platform bring-up, feature enablement and debuggability.
Serve as the technical authority on the SAI layer and the NVIDIA Spectrum SDK: advise on API usage, feature mapping, ASIC capabilities and limitations, and help customers implement new features on top of them.
Debug complex networking and software issues across the full stack — customer NOS, SAI, SDK — and provide solutions to customers.
Work closely with our R&D teams to solve customer issues and drive fixes upstream where relevant.
Participate in building the SW products roadmap by providing customer product requirements and feedback to engineering and marketing teams.

What We Need To See

6+ years' experience in networking software development with knowledge of Linux kernel, Ethernet and IP protocols.
B.Sc or equivalent experience, Masters or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related technical field.
Hands-on experience with switch software stacks — SONiC, another open/whitebox NOS, or an in-house switch operating system.
Experience with Ethernet Switches/Routers and network protocols including L2–L4 protocols.
Development or scripting ability in C/C++ and/or Python for debugging, integration and tooling.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to details.
Strong English communication and presentation skills.
Strong interpersonal skills and an ability to work directly with customers.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Working knowledge of switch ASIC programming models and abstraction layers such as SAI, or equivalent vendor switch SDKs.
Cloud infrastructure understanding
Knowledge of RDMA and RoCE
Knowledge of AI workflows

为什么需要这个角色：资产系统连接交易、借贷、理财等多个核心业务，每一次资金变化都要求结果准确、过程可追踪、异常可恢复。你将带领团队完成核心资产系统建设，同时持续深入架构设计和关键代码。入职后第一个 12 个月：夯实资金处理和对账体系，提升复杂异常及高负载场景下的系统可靠性，建立更高的团队工程和交付标准。

你会做什么：带领后端研发团队完成核心资产系统建设（任务拆解、方案评审到生产交付闭环），亲自承担关键架构设计和核心代码。梳理账户、资金划转、交易记录及对账等核心领域职责边界。建设可靠的资金处理机制，解决重试、部分失败和跨系统结果不确定等复杂场景。提升资产查询和资金处理系统的性能与稳定性（容量评估、线上问题定位、根因治理）。主导复杂系统演进和数据迁移，设计可验证、可控制、可恢复的变更方案。推动 AI 辅助研发在代码分析、测试、排障和内部工具建设中的实际应用，同时确保资金规则和关键结果经过独立验证。

你需要具备（Non-negotiables）：真正带领过研发团队，同时保持较强 Hands-on 能力（关键技术决策、核心代码、Code Review、交付质量）。能使用 Java 或 Go 设计复杂的高并发生产系统，围绕数据一致性、并发控制、性能和异常恢复做技术判断。真正负责过资金类或其他高正确性要求的核心系统（交易状态、幂等、对账、跨系统结果不确定）。能主导涉及多个服务和数据边界的复杂系统演进，在重构、迁移和生产变更中保障正确性、业务连续性和可恢复性。

Bonus：账户、支付、账务、清结算或交易等核心资金系统研发经验；主导过异常资金治理、大规模资产数据迁移或关键生产系统重构；已将 AI 辅助开发融入研发流程并形成可验证的工程实践。

jobs.title: Lead Robotics Software Engineer

jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Lead Robotics Software Engineer to develop and deliver intelligent robotic behaviours for autonomous consumer robotics products.

You will work across software, hardware, perception, and systems engineering disciplines to solve real-world robotics challenges and deliver reliable product features. This role requires strong problem-solving ability, system engineering thinking, and hands-on software development experience to design, implement, debug, and optimize robotics capabilities that perform reliably in customer environments. Experience working with ODM/JDM development partners is an advantage.

Key Responsibilities

Robotics Software Development
Design, develop, and maintain robotics software using modern C++.
Develop autonomous robot behaviours for navigation, obstacle avoidance, task execution, area coverage, and recovery.
Implement solutions involving localization, planning, control, and sensor integration.
Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, validation, and maintenance.
Conduct code reviews and contribute to software quality, reliability, and maintainability improvements.

System Engineering & Problem Solving
Investigate and resolve complex system-level issues involving software, hardware, sensors, and algorithms.
Perform root-cause analysis through debugging, data analysis, testing, and validation.
Drive reliability, robustness, and performance improvements across robotics subsystems.
Support field issue investigations and product validation activities.
Contribute to engineering best practices, software architecture discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Robotics Behaviours & Autonomy
Develop and enhance robot behaviours and autonomy frameworks.
Contribute to Behaviour Trees, State Machines, or similar decision-making systems.
Work closely with perception, controls, and product teams to improve robot performance and user experience.
Support navigation, localization, SLAM, sensor fusion, and robot control development activities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
Collaborate with hardware, perception, QA, test, and product teams throughout product development.
Support software integration, system validation, and production readiness activities.
Work with ODM/JDM partners and external suppliers to support development, integration, and issue resolution.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Skills
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.
5+ years of experience in robotics, autonomous systems, embedded software, or related software engineering domains.
Strong programming skills in C++ and working proficiency in Python.
Experience with: Linux development and debugging; Multi-threaded and concurrent software development; Object-oriented design and software architecture; Software performance optimization; Git-based development workflows.
Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis skills.

Robotics Experience (one or more)
Robotics software development; Mobile robots or autonomous systems; Navigation and localization; SLAM and sensor fusion; Robot control systems; Behaviour Trees or State Machines; ROS / ROS2.

System Engineering
Strong system engineering mindset with the ability to analyse and solve complex cross-functional problems.
Experience delivering software features from concept through product deployment.
Experience working with ODM/JDM partners or external development teams is preferred.

Perception AI & Communication
Basic understanding of robotics perception fundamentals, including computer vision, OpenCV, camera/LiDAR/IMU sensors, and machine learning concepts related to perception, object detection, classification, and sensor data processing.
Strong English reading and writing skills; basic spoken English.

Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds.

You desire to create high quality, robust code to solve diverse real-world problems. You must be fluent in C++ and be comfortable in the whole product life cycle, including design, implementation, deployment, testing and debugging of firmware and application code.

You'll collaborate with architects, software, firmware and hardware engineers, manufacturing test engineers, and specialist engineering to help solve the wide and exciting range of AI-powered devices' challenges posed by the ever-expanding Dyson product portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Responsible for the design, development and deployment of software build/test/release pipeline for continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) of embedded system products.
Design and development of the firmware and software platforms to enable behaviours/application engineers to implement features on AI-enabled products and facilitate mass production.
Manage the entire life cycle of multiple related complex modules and systems, including image build/test/release, hardware abstraction layer discussion, manufacturing test/verification methodology, documentation, design, coding, testing, maintenance, and result tracking.
Good product sense and keen focus on product performance and test automation efficiency.
Act as subject matter expert (SME) in specific domain, disseminating knowledge, guiding and mentor engineers in methodology, best practice and standards.

In-depth participation in cross-teams product design discussions.

Key Skills / Experience

A bachelor's degree or higher in Robotics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Robotics Engineering or similar.
8+ years of work experience in embedded system development, including board bring up and embedded Linux kernel/driver porting for system integration.
Experience in fulfilling continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline setup.
Excellent knowledge and hands-on experience in Linux toolchains, Yocto build system, version control tool (git), configuration, etc.
Experience in configuration and use of sensor devices over I2C, SPI, UART with DMA.
Experience in sensors/camera/BT/Wifi modules integration and calibration.
Experience in automated testing and manufacturing test process is highly desired.
Excellent object-oriented programming capability; preferably able to write high performance product quality code with C++.
Familiar with STL, boost C++ libraries, design patterns.
Strong proficiency in multithreading programming and synchronisation mechanisms.
Proficient in scripting languages, such as Python and Bash.
Experience in Agile practices is a plus.
Fluent in spoken and written English.

jobs.title: Lead Server Engineer
jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate, and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

EA SPORTS FC Mobile Shanghai is a global team devoted to developing and operating a high-quality mobile football game experience. Our quest for creativity, respect for autonomy, and emphasis on collaboration are at the heart of our team culture, which empowers us to create high-quality games and experiences worldwide.

As a team, we are passionate, innovative, and open to possibilities. We learn from past experiences and strive for progress. We value team synergy and believe a relaxed working environment can yield better results. That's why we promote and support maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

As a Lead Engineer, you will play a critical role in the system architecture design process. You will take ownership of the technical design and implementation of foundational modules and critical services, while leading a team of engineers. You will report directly to Server Architecture Lead.

Responsibilities


Develop and maintain server-side code and ensure robustness.
Responsible for the technical design of architecture/framework, such as underlying services or modules, service encapsulation/framework/DB storage/data caching etc., in the feature development process.
Oversee the server-side tasks and develop tools to ensure the healthy operation of the game server.
Manage projects/tasks of the team related to the server architecture/framework implementation, including planning, estimation, breakdown, coordination, and demonstrate commitment to delivery.
Troubleshoot complex server related technical issues to minimize the occurrence of critical issues and reduce downtime and service interruptions.
Collaborate with team members, stakeholders, operations teams and external partners.
Demonstrate impact through dialog, teamwork, and providing guidance to junior team members.
Lead and inspire a team of software engineers, fostering a collaborative and high performing work environment
Mentor and train team members, promoting skill development and career growth


Qualifications


At least 8 years' experience in server development including 3+ years of team management experience.
Proficiency in at least one of Java/C++/Go
Knowledge of common networking protocols (e.g. TCP, UDP, HTTP and WebSocket)
Knowledge of relational databases (e.g. MySQL or Postgres), NoSQL databases (e.g. MongoDB), and in-memory data structure store (e.g. Redis)
Knowledge of container and serverless technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
Experience in development for the Linux platform
Experience in version control software such as Git and Perforce
Excellent debugging capabilities
Experience in at least one shipped large online game development
Nice to be familiar with the Agile/Scrum methodology
Proficient in reading and writing English documents


About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

jobs.title: Engineering Lead (Quanta AI Platform, China)
jobs.location_raw: 中国 北京市 北京市
jobs.description:
该职位来源于猎聘。The Opportunity: Bringing Quanta to China. China's data-residency requirements mean large parts of the platform have to be independently rebuilt to run in-country: user data, uploaded documents, and query handling all need to stay in China, and some AWS and agent infrastructure isn't available there. You'll be the founding member of a new China-based engineering team: architecting and building the in-country version of Quanta, then running it and growing the team. A 0-to-1 build on top of an already-proven product with hard technical constraints and long-term ownership.

What You'll Do: Architect and build a China-resident version of Quanta's user data platform, modernizing the 10+ year old access model behind a new API layer. Get Quanta's AI agents running in China without Agent Core by adapting or forking the agent orchestration layer to a China-compatible alternative. Rebuild document upload, storage, and search/vector-index systems to run independently inside China. Design the data boundary for China-based search and agents while keeping IDC's proprietary research and verbatim user queries separated. Recruit, hire, and lead the long-term China engineering team as its first member. Own the system ongoing after launch.

What You Bring: 8+ years full-stack or backend experience including architecture ownership under real infrastructure and regulatory constraints. Direct experience building/operating systems inside China's infrastructure/data-residency environment. API design and legacy system migration. Working knowledge of search/vector-index systems and LLM agent orchestration frameworks. Experience leading or mentoring engineers. Fluency in Mandarin and English. Comfort with autonomy and ambiguity.

Preferred: China-specific cloud providers (Alibaba/Tencent/Huawei Cloud); 0-to-1 or greenfield build in regulated or data-sovereignty-constrained markets; distributed team across US/EU/China time zones; familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol).

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Man Group

Man Group is a global alternative investment management firm focused on pursuing outperformance for sophisticated clients via our Systematic, Discretionary and Solutions offerings. Powered by talent and advanced technology, our single and multi-manager investment strategies are underpinned by deep research and span public and private markets, across all major asset classes, with a significant focus on alternatives. Man Group takes a partnership approach to working with clients, establishing deep connections and creating tailored solutions to meet their investment goals and those of the millions of retirees and savers they represent.

Headquartered in London, we manage $228.7 billion* and operate across multiple offices globally. Man Group plc is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker EMG.LN and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index. Further information can be found at www.man.com

At Man Group, we respect your privacy and we are committed to protecting and safeguarding your Personal Data. We have developed policies and processes which are designed to provide for the security and integrity of your Personal Data. We are committed to Processing your Personal Data fairly and lawfully, and being open and transparent about such Processing. For further information on how we process your data, please see the privacy notice for applicants here


 As at 31 March 2026


The Role

As an Engineering Lead in the Front-office Engineering organization at Man Systematic, you will work closely with Quantitative Researchers and Portfolio Managers. Your challenges will be varied and may include onboarding new datasets, implementing new trading signals, developing portfolio optimization tools, building data visualization frameworks, enhancing our research platform, and performance tuning existing code using efficient numerical algorithms and cluster-computing solutions. As the local lead for our growing Front-office Engineering team in China, you will also be instrumental in hiring, onboarding, and shaping the team from the ground up.

Our Technology

Our systems are almost all running on Linux and most of our code is in Python, with the full scientific stack: NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, statsmodels, and scikit-learn to name a few of the libraries we use extensively. We implement the systems that require the highest data throughput in Java. For storage, we rely heavily on MongoDB and MS SQL.

We use Control-M and Airflow for workflow management, Kafka for data pipelines, Bitbucket for source control, Jenkins for continuous integration, Grafana + Prometheus for metrics collection, ELK for log shipping and monitoring, Docker for containerisation, OpenStack for our private cloud, Ansible for architecture automation, and Slack for internal communication. Our technology list is never static: we constantly evaluate new tools and libraries.

Technology And Business Skills

We strive to hire only the brightest, best and most highly skilled, passionate technologists.

Key Competencies

Required


5+ years of professional experience in software engineering, preferably with a focus on quantitative applications
Experience as a technical lead or people manager, encompassing both team development (hiring, building teams, and mentoring junior engineers) and project management (driving technical delivery)
Expert knowledge of Python and Pandas and proficiency with related scientific libraries including NumPy, SciPy, statsmodels, and scikit-learn
Experience developing mission-critical production systems, with knowledge of best practices for testing, monitoring, and deployment
Proficient on Linux platforms and strong understanding of Git
Working knowledge of one or more relevant database technologies, such as MS SQL, Postgres, or MongoDB
Demonstrated experience working with large data sets, both structured and unstructured


Advantageous


Experience in quantitative software development within a front-office setting, such as at a hedge fund, proprietary trading firm, or investment bank
Experience building web applications using modern frameworks like React
Proficient with distributed computing technologies such as Spark, Dask, Kubernetes, Redis
Knowledge of modern data engineering practices including data pipeline & ETL tools, distributed storage & processing and data warehousing
Strong understanding of financial markets and instruments
Experience working with financial market data
Relevant mathematical knowledge e.g., statistics, time-series analysis


Personal Attributes


Strong academic record and a degree with high mathematical and computing content e.g., Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or Physics
Intellectually robust with a keenly analytic approach to problem solving
Self-organised with the ability to effectively manage time across multiple projects and with competing business demands and priorities
Focused on delivering value to the business with relentless efforts to improve process
Strong interpersonal skills: able to establish and maintain a close working relationship with quantitative researchers, portfolio managers, traders and senior business people alike
Confident communicator: able to argue a point concisely and deal positively with conflicting views


Working Here

Man Systematic has a small company, no-attitude feel. It is flat structured, open, transparent and collaborative, and you will have plenty of opportunity to grow and have enormous impact on what we do. We are actively engaged with the broader technology community.


We regularly talk at leading industry conferences across the globe
We host and sponsor Boston meetups and London’s PyData and Machine Learning Meetups
We open-source some of our technology, including our ultra-high-performance DataFrame database, ArcticDB. See https://github.com/man-group for a full list and more information.


We believe that agile working allows us to deliver the best business outcomes for our clients and investors as well as having a positive impact on work-life balance and the wellbeing of our staff. We are simultaneously committed to “levelling the playing field” and believe that agile working promotes inclusivity across teams, regions and business units. In general, Technology roles are expected to be in the office for 3-4 days a week. However, the specifics can vary based on the role, team, and individual circumstances, and are ultimately subject to the manager’s discretion.

We offer competitive compensation, a generous holiday allowance, various health and other flexible benefits. We are also committed to continuous learning and development via coaching, mentoring, regular conference attendance and sponsoring academic and professional qualifications.

Inclusion, Work-Life Balance And Benefits At Man Group

You'll thrive in our working environment that champions equality of opportunity. Your unique perspective will contribute to our success, joining a workplace where inclusion is fundamental and deeply embedded in our culture and values. Through our external and internal initiatives, partnerships and programmes, you'll find opportunities to grow, develop your talents, and help foster an inclusive environment for all across our firm and industry. Learn more at www.man.com/diversity.

You'll have opportunities to make a difference through our charitable and global initiatives, while advancing your career through professional development, and with flexible working arrangements available too. Like all our people, you'll receive two annual 'Mankind' days of paid leave for community volunteering.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes competitive holiday entitlements, pension/401k, life and long-term disability coverage, group sick pay, enhanced parental leave and long-service leave. Depending on your location, you may also enjoy additional benefits such as private medical coverage, discounted gym membership options and pet insurance.

Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

Man Group provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants and all employees without regard to race, color, creed, national origin, ancestry, religion, disability, sex, gender identity and expression, marital status, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, age or any other legally protected category or status in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.

Man Group is a Disability Confident Committed employer; if you require help or information on reasonable adjustments as you apply for roles with us, please contact TalentAcquisition@man.com.

Job ID: MJ000316

Responsibilities

Design and evolve search infrastructure: Architect, develop, and maintain robust backend services for search and recommendation pipelines, covering data ingestion, real-time indexing, query parsing, and multi-channel retrieval.
Performance and latency optimization: Continually optimize query performance against massive datasets with complex real-time filters, including pricing, dynamic inventory, and geo-spatial data, to keep search latency in milliseconds during peak traffic.
Algorithm engineering and productionization: Partner closely with AI and algorithm scientists to productionize advanced features including NLP and tokenization, intent recognition, re-ranking, personalized recommendation, and vector search.
Search engine tuning: Drive performance tuning, sharding strategies, and schema mappings for Elasticsearch and OpenSearch clusters, while building comprehensive monitoring for search quality metrics.
Cross-regional collaboration: Coordinate with regional product and engineering teams across Singapore and Jakarta to support localization and multi-language search capabilities unique to Southeast Asian markets.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Professional English proficiency: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to collaborate seamlessly within a multicultural, distributed engineering team.
At least 8 years of backend development experience, with a solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems design.
Deep search expertise: Proven production experience with Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Solr, or Lucene, with a deep understanding of inverted indexes, cluster tuning, and custom plugins.
Core technology stack: Strong proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, or JVM-centric stacks. Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL and MySQL, as well as stream processing tools such as Kafka and Flink, for building real-time synchronization pipelines.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience in large-scale e-commerce, OTA search, recommendation, or ad-tech systems.
Familiarity with vector databases such as Milvus and Pinecone, or LLM-driven semantic search.
Background in cloud infrastructure, especially AWS, and containerization with Docker and Kubernetes.

主导新品全生命周期管理算法体系建设，利用大模型赋能自动化选品与汰换，实现“以少胜多”的商品力提升。 3. 团队管理与人才培养（团队管理）

jobs.title: Engineering Lead (Quanta AI Platform, China)
jobs.location_raw: 中国 北京市 北京市
jobs.description:
About the Role & Team: IDC recently launched Quanta, a new AI platform that puts autonomous buyer and seller agents to work on IDC's global technology market-intelligence data - helping tech buyers and vendors make faster, evidence-backed decisions. It's live today for customers outside China. We're now extending Quanta into China: China's data-residency requirements mean large parts of the platform have to be independently rebuilt to run in-country (user data, uploaded documents, query handling stay in China; some AWS and agent infrastructure isn't available there). You'd be the founding member of a new China-based engineering team: architecting and building the in-country version of Quanta, then running it and growing the team.

What You'll Do: Architect and build a China-resident version of Quanta's user data platform, including modernizing a 10+ year old access model behind a new API layer. Get Quanta's AI agents running in China without Agent Core, by adapting or forking the agent orchestration layer to a China-compatible alternative. Rebuild document upload, storage, and search/vector-index systems to run independently inside China. Design the data boundary that lets China-based search and agents operate while keeping IDC's proprietary research and verbatim user queries appropriately separated. Recruit, hire, and lead the long-term China engineering team as its first member. Own the system on an ongoing basis after launch - a long-term build-and-run role.

What You Bring: 8+ years of full-stack or backend software engineering experience, including ownership of architecture decisions under real infrastructure and regulatory constraints. Direct experience building or operating systems inside China's infrastructure/data-residency environment. Experience with API design and migrating legacy systems (databases, access models) onto modern service layers. Working knowledge of search/vector-index systems and LLM agent orchestration frameworks. Experience leading or mentoring engineers. Fluency in Mandarin and English. Comfort operating with real autonomy and ambiguity.

Preferred: Experience with China-specific cloud providers (Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud, Huawei Cloud) as AWS alternatives. Prior 0-to-1 or greenfield build experience, ideally in a regulated or data-sovereignty-constrained market. Distributed team experience across US/EU/China time zones. Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) - the broader agent orchestrator migration is moving that direction.

Offer: Hybrid working with 4 days in office per week required.
jobs.notes: IDC 把其 AI 平台 Quanta（自主 buyer/seller agents + 市场情报数据）落地中国的创始工程负责人：重建数据驻留版用户数据平台、迁移/分叉 LLM agent 编排层、自建向量检索与文档系统，明确偏好 MCP 熟悉者。0-to-1 + 长期 ownership + 组队，8 年+ 全栈/后端、中英双语，AI Agent 含量极高，本轮最值得关注的职位之一；混合办公每周到岗 4 天。
