jobs.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 岗位职责 1、团队管理：全面负责技术开发团队的日常管理、人员调配、绩效考核、培养赋能，带领团队完成各项研发任务，打造高效、稳定、有战斗力的研发团队，提升团队整体技术水平。 2、人事管理系统研发：主导事业部人事管理系统（eHR系统）的需求分析、架构设计、技术选型、开发落地及迭代优化，覆盖招聘、薪酬、绩效、考勤、员工关系、组织架构等核心模块，确保系统贴合公司人事管理业务需求。 3、项目管控：统筹人事管理系统相关项目的全生命周期管理，制定研发计划、把控项目进度、控制研发成本、规避技术风险，确保项目按时、按质、按需求交付，保障系统稳定运行。 4、技术统筹：负责技术方案的评审、代码评审，规范研发流程，优化技术架构，解决研发过程中的核心技术难题，推动技术创新与优化，提升系统性能、安全性和可扩展性。 5、跨部门协同：对接事业部人力资源部，精准理解人事业务需求，转化为技术实现方案；协调测试、运维、产品等相关部门，推进项目落地、系统部署及后期维护，保障业务顺畅开展。 6、人才培养：搭建团队人才培养体系，负责团队成员的技术指导、技能培训、职业规划，挖掘核心人才，提升团队凝聚力和稳定性，打造梯队化人才结构。 7、合规与安全：确保人事管理系统的数据安全、隐私保护，符合国家相关法律法规及内部管理规定，防范数据泄露、系统漏洞等风险；配合完成系统审计、合规检查等工作。 任职要求 一、学历与经验： 1、本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程、信息管理等相关专业，5-8年技术开发经验，其中2年以上团队管理经验，且有带领10人左右技术团队的实际管理经历； 2、有人事管理系统（eHR）全流程开发、迭代经验者优先，大型企业相关经验者优先。 二、技术能力： 1、精通至少一门后端开发语言（Java/Go/Node.js优先），熟练掌握对应的主流框架（Spring Boot/Spring Cloud、NestJS等）； 2、熟悉前端开发技术（HTML5、CSS3、JavaScript、Vue/React），能对接前端团队完成页面开发与联调； 3、熟练掌握MySQL、Redis等数据库，具备数据库设计、SQL优化、数据安全防护能力； 4、了解人事管理系统核心业务逻辑（招聘、薪酬、绩效等），能结合业务需求设计合理的技术方案，有eHR系统架构设计经验者优先； 5、熟悉微服务、分布式架构、消息队列、CI/CD等相关技术，具备独立解决复杂技术难题的能力。 6、管理能力：具备优秀的团队管理、人员调度、绩效考核能力，能有效激励团队，提升团队效率；具备良好的项目管理能力，能统筹项目进度、把控项目质量，应对项目风险。 7、沟通与协作：具备极强的跨部门沟通协调能力，能精准对接人力资源部等业务部门，理解并转化业务需求；具备良好的表达能力、逻辑思维能力，能高效推进工作落地。 8、职业素养：工作严谨负责、责任心强，具备较强的抗压能力、执行力和创新意识；注重细节，有良好的代码规范和研发习惯；认同集团企业文化，具备大局观。 加分项：有国央企、大型集团eHR系统研发管理经验；熟悉人力资源相关法律法规；具备技术架构设计、系统重构、性能优化经验；有团队搭建、人才梯队建设经验。
jobs.notes: eHR 人事系统开发组长，带 10 人左右团队，技术栈 Java/Go/Node.js（Spring Cloud）、Vue/React、MySQL/Redis、微服务；要求 5-8 年开发+2 年管理，seniority 判为 lead。非 AI 相关。风险：标注“来源于猎聘”，发布账号为管理咨询公司，疑似代招；薪资 25-35K/月对管理岗一般。

jobs.title: Technical Lead and Data Science
jobs.company: 曼胡默尔管理(上海)有限公司
jobs.description:
该职位来源于猎聘 Role Summary The Senior AI Technical Lead is a senior, hands-on technical leader responsible for designing, building, deploying, and operating production-grade Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI (GenAI) solutions for internal MANN+HUMMEL customers across divisions and central functions. This role is an immediate contributor who sets technical direction through reference architectures, reusable components, and engineering standards, while mentoring junior and mid-level developers within the Global Data Analytics team. Key Responsibilities


End-to-end delivery: Own AI/GenAI solutions from problem framing through production deployment and operational readiness.
Python engineering: Build robust services, APIs, and automation in Python with strong testing and maintainability practices.
Multi-cloud solutions: Architect and implement solutions across AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP); familiarity with Alibaba Cloud (Alicloud) is a plus.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Implement and maintain IaC using Terraform and/or cloud-native equivalents.
CI/CD: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Bitbucket and/or GitHub (e.g., GitHub Actions), including automated testing, security checks, and environment promotion.
Traditional AI/ML: Deliver machine learning, neural networks, recommendation engines, time series forecasting, and statistical analysis solutions; define evaluation and monitoring.
GenAI/LLM solutions: Implement LLM-based solutions including prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool/function calling, structured outputs, and safety controls (grounding, access control, sensitive data handling).
Data engineering & platforms: Build data pipelines and integrate with Snowflake and/or Databricks; ensure data quality, observability, and performance.
Agentic orchestration: Apply MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent-to-Agent) patterns for agent coordination, orchestration, guardrails, and auditability.
Mentorship & standards: Mentor junior/mid-level developers via pairing, code/design reviews, and coaching; establish “golden paths,” templates, and reference implementations. Required Qualifications
10+ years in software engineering, data engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI with ownership of production systems.
Expert-level Python development (architecture, testing, packaging, performance).
Strong experience delivering cloud solutions on AWS/Azure/GCP; multi-cloud mindset. Alicloud is a plus.
Hands-on IaC experience (Terraform preferred) and CI/CD using Bitbucket and/or GitHub.
Deep applied knowledge of ML and data science methods (modeling, evaluation, statistics, time series, recommendations).
Demonstrated GenAI delivery experience with LLMs (RAG, tool use, evaluation, safety controls).
Experience building data pipelines and working with Snowflake and/or Databricks.
Working knowledge of MCP and A2A for agentic coordination/orchestration. Preferred Qualifications
Containers/orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), API management patterns.
Vector search / embeddings / vector databases (technology-agnostic).
Enterprise security patterns (least privilege, secrets management, audit logging).
Experience working with globally distributed teams. Success Measures
Production deployments delivered with measurable internal impact (time saved, quality improvements, cost reduction).
Stable operations: monitoring, alerting, incident readiness, and cost controls in place.
Reusable components and reference architectures adopted by the team.
Improved team capability through mentorship and consistent engineering practices. Internal Stakeholders / Interfaces
Global Data Analytics (data engineering, analytics engineering, data science)
IT security, enterprise architecture, cloud/platform teams
Internal business customers across divisions and central functions
jobs.notes: 曼胡默尔（MANN+HUMMEL）Senior AI Technical Lead，负责企业级 AI/GenAI 方案端到端交付，技术栈 Python、多云（AWS/Azure/GCP/阿里云）、Terraform、Snowflake/Databricks；要求 10+ 年经验，seniority 判为 lead。强 AI 相关且非常前沿：明确涉及 LLM、RAG、tool calling、MCP 与 A2A 多智能体编排。薪资 50-60K/月，猎聘代发，岗位质量较高。

jobs.title: Sr. Associate Director, Tech SME
jobs.description:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Tech SME.

Business: IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

Technical leadership and architecture

Own and communicate the technical vision, roadmap and engineering approach for Web Flows, aligned with Digital Platforms and wider iWPB Technology strategies.
Lead the design and delivery of secure, resilient and scalable web applications, APIs, microservices and associated platform components.
Translate complex business, customer and regulatory requirements into pragmatic technical solutions.
Work with Architecture, Platform Engineering, Cybersecurity and Infrastructure teams to agree solution designs, engineering standards and technology patterns.
Make informed technology decisions, balancing customer value, delivery speed, operational resilience, security, maintainability and cost.
Identify opportunities to simplify the technology estate, reduce technical debt and retire legacy components.
Ensure solutions are designed for availability, recoverability, observability, performance and efficient support.
Provide technical direction across multiple agile squads and ensure consistency of engineering practices across locations.

Engineering delivery

Lead the technical delivery of Web Flows initiatives from discovery and design through implementation, release and production support.
Break down complex or ambiguous problems into clear technical outcomes, deliverables and implementation plans.
Review and assure solution designs, code quality, test strategies, release plans and operational readiness.
Remove technical impediments and manage dependencies across teams, platforms and technology functions.
Support delivery teams in applying agile, DevSecOps and continuous delivery practices.
Promote automation across build, test, deployment, environment management and operational processes.
Ensure engineering deliverables meet agreed standards for quality, security, resilience, performance and regulatory compliance.
Contribute to planning, estimation, prioritisation and capacity discussions, ensuring that technology risks and dependencies are visible.

Platform resilience, security and operational effectiveness

Be accountable for the production readiness and operational health of Web Flows services.
Work with service management and production support teams to improve stability, incident prevention, monitoring and recovery processes.
Lead technical contributions to problem management, root-cause analysis and service improvement.
Ensure appropriate logging, monitoring, alerting, tracing and service-level measures are in place.
Identify and mitigate technology, cyber, operational and delivery risks.
Support audit, control assessments, risk reviews and independent programme assessments as required.
Ensure changes are delivered in accordance with HSBC’s control framework and technology policies.
Protect HSBC from avoidable operational, financial, regulatory and reputational risk.

Stakeholder management and influence

Build strong working relationships with Value Stream Leads, Product Owners, Architects, Engineering Leads, Operations, Cybersecurity and business stakeholders.
Represent Web Flows in relevant technology, delivery and governance forums.
Explain complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Influence decisions across teams and geographies without relying solely on formal authority.
Partner with third-party suppliers and technology vendors where applicable, ensuring delivery quality, value for money and effective risk management.
Contribute to the alignment of global, regional and local technology priorities.
Encourage constructive challenge and ensure diverse perspectives are considered in technical and delivery decisions.

People and engineering capability

Provide technical coaching, mentoring and day-to-day leadership to engineers and technical specialists.
Help build a high-performing, inclusive engineering culture focused on ownership, collaboration, quality and continuous improvement.
Share knowledge across teams and promote reuse of proven patterns, components and engineering practices.
Support capability development in modern web engineering, cloud technologies, automation, resilience, security and DevSecOps.
Identify skills gaps and contribute to development plans, communities of practice and technical learning.
Collaborate effectively with globally distributed colleagues and promote consistent ways of working across locations.
Demonstrate HSBC’s values by valuing difference, succeeding together, taking responsibility and getting it done.

Financial and delivery management

Support effective prioritisation of change and run activities within agreed budgets and delivery plans.
Ensure technical decisions consider total cost of ownership, operational efficiency and long-term sustainability.
Contribute to investment cases, delivery estimates, resource planning and vendor assessments.
Manage multiple priorities while maintaining focus on customer outcomes, engineering quality and risk management.

Requirements

Knowledge and experience / qualifications

Essential

Proven experience as a Tech Lead, Lead Engineer, Principal Engineer or equivalent role in a complex enterprise environment.
Strong experience designing and delivering web applications, digital journeys, APIs and distributed services at scale.
Demonstrable experience leading engineering delivery across multiple agile teams.
Strong understanding of software architecture, application design, data, infrastructure and integration patterns.
Experience with modern engineering practices, including DevSecOps, continuous integration and continuous delivery.
Experience with cloud technologies, containerisation, microservices and automated deployment approaches.
Strong understanding of non-functional requirements, including resilience, scalability, availability, performance, observability and security.
Experience working with architecture, cybersecurity, platform and operations functions to deliver production-ready services.
Ability to lead technical decision-making in situations involving ambiguity, competing priorities and complex dependencies.
Strong communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
Experience coaching engineers and raising engineering standards across teams.
Experience working in a regulated industry or other environment with strong operational, security and control requirements.
Ability to work effectively with colleagues across multiple countries, cultures and time zones.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (Guangdong) Limited Shanghai Branch***

jobs.title: Robotics Pod Lead
jobs.description:
The role

Siemens builds the systems the physical world runs on: factories, power grids, buildings, trains, hospitals. Robotics and physical AI are major opportunities in applied AI, and among the harder ones to get right. There is a generation of AI-powered robotics and automation products to build.

We are building systems that integrate machine learning models, perception, control, and autonomy into real world, production grade engineering platforms. These systems operate at the intersection of applied science, robotics, distributed systems, and real time product delivery.

As Director of Engineering (Robotics Pod Lead), you own the technology execution and delivery required to take these systems from concept into reliable, deployed production environments. You are accountable for ensuring that robotics and automation systems ship with applied science models embedded in them, and continue to operate at scale with high quality, reliability, safety, and velocity.

This is a senior engineering leadership role. You will lead a cross-functional robotics engineering pod and serve as the single accountable owner for delivery outcomes, partnering closely with Product Management and Applied Science while remaining personally responsible for execution. The role requires both strategic judgment and operational rigor: someone who can make delivery tradeoffs, lead teams through ambiguity, and stay close enough to the work to ensure the right systems get built and deployed.

Key Responsibilities

Own end-to-end delivery of AI-powered robotics and automation systems, from planning through deployment, operation, and iteration.
Lead and scale an engineering pod responsible for building and operating production systems that embed ML models into robotics, perception, control, or automation workflows.
Partner with Product Management to convert product strategy into executable delivery plans.
Partner with Applied Science to take models from research into production-grade robotics and automation systems, effectively and safely.
Ensure engineering systems meet the standards for reliability, scalability, observability, safety, and operational excellence.
Make delivery tradeoffs across scope, schedule, quality, and technical risk.
Drive execution across infrastructure, product engineering, robotics software, and ML-enabled systems.
Hire, develop, and retain engineering managers and senior engineers.
Establish delivery discipline across planning, code quality, release readiness, and incident response.
Hold the pod accountable for outcomes.

Basic Qualifications

12+ years of professional software engineering experience.
5+ years leading multi-team engineering organizations at Senior EM or Director level.
Demonstrated ownership of shipping and operating complex distributed systems in production.
Experience delivering systems that incorporate machine learning, AI, robotics, autonomy, perception, simulation, or control components.
Strong system-level understanding across software architecture, ML pipelines, robotics systems, and production operations.
Proven ability to lead teams through technical and organizational ambiguity.
Track record of balancing delivery velocity with long-term system health.
Demonstrated ability to recruit and retain senior engineers and engineering managers in a competitive market.
Clear, decisive communicator with credibility across engineering, product, and senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading AI, ML, robotics, or autonomous systems platforms end to end.
Background in industrial robotics, automation, real-time systems, or safety-critical systems.
Familiarity with modern AI and robotics systems in production: LLMs, agents, generative AI, retrieval, model serving, inference optimization, MLOps, perception, simulation, or control systems.
Experience scaling teams and delivery practices in growing organizations.
Comfortable operating in global, cross-functional environments.
jobs.notes: 西门子机器人/物理 AI 方向工程负责人（Director of Engineering 级别）：负责把 ML/感知/控制/自主性模型嵌入生产级机器人平台，12+ 年经验 + 5+ 年 Senior EM/Director 管理经验，管理跨职能 Pod 并带队招聘 EM/资深工程师。seniority 依据：Director 级工程负责人、Robotics Pod Lead，判 lead。深度涉及 AI Agent/LLM/生成式 AI/机器人（明确列出 agents、generative AI、retrieval、MLOps），工业 AI 头部平台，对 Agent 方向高度对口，亮点突出。

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer (Geometry)
jobs.description:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Lead Software Engineer to provide hands-on technical leadership in the Geometry domain for MSC Apex. This role is responsible for designing and developing geometry capabilities used in CAE preprocessing, model preparation, defeaturing, geometry cleanup, healing, interoperability, and downstream simulation workflows. The successful candidate will be a senior individual contributor who leads feature-level technical execution, mentors engineers, and collaborates with architecture, QA, product, and engineering teams to deliver robust, scalable, and maintainable geometry solutions aligned with customer and product needs.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deliver advanced Geometry capabilities for CAE products, with focus on robustness, performance, scalability, and maintainability.
Lead feature-level technical work for geometry modeling, defeaturing, cleanup, healing, interoperability, topology handling, and CAE preprocessing workflows.
Participate in design reviews, feasibility analysis, risk assessment, debugging, performance optimization, and implementation planning.
Collaborate with product management, architecture, QA, program management, and engineering teams to translate customer workflow needs into well-defined technical solutions.
Mentor engineers on geometry algorithms, design patterns, code quality, testing strategy, and engineering best practices.
Investigate complex geometry defects, interoperability issues, performance bottlenecks, and customer-reported workflow problems, and drive timely resolution.
Contribute to technical plans and communicate design tradeoffs, delivery risks, and implementation status clearly to stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

Education
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Computational Geometry, Computer-Aided Design, Computer-Aided Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

Experience
10+ years of software engineering experience delivering commercial or enterprise engineering software, preferably in CAD, CAE, geometry, or simulation domains.
Strong expertise in computational geometry, topology, CAD modeling concepts, geometry kernels, B-rep data structures, geometry cleanup, healing, defeaturing, and interoperability workflows.
Strong background in C++ software development for large-scale engineering, scientific, CAD, CAE, or geometry-intensive applications.
Experience designing and implementing robust geometry algorithms and production-quality software components used in model preparation and CAE preprocessing workflows.
Working knowledge of CAE workflows including model preparation, meshing handoff, solver readiness, simulation preprocessing, and customer-driven usability requirements.
Experience with CAD/CAE products or geometry platforms such as MSC Apex, Patran, ANSA, CATIA, SolidWorks, NX, Parasolid, ACIS, Open Cascade, or equivalent technologies.
Ability to lead feature design and implementation decisions while balancing quality, performance, robustness, maintainability, and delivery commitments.
Familiarity with scripting, automation, build systems, debugging tools, profiling tools, and engineering productivity practices; Python experience is preferred.
Experience mentoring engineers, reviewing designs and code, and coordinating technical work within a project or feature team without direct people-management responsibility.

Technical Skills
Strong proficiency in C++ for high-performance geometry, CAD, CAE, or scientific computing applications.
Strong understanding of computational geometry algorithms, including intersection, projection, trimming, tolerance handling, curve and surface evaluation, spatial search, and proximity calculations.
Hands-on experience with B-rep topology, geometry kernels, feature recognition, defeaturing, geometry cleanup, healing, and topology repair workflows.
Experience working with CAD data translation, interoperability, and neutral formats such as STEP, IGES, Parasolid, ACIS, or equivalent geometry representations.
Ability to design robust geometry APIs, reusable software components, and efficient data structures for complex engineering models.
Strong debugging and diagnostic skills for resolving geometric robustness issues, numerical precision problems, and customer workflow failures.
Experience improving geometry operations for performance, memory usage, scalability, and responsiveness in large assemblies and complex CAE models.
Familiarity with automated testing strategies for geometry algorithms, including regression tests, tolerance-based validation, stress cases, and customer model validation.
Working knowledge of Python or scripting tools for automation, diagnostics, workflow prototyping, and engineering productivity.

Soft Skills
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Problem-solving and analytical thinking.
Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
Strong organizational and time-management skills.
jobs.notes: Cadence（EDA 龙头）MSC Apex CAE 几何内核 Lead 岗：计算几何/B-rep/geometry kernel/defeaturing、C++ 大型工程软件、STEP/IGES 互操作；10 年+ 技术领导（无人事管理）。seniority=lead 依据 title。不涉大模型/Agent。亮点：CAE 几何核心技术、资深 IC 路线；风险：CAD/CAE 小众领域、办公模式未标注。

Job Description

Manager, Solution Architect

Technology Services – Asia Pacific, China Market

Overview

Johnson & Johnson Technology Services enables the company’s mission by delivering modern, scalable, compliant and innovative foundational platforms and digital services across the Asia Pacific region.

We are seeking a Manager, Solution Architect to partner with business and technology teams in designing and delivering enterprise technology solutions that align with our architecture standards and business objectives.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Solution Architecture, you will be responsible for translating business needs into high-quality, scalable technical architectures. You will work closely with engineering and technology teams, sector IT partners, cybersecurity and regional stakeholders to design robust, compliant solutions tailored to China market including GenAI integrations, cloud platforms and modern enterprise software architecture.

The successful candidate must demonstrate strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions without authority, lead multiple initiatives, and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams. Passion for continuous learning, innovation, and solving complex business and technology challenges is essential.

Roles & Responsibilities


 Solution Architecture & Technical Design
Lead solution architecture and technical design for enterprise applications and digital platforms within China market.
Translate business needs and architecture strategies into scalable, secure, resilient, and supportable solution designs.
Define and apply reference architectures, design patterns, engineering standards, and technology best practices.
Cloud Solution Design: Ability to evaluate and assess architectural trade-offs and select appropriate cloud services, architecture patterns, and technology components based on business, technical, security, operational, and cost requirements.
Produce architecture deliverables including solution designs, integration architectures, GenAI design patterns, deployment models, and technical specifications.
Ensure solutions meet functional and non-functional requirements, including security, performance, resilience, modernization, API first, AI-enabled, compliance and regulatory obligations.
Conduct architecture reviews, technical assessments, solution evaluation and advisory activities throughout the project lifecycle.
Provide governance and delivery oversight to ensure implementation aligns with approved architecture and enterprise standards.
Identify technical risks, evaluate solution options, and drive mitigation strategies and technology decisions.
 Business Partnership
Partner with business technology stakeholders, product owners, project managers, to understand business priorities including regulatory and compliance needs.
Collaborate with cross functional IT teams, enterprise architects, software engineering units to align technical designs with business requirements.
Work closely with vendors and implementation partners to ensure solutions meet Johnson & Johnson standards and successful technical integration with internal platforms.
Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
 Technology Leadership and Architecture governance
Recommend technology solutions, platforms, and integration approaches aligned with business and architecture objectives.
Develop and maintain reference architectures, design standards, reusable patterns, and engineering best practices.
Provide architecture governance and guidance to ensure solution delivery remains aligned with approved designs.
Participate in architecture reviews and prepare technical artifacts for Architecture Review Board (ARB) evaluations.
Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to inform technology roadmaps and enterprise capability evolution.
Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Security, Data, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams to drive successful solution outcomes and continuous improvement.


Required Qualifications


Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
7+ years of experience in Information Technology, with at least 3+ years actively operating in a solution architect of lead technical engineer role.
Demonstrated experience designing enterprise-scale technology solutions.
Experience working across multiple technology domains.


Preferred Qualifications


Proven experience in working within multinational and life sciences organizations within China market.
Understanding of regional technology considerations including data residency and regulatory requirements.
Experience with Architecture Review Boards and architecture governance.
Familiarity with TOGAF or enterprise architecture methodologies.
AWS, Azure, AI Engineer/Practitioner certifications are advantageous.


Technical Skills And Breadth

Strong experience in several of the following areas:


Cloud native services: Azure, AWS, cloud computing, security, defense in depth, strong understanding of cloud-native components and the ability to select appropriate platform components, deployment models, and architecture patterns
Integration & APIs: REST APIs, API Management, enterprise integration patterns, and event-driven architectures
Application Architecture: Distributed systems, microservices, containerization, and Kubernetes platforms
Data & Messaging: Data architecture, data integration, and messaging technologies
Security: Identity and Access Management (IAM) and security-by-design principles
Enterprise business platforms: CRM (Salesforce, MS Dynamics), ERP (SAP and its variants), and enterprise business application ecosystems
GenAI & AI Platform:
LLMs, RAG, AI agents, and prompt orchestration
AI application architecture and integration patterns
Vector databases and semantic search
AI gateways, guardrails, and responsible AI controls
Model serving, inference platforms, and AI observability
Multi-model, cloud-hosted, and self-hosted AI deployments


Required Skills

Preferred Skills:

Change Management, Compliance Management, Consulting, Developing Others, Emerging Technologies, Enterprise IT Governance, Inclusive Leadership, Information Security Management System (ISMS), Information Technology Strategies, IT Architecture, Leadership, Product Configuration, Requirements Analysis, Resource Allocation, Solution Architecture, Team Management, Technical Credibility

攻克长周期预测、节假日预测、新品/新店预测、极端天气、复杂营销活动、突发事件下的鲁棒性预测等行业级难题。 2. 业务闭环与价值交付

jobs.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 核心系统架构设计与智能化升级 负责核心业务系统的整体架构设计，提供高可用、高扩展的技术解决方案，主导需求评审、系统设计、核心编码及代码质量管控。结合 AI 大模型（LLM） 与 Agent 技术，推动传统保险业务系统的智能化改造，包括但不限于智能核保、理赔辅助、智能客服、自动化风控等场景。主导关键技术预研与难点攻关，引入 AI Agent 框架（如LangChain、Semantic Kernel） 及 RAG（检索增强生成） 技术，提升系统迭代效率与业务响应速度。 保险业务前/中/后台规划与技术治理 深度参与保险业务全域规划，负责所在领域的技术架构治理与演进。前瞻性挖掘业务与技术结合点的突破机会，特别关注 生成式AI在保险价值链（营销、承保、理赔、健康管理）中的应用，提出并落地智能化创新方案，推动业务流程自动化与决策智能化。主导 业务智能体（Agent） 的架构设计，实现复杂业务场景下的自主决策与多Agent协同。 产品与业务深度融合，跨团队协同创新 作为技术领域专家，深入理解保险产品与业务逻辑，与业务、产品团队紧密互动，主动识别业务痛点并转化为技术方案。积极与其他技术团队（数据、算法、平台）沟通协作，推动 AI原生应用 与 领域驱动设计（DDD） 相结合的实践落地，促进技术共享与业务创新。 战略规划与落地推进 依据平安健康险战略及保险行业市场趋势，结合公司阶段性业务重点，制定 目标架构蓝图 与 年度技术规划，明确AI能力建设路径、领域模型演进路线及中台化发展策略，并推动规划有效分解与执行，确保技术战略与业务目标高度对齐。 任职资格 技术基础与AI工程能力 计算机相关专业本科及以上学历，8年以上Java项目开发经验，精通Java语言，深入理解OOP、反射、JVM、IO、多线程、并发处理。 对Spring、MyBatis等主流框架有深入应用及优化经验，了解其原理与实现机制。 熟悉至少一种主流数据库（MySQL/Oracle/PostgreSQL）及SQL调优，熟练使用Maven、SVN/Git等版本工具。 具备AI工程化落地能力：熟悉大模型应用开发（如OpenAI API、国产大模型）、Prompt Engineering、Fine-tuning、向量数据库（如Milvus、Pinecone）、RAG架构；有Agent开发经验，熟悉LangChain、AutoGen、Dify或类似Agent编排框架，能设计并实现业务型智能体（如理赔助手、核保机器人等）。 加分项：熟悉低代码平台技术（流程编排、数据编排、UI编排、服务编排）；有AI模型部署与运维（MLOps）经验。 架构经验与领域驱动设计（DDD） 3年以上技术团队管理经验，有互联网保险或互联网创新业务的架构落地案例。 精通DDD领域驱动设计方法论，具备丰富的领域建模实践经验，能够熟练运用事件风暴、聚合设计、限界上下文划分等技术，将复杂保险业务（如产品定义、承保流程、理赔规则）抽象为清晰的领域模型，并指导微服务拆分与中台建设。 具备结合监管合规风险的架构设计能力，能够在合规框架内实现业务弹性与技术创新。 加分项：有主导业务智能化创新（如AI辅助决策、自动化核保、智能推荐）项目落地的经验；有从0到1构建保险业务中台或数据中台的架构设计经验。 企业架构与建模能力 熟悉企业架构模式，包括流程建模、领域建模、体验建模、产品建模等，能根据业务战略输出架构视图。 有中大型复杂度（日均请求百万级以上）系统架构设计与优化经验，对分布式事务、最终一致性、高并发缓存、消息队列等有成熟实践。 对微服务治理、容器化（Kubernetes）、Service Mesh等云原生技术有理解。 学习与钻研精神 对新技术（尤其是AI、大模型、智能体）有强烈兴趣，喜欢钻研前沿论文与开源项目，具备快速学习与工程转化能力。 有良好的软件工程素养，注重代码质量、自动化测试、持续交付，对技术债务有清晰的管理意识。 沟通与领导力 优秀的沟通表达与逻辑分析能力，能够将复杂技术概念转化为业务语言，有效影响决策。 具备出色的跨部门协作和问题解决能力，能够在不确定环境中主动推动进展，具备强烈的自驱力和结果导向意识。 有团队培养与人才梯队建设经验，能够指导下属工程师成长，营造技术分享与创新氛围。
jobs.notes: 平安健康险研发技术经理，Java 技术栈（Spring/MyBatis）+ DDD + 微服务/云原生，要求 8 年开发+3 年团队管理，seniority 为 manager。强 AI 相关：核心职责是用 LLM/Agent（LangChain、AutoGen、Dify）、RAG、向量数据库改造保险业务（智能核保、理赔、客服），是 AI+保险的落地管理岗。薪资 30-50K/月，发布于猎聘代发渠道。

Complete vehicle development projects and supplier collaboration from architecture definition to validation and release. jobs.title: Overseas IT Manager
jobs.description:
Responsibilities: Responsible for Java back-end architecture design, core function development and system optimization of overseas information systems, supporting build-out, go-live and continuous iteration of overseas business systems. Conduct custom development for Oracle EBS using PL/SQL (stored procedures, packages, functions, triggers, custom reports and business documents); support procurement, inventory, supply chain, finance (AR/AP) modules. Develop Java back-end services and interfaces integrating Oracle EBS with third-party systems including Salesforce, overseas warehousing, logistics and tax systems. Participate in overseas data platforms and business middle-platforms; promote data standards, governance and quality. Optimize microservice architecture and core-system performance with Spring Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, message queues for multi-organization, multi-currency, multi-region operations. Formulate technical specifications, perform code reviews; promote AI-assisted development tools in coding, debugging, testing and documentation.

Qualifications: Bachelor's degree or above in CS/SE or related; at least 5 years of Java back-end development experience including minimum 3 years of Oracle EBS custom development. Proficient in Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, microservices, multi-threading, JVM tuning, SQL optimization. Proficient in Oracle database and PL/SQL; familiar with Oracle EBS standard APIs and business modules. Enterprise system-integration experience with RESTful API/Web-Service; EBS-Salesforce/ERP/CRM/WMS integration preferred. Familiar with Docker, Kubernetes, message queues, distributed transactions; high-concurrency/high-availability system experience. Basic knowledge of enterprise data governance; data platform or middle-platform experience preferred. Experience with AI-aided R&D tools such as GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT. Good English document reading proficiency. Strong communication and coordination; project/team leadership experience preferred.

Recruiter-added requirements: IT Services and IT Consulting 5+ years; Renewable Energy Semiconductor Manufacturing 8+ years; Java 5+ years; Team Management 5+ years.
jobs.notes: 储能系统上市公司海博思创（688411）海外 IT 经理：Java 后端 + Oracle EBS 二开（PL/SQL）+ Salesforce/海外仓/物流/税务系统集成，Spring Cloud/K8s 支撑多组织多币种海外业务。偏 ERP 二开与技术管理岗（要求 5 年+ 团队管理，判 manager），AI 仅要求会用 Copilot/ChatGPT 提效；支持快速申请，但方向与大模型关联弱。

jobs.title: Manager, Software Engineering - NCCL
jobs.description:
We are the GPU Communications Libraries and Networking team at NVIDIA. We deliver communication libraries like NCCL & NVSHMEM for Deep Learning and HPC. DL and HPC applications have a huge compute demand already and run on scales which go up to tens of thousands of GPUs. The GPUs are connected with high-speed interconnects (eg. NVLink, PCIe) within a node and with high-speed networking (eg. Infiniband, Ethernet) across the nodes. Communication performance between the GPUs has a direct impact on the end-to-end application performance; and the stakes are even higher at huge scales! We are looking for a dynamic and technical leader for our China NCCL team. This is an outstanding opportunity to push the limits on the state-of-the-art and deliver platforms the world has never seen before. Are you ready to contribute to the development of innovative technologies and help realize NVIDIA's vision?

What You Will Be Doing


Lead, mentor, and grow our China engineering team. Own the end-to-end execution spanning planning, prioritization, quality control and performance.
Interact with customers and researchers to understand their use cases and requirements. Collaborate with engineering, program and product management, and partners to define the product roadmap.
Contribute to feature design and implementation.
Continuously review and identify improvement opportunities in established processes, infrastructure, and practices to ensure the teams are accomplishing work in the most efficient and transparent manner.


What We Need To See


10+ overall years of experience in the software industry with 4+ years of management experience.
Bachelors, Masters, or Ph.D. in CS, CE, EE (related technical field) or equivalent experience.
Specialization in systems software, communication runtimes, or high performance networking. Proven success in managing several complex initiatives or products through the full product life cycle.
Strong understanding of computer systems architecture, networking technologies (RDMA, RoCE, Ethernet, EFA, InfiniBand) and topologies, operating systems principles (aka systems software fundamentals), HW-SW interactions and performance analysis/optimizations.
Hands-on C/C++ programming and debugging skills in Linux.
Experience balancing multiple projects with competing priorities. Flexibility to work and communicate effectively across different teams and timezones.


Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd


Active user or developer of NCCL!
Customer engagement experience in this space.
Experience with parallel programming models (MPI, SHMEM) and at least one communication runtime (MPI, NCCL, NVSHMEM, NIXL, OpenSHMEM, UCX, UCC).
Experience with programming using CUDA, MPI, OpenMP, OpenACC, pthreads.
Knowledge of HPC and ML/DL fundamentals. Experience with Deep Learning Frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, vLLM, SGLang, TRT-LLM, etc.


, , JR2016650

jobs.title: Robotics Pod Lead
jobs.description:
The role

Siemens builds the systems the physical world runs on: factories, power grids, buildings, trains, hospitals. Robotics and physical AI are major opportunities in applied AI, and among the harder ones to get right. There is a generation of AI-powered robotics and automation products to build.

We are building systems that integrate machine learning models, perception, control, and autonomy into real world, production grade engineering platforms. These systems operate at the intersection of applied science, robotics, distributed systems, and real time product delivery.

As Director of Engineering (Robotics Pod Lead), you own the technology execution and delivery required to take these systems from concept into reliable, deployed production environments. You are accountable for ensuring that robotics and automation systems ship with applied science models embedded in them, and continue to operate at scale with high quality, reliability, safety, and velocity.

This is a senior engineering leadership role. You will lead a cross-functional robotics engineering pod and serve as the single accountable owner for delivery outcomes, partnering closely with Product Management and Applied Science while remaining personally responsible for execution. The role requires both strategic judgment and operational rigor: someone who can make delivery tradeoffs, lead teams through ambiguity, and stay close enough to the work to ensure the right systems get built and deployed.

Key Responsibilities


Own end-to-end delivery of AI-powered robotics and automation systems, from planning through deployment, operation, and iteration.
Lead and scale an engineering pod responsible for building and operating production systems that embed ML models into robotics, perception, control, or automation workflows.
Partner with Product Management to convert product strategy into executable delivery plans.
Partner with Applied Science to take models from research into production-grade robotics and automation systems, effectively and safely.
Ensure engineering systems meet the standards for reliability, scalability, observability, safety, and operational excellence.
Make delivery tradeoffs across scope, schedule, quality, and technical risk.
Drive execution across infrastructure, product engineering, robotics software, and ML-enabled systems.
Hire, develop, and retain engineering managers and senior engineers.
Establish delivery discipline across planning, code quality, release readiness, and incident response.
Hold the pod accountable for outcomes.


Basic Qualifications


12+ years of professional software engineering experience.
5+ years leading multi-team engineering organizations at Senior EM or Director level.
Demonstrated ownership of shipping and operating complex distributed systems in production.
Experience delivering systems that incorporate machine learning, AI, robotics, autonomy, perception, simulation, or control components.
Strong system-level understanding across software architecture, ML pipelines, robotics systems, and production operations.
Proven ability to lead teams through technical and organizational ambiguity.
Track record of balancing delivery velocity with long-term system health.
Demonstrated ability to recruit and retain senior engineers and engineering managers in a competitive market.
Clear, decisive communicator with credibility across engineering, product, and senior leadership.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience leading AI, ML, robotics, or autonomous systems platforms end to end.
Background in industrial robotics, automation, real-time systems, or safety-critical systems.
Familiarity with modern AI and robotics systems in production: LLMs, agents, generative AI, retrieval, model serving, inference optimization, MLOps, perception, simulation, or control systems.
Experience scaling teams and delivery practices in growing organizations.
Comfortable operating in global, cross-functional environments.

jobs.title: Director, AIT Acceleration Lead, Principal Engineer
jobs.description:
Role Summary


The Director, AIT Acceleration Lead runs Forward Deployment Engineering (FDE) and AI engineering as one acceleration engine, working with AI Product Owners to move high-value ideas from opportunity framing to validated minimum viable products. The role turns prioritized AI demand into working, evaluated solutions at speed, then hands them to Digital & Technology (D&T) and PIC for production, scale and sustainable ownership.

The Acceleration Lead owns the rapid-validation and AI engineering capability within AITO, setting engineering and validation standards and leading a multidisciplinary engineering squad that works in PO-led PODs to prove feasibility, desirability and value before scale decisions. The FDE squad focuses on 0→1 business validation of flagship AI opportunities, rapid solution build, small language model development and the AI layer of the AI Empowered Consumption Layer (AICL).


 Key Accountabilities
Lead FDE and AI engineering as a single acceleration engine, moving prioritized AI portfolio ideas from opportunity framing through rapid prototype, proof of concept and validated MVP. 
Partner with AI Product Owners, who report to the AITO Head, on product vision, scope, backlog and MVP success criteria; own technical feasibility, solution build, evaluation evidence and scale-readiness for the prioritized AI portfolio. 
Work with AI Product Owners in PO-led PODs, providing FDE and engineering capacity per product and applying shared discovery, engineering and validation standards. 
Lead the AIT FDE squad for fast, hands-on solution design, prototyping and validation of flagship AI opportunities (0→1). 
Lead rapid AI solution development and implementation through the AI engineering team: agentic applications, RAG pipelines and system integrations built on the China AI platform, using its reference architectures and guardrails. 
Own small language model (SLM) and domain model development for priority commercial use cases – data preparation, fine-tuning, distillation and evaluation of open-weight models – deployed through the China LLM foundation and production release gate owned by the AI Platform & Foundation Director. 
Own the AI layer of AICL (agents, retrieval and orchestration), delivered as one POD with the D&T Data line (CL layer) and GCA DSM (business definitions and unified KPIs). 
Drive builder adoption with China business teams and engineers through sample agents, reusable components, documentation, training and an active user community, in step with GTMx AI fluency and enablement programs. 
Apply disciplined validation gates - feasibility, desirability and value - so only evidenced solutions progress to scale. 
Manage the acceleration-to-scale seam with D&T and PIC, ensuring validated solutions have clear ownership, production architecture, evaluation evidence, funding and transition plans. 
Partner with the AIT Value & Performance Lead to connect product decisions to business cases, KPIs and model-cost economics. 
Lead and develop a multidisciplinary engineering squad, balancing speed, quality and reuse. 
 Required Capabilities & Competencies
 Critical Capabilities & Qualifications
Strong AI product sense and proven partnership with product owners: discovery-to-MVP practices, value-based prioritization and translating business problems into technical solutions. 
Forward deployment / applied AI engineering: agentic applications, retrieval, model and API integration, orchestration, prompt and context engineering, evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop design. 
Hands-on experience building retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines – embeddings, re-rankers and vector databases – and writing production-quality Python. 
Small language model and domain model development: fine-tuning, distillation and evaluation of open-weight models on GPU infrastructure, including sizing and performance testing; experience on domestic accelerators is a plus. 
Rapid experimentation and validation at scale — moving ideas from concept to evaluated MVP with clear evidence. 
Working knowledge of MLOps and LLMOps, model-cost / cost-per-outcome discipline and enterprise deployment seams. 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering or a closely related discipline; an advanced technical or business degree is preferred. 
Typically 12+ years of progressive relevant experience, including several years leading AI engineering and applied AI teams at scope and complexity appropriate to the Director level. Candidates with an exceptional background may be considered from 10+ years. 
Demonstrated ability to work across business, product, technology, data and governance stakeholders in a matrixed environment. 
Experience in a highly regulated industry and the China technology, data, privacy or vendor environment is preferred. 
 Leadership Expectations
Outcome ownership: connects decisions to measurable business, user, service and transformation outcomes. 
AI-first and enterprise-minded: applies responsible AI, reuse, architecture, security, privacy and scale principles appropriate to the work. 
POD collaboration: enables clear accountability, effective cross-functional execution and minimal handoff friction across peer teams and partners. 
Precision and learning: communicate clearly, documents decisions, uses evidence and telemetry and continuously improves delivery. 
Acceleration mindset: drives speed with rigor, making timely scale or stop calls on the evidence. 
 Key Collaboration


The Director partners with the AI Product Owners on product backlog and MVP scope, and with the AIT Value & Performance Lead on business cases and investment decisions and works within AITO under the AITO Head. The role builds on the China AI platform and LLM foundation owned by the AI Platform & Foundation Director, and delivers the AICL AI layer as one POD with D&T Data Engineering & Semantics (CL layer) and GCA DSM (business definitions and unified KPIs). It manages the acceleration-to-scale seam with Digital & Technology (D&T) and the Pfizer Innovation Center (PIC), directs matrixed PIC and contractor capacity, and partners with Go-to-Market Transformation (GTMx), Global Commercial Analytics (GCA) and China Business Units to shape demand and land solutions. It also works with International AIT product and engineering communities, and with Legal, Privacy, Risk, Compliance and Security stakeholders.


 Measures of Success
High-value ideas progressed from opportunity framing to validated, evaluated MVP with a named owner and clear scale or stop decision. 
Faster, higher-quality validation and a clean acceleration-to-scale transition to D&T and PIC. 
Strong engineering and validation discipline – clear standards and evaluation coverage, with close alignment with AI Product Owners on backlog and MVP criteria. 
Reuse of AI products and FDE patterns across the prioritized portfolio. 
AICL AI layer and priority small language models delivered on the China AI platform, with evaluation evidence and reuse across use cases. 


Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.

To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers.

Information & Business Tech

jobs.title: Senior GPU Compiler Development Engineer
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you'll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world's most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career.

The Role

AMD is looking for an MLIR compiler engineer who is passionate about representing and lowering deep-learning operators for next-generation large language and vision models on AMD GPUs. You will be a member of a core team of incredibly talented industry specialists and will work with the very latest hardware and software technology, building the MLIR dialect and operator-lowering surface — including a new single dynamic-shape graph.

The Person

The ideal candidate should be passionate about compilers and intermediate representations and possess the drive to take sophisticated issues to resolution. Able to communicate effectively and work optimally with different teams across AMD.

Key Responsibilities

Help architect the dynamic-graph IR lowering on a single graph
Implement operator definitions and MLIR lowerings for attention and control-flow operators required by new models
Build model- and operator-level runtime-status reporting and analyze graph-optimizer behavior
Contribute to MLIR dialect conventions and the operator-add checklist; review operator-lowering work
Stay informed of compiler, algorithm, and architecture trends and apply them to the IR stack
Debug and fix existing issues and research alternative, more efficient ways to accomplish the same work
Develop technical relationships with peers and partners

Preferred Experience

Strong object-oriented programming background, C/C++ preferred, with a keen attention to detail
Hands-on experience with MLIR (dialects, lowering, passes)
Solid understanding of deep-learning operators and computational graphs
LLVM, GPU programming (HIP / CUDA), and ONNX / ONNX Runtime experience is a plus Attention / transformer and diffusion operator internals; dynamic-shape and quantized inference is a plus
Experience with Windows and Linux development; familiarity with debuggers, source code control systems (GitHub), and profilers
Regular, hands-on use of AI coding agents / assistants to improve day-to-day engineering efficiency
Professional working proficiency in English for cross-site collaboration
Effective communication and problem-solving skills

This posting is for an existing vacancy.
jobs.notes: AMD 北京 GPU 编译器岗（MLIR）：为下一代大语言/视觉模型做算子 lowering 与动态图 IR，C++/LLVM/HIP/CUDA/ONNX，transformer 与扩散算子、量化推理加分；明确要求日常使用 AI coding agents，与 Agent 工具链强相关。大模型基础设施方向，AI 关联度极高。亮点：下一代 LLM 编译栈核心团队；风险：编译器专精路线、现场办公。

jobs.title: CRT Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
Introduction to the job

Are you motivated by solving complex software and computer-related problems on advanced e-beam machines? Do you enjoy applying solid computer science fundamentals to diagnose real-world machine issues, improve system reliability, and support critical products used by customers worldwide?

We are looking for a Software Engineer with a strong foundation in computer science and hands-on software engineering skills to join the Diagnostics Tooling group. In this role, you will help diagnose, investigate, and resolve software and computer-related issues observed on customer e-beam machines, while designing and developing software tools that improve troubleshooting efficiency, automate diagnostics workflows, and strengthen our overall machine diagnostics capability.

You will work closely with equipment specialists, architects, product owners, and stakeholders across multiple domains to analyze complex problems, identify root causes, and deliver reliable, maintainable software improvements.

Role and responsibilities

As a Software Engineer in D&E CRT(Customer response team), you will act as a software expert for software and computer-related diagnostics on e-Beam machines. You will analyze issues reported by Field team from customer sites, provide technical feedback and troubleshooting guidance, and develop software tools and test applications that improve diagnostics efficiency and support internal module validation.

Your responsibilities include:

Acting as a D&E software expert for software and computer-related issues reported by Field from customer e-beam machines
Analyzing Field feedback, diagnosing symptoms, identifying possible root causes, and providing practical troubleshooting recommendations
Developing software tools to reduce the effort and complexity for Field engineers when investigating software, computer, and machine-related problems at customer sites
Building diagnostics and automation tools for log collection, system health checks, issue reproduction, data analysis, and root cause investigation on e-beam machines
Supporting the development of internal D&E module test software, including software for module communication, test execution, result analysis, and validation workflows
Contributing to software solutions involving module communication interfaces, image processing workflows, and image algorithm validation where applicable
Working closely with Field team, equipment specialists, architects, and software teams to translate technical problems into maintainable software solutions
Writing clean, maintainable, and well-tested code for diagnostic tools, test utilities, backend components, and integration software
Continuously improving diagnostics workflows, tool usability, and knowledge transfer between D&E and Field teams
Collaborating effectively across D&E, Field, application, and equipment domains to drive customer-impacting issues toward resolution

Education and experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation, or equivalent
At least 10 years of professional software development experience, preferably in equipment, diagnostics, automation, test software, or engineering tool development
Strong hands-on programming experience with Python and C++
Experience with at least one GUI framework or library, such as Qt, PySide, WinForms, WPF, or similar
Experience or exposure to image algorithms, image processing, general algorithms
Familiarity with computer and equipment interfaces such as RS232, Ethernet, PCIe, and related communication concepts
Basic understanding of Windows and Linux driver concepts, device communication, and system-level troubleshooting

Skills

Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills for software and computer-related issues on complex equipment
Ability to analyze logs, system behavior, communication traces, diagnostic data, and issue reproduction results
Ability to translate Field-reported customer-site issues into actionable technical investigation plans
Good software design and implementation skills for diagnostic tools, test utilities, automation tools, and integration software
Good understanding of operating systems, networking, device communication, and equipment integration troubleshooting
Experience with Git-based development workflows for engineering software or internal tools
Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to Field, DnE, application, and equipment stakeholders

Other information

Curious and analytical problem solver who enjoys investigating complex technical issues
Able to understand system interactions across software, computer, communication, and equipment domains
Ability to establish, maintain, and troubleshoot Linux environments for engineering software, diagnostics tools, and test applications
Takes ownership and drives issues from investigation to practical resolution
Comfortable working with ambiguity in a fast-paced engineering environment
Communicates clearly and collaborates effectively across Field, DnE, application, and equipment teams

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Introduction to the job

Are you motivated by solving complex software and computer-related problems on advanced e-beam machines? Do you enjoy applying solid computer science fundamentals to diagnose real-world machine issues, improve system reliability, and support critical products used by customers worldwide?

We are looking for a Software Engineer with a strong foundation in computer science and hands-on software engineering skills to join the Diagnostics Tooling group. In this role, you will help diagnose, investigate, and resolve software and computer-related issues observed on customer e-beam machines, while designing and developing software tools that improve troubleshooting efficiency, automate diagnostics workflows, and strengthen our overall machine diagnostics capability.

You will work closely with equipment specialists, architects, product owners, and stakeholders across multiple domains to analyze complex problems, identify root causes, and deliver reliable, maintainable software improvements.

Role and responsibilities

As a Software Engineer in DnE, you will act as a software expert for software and computer-related diagnostics on e-beam machines. You will analyze issues reported by Field from customer sites, provide technical feedback and troubleshooting guidance, and develop software tools and test applications that improve diagnostics efficiency and support internal module validation.

Your responsibilities include:

- Acting as a DnE software expert for software and computer-related issues reported by Field from customer e-beam machines
- Analyzing Field feedback, diagnosing symptoms, identifying possible root causes, and providing practical troubleshooting recommendations
- Developing software tools to reduce the effort and complexity for Field engineers when investigating software, computer, and machine-related problems at customer sites
- Building diagnostics and automation tools for log collection, system health checks, issue reproduction, data analysis, and root cause investigation on e-beam machines
- Supporting the development of internal DnE module test software, including software for module communication, test execution, result analysis, and validation workflows
- Contributing to software solutions involving module communication interfaces, image processing workflows, and image algorithm validation where applicable
- Working closely with Field, equipment specialists, architects, and software teams to translate technical problems into maintainable software solutions
- Writing clean, maintainable, and well-tested code for diagnostic tools, test utilities, backend components, and integration software
- Continuously improving diagnostics workflows, tool usability, and knowledge transfer between DnE and Field teams
- Collaborating effectively across DnE, Field, application, and equipment domains to drive customer-impacting issues toward resolution

Education and experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation, or equivalent
- At least 5 years of professional software development experience, preferably in equipment, diagnostics, automation, test software, or engineering tool development
- Strong hands-on programming experience with Python and C++
- Experience with at least one GUI framework or library, such as Qt, PySide, WinForms, WPF, or similar
- Experience or exposure to image algorithms, image processing, general algorithms
- Familiarity with computer and equipment interfaces such as RS232, Ethernet, PCIe, and related communication concepts
- Basic understanding of Windows and Linux driver concepts, device communication, and system-level troubleshooting

Skills (Essential)

- Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills for software and computer-related issues on complex equipment
- Ability to analyze logs, system behavior, communication traces, diagnostic data, and issue reproduction results
- Ability to translate Field-reported customer-site issues into actionable technical investigation plans
- Good software design and implementation skills for diagnostic tools, test utilities, automation tools, and integration software
- Good understanding of operating systems, networking, device communication, and equipment integration troubleshooting
- Experience with Git-based development workflows for engineering software or internal tools
- Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to Field, DnE, application, and equipment stakeholders
- Ability to establish, maintain, and troubleshoot Linux environments for engineering software, diagnostics tools, and test applications

Nice to have

- Experience with e-beam, semiconductor equipment, motion systems, imaging systems, or other high-tech equipment
- Experience with image processing, image algorithm validation, motion control diagnostics, or module-level test software
- Experience with equipment communication protocols, hardware interfaces, or module-level integration
- Experience with remote troubleshooting, log analysis platforms, diagnostic automation frameworks, or customer escalation support

Personal skills

- Curious and analytical problem solver who enjoys investigating complex technical issues
- Able to understand system interactions across software, computer, communication, and equipment domains
- Takes ownership and drives issues from investigation to practical resolution
- Comfortable working with ambiguity in a fast-paced engineering environment
- Communicates clearly and collaborates effectively across Field, DnE, application, and equipment teams
- Team player who shares knowledge and supports continuous improvement
- Open to AI-assisted development, open-source technologies, and new engineering practices

About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.

And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.

Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

We're looking for an experienced individual to join us in the role of Senior Software Engineer. This position requires enthusiasm for exploring and understanding new business areas.

We maintain a culture of ownership and value engineers that are excited about the business and are willing to work alongside stakeholders to continually improve business processes and customer experience.

We offer a broad range of opportunities across platform engineering, B2B customer integration, conversion optimisation and business process automation. At Abound, you will work on the best-in-class open-banking decision making platform, and learn how to operate with low-latency, at scale.

Candidates must have had experience working directly with internal stakeholders to establish requirements, designing technical solutions, and owning the delivery of significant functionality, ideally having worked with peers of different levels to complete projects collaboratively. Fluency in both Chinese and English is essential to facilitate seamless communication and collaboration.

Our technology stack: Python (including FastAPI, OpenTelemetry, procrastinate, SQLAlchemy, Uvicorn), Postgres, MySQL, Liquibase, Retool, Docker, AWS

Who You Are

Seven or more years professional experience in software engineering
Proven experience leading the development of significant new functionality
Proficiency in writing well-structured async Python code with type hints and unit tests
Experience maintaining codebases for business-critical systems
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Effective communication and collaboration skills
Proficiency in Git for version control
Basic knowledge of cloud infrastructure with experience working with at least one of AWS, GCP, or Azure
Strong SQL skills for efficient data management and retrieval
Knowledge of lending products and business processes will be a major advantage
Fluency in both Chinese and English

What You'll Be Doing

Develop new features backend services that could span any part of the lending lifecycle, from finding and onboarding new customers, to helping underwriters asses their affordability, all the way through to paying out and then collecting a loan
Participate in the entire SDLC, helping to design changes, review code, build tests, and coordinate deployments

Collaborate closely with colleagues in Product and Design as well as users (both internal and external) to understand, challenge, and refine requirements

Supporting junior engineers through PRs and pairing
Apply strong SQL skills to troubleshoot and improve the performance of data management and retrieval across our Postgres databases

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer (backend-weighted) to join the Retail Tech team within Digital Technology. You will stay hands-on across the stack, with most of your impact through backend architecture, APIs, and integration quality. Additionally, this role requires participation in an on-call rotation to ensure the continuous reliability of our critical systems.

Job Description

Full stack delivery (backend-weighted): Design and build backend microservices, REST/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, and event-driven integrations connecting retail and D2C channels with internal systems (OMS, ERP, inventory, POS, WMS, payments). Implement and maintain supporting frontend/admin or internal tooling where needed.
Subsystem ownership & architecture: Lead end-to-end execution of complex retail/omnichannel features — from technical design through deployment. Translate business requirements into scalable, high quality, fault-tolerant solutions; own at least one integration domain (e.g. order sync, inventory, catalog/pricing, or POS↔digital).
Omnichannel data sync: Ensure reliable, near-real-time sync of orders, inventory, product catalogs, pricing, and customer data across online channels and physical retail touchpoints; handle failure modes, retries, and idempotency.
Quality & production ownership: Conduct thorough code reviews; champion unit/integration testing, observability, and runbooks; participate in on-call and production incident response for retail-critical paths; reduce technical debt in core integration services.
Mentorship & collaboration: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers; improve team engineering practices. Partner with Product, Solution Architects, QA, and adjacent teams (DCOM, Data, Production & Supply Chain) to deliver quarterly initiatives.

Requirement
Experience
4–6+ years in full stack or backend software development, with strong backend fundamentals.
Track record in e-commerce, retail, omnichannel, or enterprise integration systems.

Must Have
Backend: APIs (REST/GraphQL), microservices, webhooks, event-driven / async integration patterns.
Full stack: Comfortable delivering supporting frontend or internal admin UI (React/Vue or equivalent).
Database (RDS or NoSQL DB): performance tuning, query optimization, production debugging.
Production mindset: Code review, automated testing, documentation, incident troubleshooting.
Communication: Fluent written and spoken English & Chinese.
Working style: Self-directed, detail-oriented, accountable for deadlines and production quality.

Nice to have
Retail systems: POS, OMS, ERP, WMS, payment gateway integrations.
Commerce platforms: Shopify Plus, headless commerce, custom commerce backends.
Cloud & ops: AWS (EC2, RDS, CloudFront), Linux, bash scripting; AWS certification a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Global payments are complex and ever-evolving. At Checkout our software engineers develop the next-generation payments technologies that enable our Merchants to boost their acceptance rates, cut processing costs, fight fraud, and create cutting edge technology that enables extraordinary customer experiences.

We're looking for Senior Software engineers who bring fresh ideas, have a curious nature and are passionate about working in an Engineering environment which focuses on building products to achieve the company's strategic goals. You’ll get to work with teams from across Checkout.com’s portfolio of products and services who all have a real customer first philosophy.

As a Senior Software engineer, you will lead and drive specific projects critical to Checkout's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display exceptional leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. With your technical expertise you will lead project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

What Are We Looking For

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
Proficiency in .NET C#, Java, or Go, with a strong understanding of software development principles in either a backend or full stack environment.
Great communication skills and ability to interact effectively with a wide range of stakeholders
Experience working in agile environments and delivering high-quality code within tight deadlines
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team
Payments or financial knowledge is a plus, but not a necessity

How You’ll Make An Impact

Be part of, and collaborate with, cross-functional teams including product management, across a large engineering community.
Define and design loosely coupled, scalable systems in a wider microservices using industry best practices.
Stay up-to-date, use, and spread knowledge of the latest technologies used by Checkout.
Write clean, maintainable, extendable and testable code on some of Checkout’s most impactful systems.
Build, own and operate your systems to the highest levels of resilience and service.
Mentor junior team members and assist in their technical development

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram
jobs.notes: Checkout.com 支付平台高级软件工程师，技术栈 .NET C#/Java/Go，微服务后端或全栈，带项目主导与导师职责。seniority 由标题 Senior 判断。不涉及 AI/大模型。亮点：全球支付金融科技、每周三天到办公室的混合模式；风险：竞争激烈（超过 100 人点击申请）。

jobs.title: 电子系统技术顾问 - 软件
jobs.description:
工作总结:

该应用技术、开发领导职位创造作为康明斯产品不可或缺的部分出售的软件。担任这些职位的人员参与确定和理解利益相关方要求和制定规范，以及软件设计、实施、测试和/或发布的职责，而该软件可控制康明斯产品在各种客户应用中的运作。

主要责任:

调查高难度或高度专业的产品软件问题、了解因果机制、提出适当措施、制定问题解决方案并记录结果。

创建、管理、改进并运用产品软件开发流程和工具。相关流程包括编码、编译及测试。相关工具包括代码编辑器、集成工具、策略分析工具、编译器及环路测试工具硬件。有关此角色的详细信息，请参阅本文档末尾部分。

征求产品和软件开发团队意见并与其磋商，并向产品团队提供已验证软件功能、组件和构建。

利用系统知识和专业技能，在影响软件构建质量和性能、产品线（平台）及跨事业部集成和协调管理的软件要求、架构、设计及测试方面制定决策。

负责与跨职能团队互动和协作。

负责审查经验不足的开发人员/测试人员的工作，以确保设计稳健、可重复使用及有效。

负责培训和培养下一代技术专家。

为不明确性较高且通常对全球业务产生影响的复杂系统提供问题解决方案指导。

领导某个全球事业部职能部门的工作流程和系统开发和改进或所有事业部的管理改进。

协调和指导技术项目团队的工作，甚至包括直接管理中小型团队。

作为某个站点或全球事业部的某个专业或产品领域的公认多领域专员或专家，负责（直接或间接）培养当地人才。

培训和指导其他工程师、项目经理及跨职能部门团队成员。

亦可能包括某个能力或专业领域的学术或行业合作。

技能:

产品功能建模、模拟与分析 - 通过使用和/或解释计算工具和方法，预测相对于系统、子系统和/或零件级需求的产品功能能力，影响产品设计决策。

产品平台规划和建造 - 创建和开发整体产品平台，包括与未来目标市场的市场级产品计划相一致所需的关键架构特征和功能变体；生成可追溯到要求的替代架构，并与生命周期利益相关者合作进行权衡分析，确保提供平衡和最佳平台；沟通和维护产品开发团队执行的可追溯信息和计划。

产品软件设计与构建 - 使用行业最佳实践和完善的软件工程原理构建产品软件；验证软件更新以确保产品质量。

产品验证和认证管理 - 根据各种输入来制定产品系统验证计划，以识别故障模式，同时管理产品风险和相对优先级；根据能力来协商产品需求，以指导项目范围；评估分析、模拟和物理测试结果，以核实产品能力和验证要求；评估传统系统解决方案与获提议系统解决方案的功能，并使用技术文档提出建议，以支持产品决策。

系统要求工程 - 利用适当的方法和工具将利益相关方的需求转化为开发设计的可验证需求；通过分析、分配和协商确定涉及系统的验收标准；跟踪整个系统生命周期中的要求状态；评估系统要求变化对项目范围、进度和资源的影响；创建并维护关联相关工件的信息。

系统思考 - 通过绘制边界、确定环境背景、界面以及生命周期以定义涉及系统，帮助规划问题陈述、范围和可交付成果；通过使用合适的方法、模型和结果整合来分析构成涉及系统的要素之间的关联和相互作用，以了解系统、预测其行为并提出改进建议以产生期望的效果。

构建关系网络 - 在组织内外部有效建立正式和非正式的关系网络。

有效沟通 - 发展和实现多模式沟通，清晰了解不同受众的特定需求。

培育创新 - 通过创新和持续的改进让组织成功。

决策质量 - 及时作出高质量的决策，推动组织发展。

管理不确定性 - 即使在事情不明朗，目标不确定的情况下也能有效运作。

We are looking for a Senior Robotics Software Engineer to support the development and delivery of autonomous consumer robotics products.

This role is focused on working closely with ODM/JDM development partners throughout the product lifecycle, driving technical discussions, system-level problem solving, issue investigation, performance optimization, quality improvements, and successful product launches.

While opportunities may exist to contribute to feature design and software implementation, the primary focus is on technical leadership, system engineering, partner collaboration, and product delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Product Development & Partner Collaboration
Collaborate closely with ODM/JDM partners throughout product development, validation, and launch phases.
Review software designs, technical proposals, and implementation plans from development partners.
Drive technical discussions, requirement clarification, risk assessments, and issue resolution.
Support integration, validation, and production readiness activities.
Track and drive closure of technical issues impacting product quality, performance, reliability, or schedule.

System Engineering & Problem Solving
Investigate and resolve complex system-level issues involving software, hardware, sensors, algorithms, and system integration.
Perform structured root-cause analysis using data, testing, debugging, and validation techniques.
Drive improvements in system reliability, robustness, performance, and maintainability.
Support field issue investigations and corrective actions.

Robotics Behaviours & Autonomy
Work with internal teams and development partners to define, implement, and optimize autonomous robot behaviours.
Review and validate solutions related to navigation, localization, obstacle avoidance, sensing, planning, and control.
Analyze robot performance in real-world environments and identify opportunities for improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with software, hardware, perception, QA, test, product, and operations teams.
Support project planning, issue management, and technical decision-making.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Skills
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.
5+ years of experience in robotics, autonomous systems, embedded systems, or software engineering.
Strong programming skills in C++ and Python.
Experience with Linux development, software debugging, system integration, and software architecture.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.

Robotics Experience (one or more)
Robotics software development; Mobile robots or autonomous systems; Navigation and localization; SLAM and sensor fusion; Robot control systems; Behaviour Trees or State Machines; ROS / ROS2.

Strong system-thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
Experience working across software, hardware, sensors, and algorithms to resolve complex issues.

Basic understanding of robotics perception, computer vision, sensors, and machine learning concepts.

Strong English reading and writing skills; basic spoken English for technical discussions.
