jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description

About Grab and our workplace

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. We are dedicated to improving the lives of millions of users across the region by providing them everyday services such as deliveries, mobility, financial services, enterprise services and others. More than that, we provide the opportunity for them to have a better life. And that aspiration starts inside Grab because we believe in a seamless blend of work and home life, making every aspect of life better for all.

Guided by The Grab Way, which spells out our mission, how we believe we can achieve it, and our operating principles—the 4Hs: Heart, Hunger, Honour and Humility—we work to create economic empowerment for the people of Southeast Asia. With our unwavering commitment to our values, we believe that we're more than a service provider; we're agents of positive change.

Job Description

关于Grab及我们的工作环境

Grab是东南亚领先的一站式超级应用。我们致力于通过提供配送、出行、金融服务、企业服务等日常生活服务，改善东南亚数百万用户的生活。更重要的是，我们为他们创造过上更好生活的机会。这一切的起点就在Grab内部，因为我们相信工作与生活的无缝融合，让生活的方方面面都变得更美好。

职位描述

了解我们的团队

Grab致力于在东南亚打造领先的O2O平台，而平台效率是衡量业务能力的关键因素。本团队为不同业务线（出行、餐饮配送、快递等）提供路线规划/导航/预估到达时间（ETA）能力。我们的目标是为司机伙伴提供最有效、最可靠的实时信号（如路况事件、交通信息、行车记录仪检测结果），以实现更高的平台效率。

了解这个岗位

在这里，你将深度参与地理信息行业最前沿的路线规划/导航算法的开发与研究，更贴近业务的核心指标，并利用海量真实数据探索其与现实世界的关联。最重要的是，你将有机会通过一点一滴的洞察推动Grab的业务增长，并最终见证业务指标的提升。

我们正在寻找一位高级机器学习工程师，来构建先进的实时感知能力，帮助我们的司机伙伴以最高效的方式完成工作。我们需要你卓越的机器学习技能来优化导航体验（包括场景细化、导航定位、引导优化、用户定制化、与实时信号的交互、数据埋点与分析等）。同时，我们也希望你充分发挥才能，大胆提出创意想法，并与团队成员一起实践落地。

日常工作内容

构建可靠的L3/L4级智能化流程，打造稳健且可扩展的解决方案来处理实时信号。
基于海量的用户轨迹数据，构架交通基座大模型，提升ETA路径规划等能力。
基于手机或车载行车记录仪等低成本视觉设备，打造以视觉为基础的交通事件的感知模型。
设计、构建和运维可靠的数据管道，覆盖实时流式处理和大规模批量处理，包括实时事件数据及其他地理空间信号。
将原始且嘈杂的数据转化为可信赖的特征、洞察和数据集，以支持路线规划、导航、路况和地图质量等相关应用场景。
建立监控、数据质量检查、评估框架和反馈闭环，确保数据管道和模型输出的可靠性。
与产品经理、数据科学家、分析师和工程师紧密协作，定义问题、开展实验并交付可扩展的解决方案。
探索新兴技术，并将其务实地应用于提升团队的工程效率和产品成果。

Qualifications

任职要求

必备条件

两年以上机器学习工程经验。
扎实的计算机科学基础，包括算法和数据结构。
有开发和维护大规模微服务的经验。
有构建和运维生产级批量及实时数据处理管线的实战经验。
能够处理噪杂或不完整的数据，定义合适的评估指标，并将模糊的业务问题转化为可衡量的技术解决方案。
热衷于构建产品和功能以推动业务增长。
熟悉任何一种编程语言并具备良好的编码能力，同时愿意使用Golang进行开发。熟练掌握Golang将是一个很大的加分项。

加分项

有处理地理空间、路线规划、导航、路况、事件或地图相关数据的经验。
熟悉流式处理技术，如Kafka、Flink、Spark Streaming或同类系统。
有构建面向工程或运维工作流的智能化自动化的经验，包括RAG、工具集成、评估和Harness工程。
熟悉数据分析、模型监控、实验设计和生产级ML生命周期管理。
熟悉AWS或Azure等云服务。
jobs.notes: Grab 北京地图/导航 ML 高级岗：路线规划/ETA、基于轨迹数据构建交通基座大模型、视觉交通事件感知、Kafka/Flink 实时管道、Golang；加分项含 RAG/工具集成/Harness 工程，AI/Agent 关联强。senior 依据 title。亮点：地理信息前沿+基座大模型落地场景；风险：北京现场办公、仅要求 2 年经验职级可能偏平。

jobs.title: Senior Backend & Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description
About Grab and Our Workplace
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Job Description
Get to Know the Team
The Mobility team is an established team responsible for the ride-hailing module in the Grab app. We improve the core transport booking experience.

We are working on high throughput, real-time distributed systems that use machine learning techniques to solve hundreds of millions of requests per day. Our mission is to offer the best products and experiences to our passengers to increase adoption and engagement of our services. Our team has direct end-user contact, and impact on the bottom line for Grab.

Get to Know the Role
We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer, Backend to join our growing engineering team in Beijing, China. You will be reporting to Software Engineering Manager II and work at the intersection of backend product engineering and Site Reliability Engineering.

This role balances building new backend capabilities with improving the reliability, observability, and operational readiness of the services we own. Across an average quarter, you will spend approximately half your time on product and integration engineering, and half on reliability engineering. The split will flex around launches, incidents, and business priorities.

You will design, build, and operate backend systems that support Mobility at scale. You will work closely with Product, Operations, Analytics, partner-facing teams, and engineers across Grab to deliver reliable customer and partner experiences.

This role is onsite based in our Beijing, China office.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
- You will work with Product/Design/Analytics teams to understand problems, requirements, provide feedback, options, trade offs, and timelines.
- You will collaborate with Android/IOS/Backend/QA/ML Engineers to brainstorm and implement technical solutions that are scalable and addressing the actual problems.
- You will write code that is reusable, scalable and testable. Make sure features are delivered on time and with high quality.
- You will review code and engineering specs, provide constructive feedback and aim to raise the engineering bar.
- You will be responsible and responsive during on-call duty. Triage, debug, mitigate and fix complex issues. Assist on ad hoc queries from other teams.
- You will mentor junior engineers and contribute to the team's overall growth and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications
- You have Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field
- You have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience in distributed systems environments
- You have proficiency in at least one backend programming language (Go, C++, Python, or similar)
- You have experience with computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, and system design principles
- You have experience designing and operating high-throughput or real-time distributed systems.
- You understand production failure modes, including partial failures, timeouts, retries, duplicate events, eventual consistency, and dependency degradation.
- You have solid knowledge of relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, MongoDB, Cassandra, or similar)
- You have hands-on experience with production observability, including metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting, and runbooks.
- You understand reliability practices such as SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, safe deployments, rollback strategies, capacity planning, and postmortem follow ups.
- You have experience with cloud infrastructure, like AWS, and modern delivery practices such as CI/CD, containers, and infrastructure automation.
- You collaborate effectively across engineering and non-engineering functions, communicate technical trade-offs clearly, and take ownership of outcomes.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.location_raw: 中国 香港特别行政区
jobs.description:

Responsibilities:
Own the end-to-end delivery of full-stack features, from requirements clarification and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and post-release support.
Work directly with product, operations, and app engineering teams to translate business needs into practical technical solutions, communicate trade-offs, and proactively resolve delivery blockers.
Develop and extend Sylius/Symfony modules with clear domain models and maintainable business logic. Design and optimize database schemas and queries to support application performance and data integrity.
Build and maintain reusable Vue 3 and TypeScript components, and evolve the frontend architecture to deliver consistent, responsive user experiences.
Design, implement, and maintain APIs and integrations supporting native Android/iOS apps, e-commerce operations systems such as Odoo, and internal services, ensuring reliable data exchange and backward compatibility.
Improve search and product discovery with Elasticsearch through relevance tuning, query optimization, and reliable indexing and data synchronization workflows.
Take ownership of code quality through automated unit, integration, and API tests, covering critical business workflows, edge cases, and integration contracts before release.
Deploy and support applications in cloud and containerized environments, monitor changes after release, and troubleshoot production issues.
Guide technical decisions, conduct constructive code reviews, and mentor junior engineers.

Requirements:
5+ years of full-stack development experience, with engineering team leadership preferred.
Proficiency in languages like PHP, Python, or Node.js, with strong hands-on experience in enterprise frameworks like Symfony or FastAPI.
Proficiency in MySQL (or similar relational database), including schema design, query optimization and data integrity.
Hands-on experience developing and delivering modular, scalable frontend applications with Vue 3 and TypeScript.
Hands-on experience implementing Elasticsearch for search and filtering features.
Hands-on experience with cloud services (AWS preferred) and container technologies like Docker.
Familiarity with AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, etc) for code generation and problem-solving.
End-to-End Quality: robust unit, integration, and API automated tests.
High Autonomy: navigate ambiguity, propose scalable technical solutions, drive delivery.
Communication & Mentorship: excellent English; Cantonese is a plus.

Nice to have:
Experience working with ERP platforms (especially e-commerce operations workflows and finance/accounting requirements).
Experience within a retail or e-commerce business environment (inventory, promotions, logistics).
Mobile-facing API design experience (versioning, backward compatibility, performance).

Additional information:
The team is lean: successful candidates are highly self-directed. End-to-end ownership. Quality first.

If you think you've got what it takes, please provide your cover letter, CV and expected salary.

This position is based and located in Hong Kong. Candidate must be eligible to work in Hong Kong.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Gateway - Shanghai
jobs.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About The Role

Kong is an open-source project with a global adoption around the world. Developers and architects are adopting Kong in production among a large variety of use-cases, and actively help make Kong a better product with their feedback and contributions.

As a Systems Engineer in the Core Team, you will be working on core features such as proxying capabilities, load balancing, and database support with forward-thinking. You will be responsible for building foundations for other teams and customers, discovering and producing cutting edge industry trends and use-cases.

What You'll Do

Responsible for designing, building and maintaining API management software and its underlying stack.
Architecture, design, and implement new innovative features including proxying capabilities, load balancing, databases support that extend Kong’s offering.
Bugs troubleshooting, performance tuning and low-level optimizations. Engage with open source community and extend Kong core to support the latest industry trends.
Fill the gaps between Kong and third-party deployment platforms and tooling.
And any additional tasks required by manager.

What You'll Bring

8+ years of programming in server-side applications and components.
Experience designing, prototyping, building and debugging applications that are highly scalable, distributed, reliable and resilient.
Solid hands-on low-level technical expertise in Linux systems troubleshooting, and profiling.
Experience in distributed systems, Linux networking stack and computer systems programming, Kong works with APIs on both L7 and L4 transports and protocols, so this expertise and knowledge are required.
Comfortable working with a remotely distributed team.
Strong sense of ownership and excellent verbal and written communication skills -- engineers at Kong write the documentation for their products
Familiarity with AI LLM concepts and applications development

Bonus Points

Hands on experience with NGINX/OpenResty/Kong/LuaJIT.
Hands on experience with Envoy or Istio.
Hands on experience with Rust

About Kong

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.

jobs.description:

雇佣类型：全职

岗位概述

负责 Linux 虚拟化平台与 MicroVM 技术的架构设计和核心能力建设，持续优化虚拟机的启动速度、资源隔离、稳定性与安全性。

岗位职责

负责 Linux 虚拟化平台的架构设计、开发与性能优化；
负责 MicroVM 技术方案的设计、落地及核心能力建设；
优化虚拟机启动速度、资源隔离、稳定性与安全性。

任职要求

5 年以上 Linux 系统或虚拟化开发经验；
深入理解 Linux 内核、KVM/QEMU 架构及虚拟化原理；
熟悉 Firecracker、Cloud Hypervisor、Kata Containers 等 MicroVM 技术；
至少熟悉 AWS、GCP、Azure 中一个主流云平台；
精通 C/C++、Rust 或 Go，具备系统调试与性能分析能力；
资深 Code Agent 用户，能够熟练使用 AI 编程工具完成复杂系统的开发、调试与代码审查；
能够使用中文开展深入技术协作，并使用英文阅读、撰写和参与日常技术沟通。

加分项

有 Linux 内核、KVM、QEMU、Firecracker、Cloud Hypervisor、Kata Containers、rust-vmm 等开源项目的上游贡献；
在云厂商的计算或虚拟化团队做过核心开发，有大规模虚拟机或 MicroVM 集群的生产落地经验；
有虚拟机快照与恢复、热迁移、内存超分与去重、设备直通、virtio / vhost-user 等机制的深度优化经验；
有 AI Agent 沙箱、Serverless 或安全容器（如 E2B、gVisor）相关的研发经验；
有开源项目、技术博客或同等的非公开工程成果。

Own the design, development and deployment of services that comprise our globally distributed trading platform

Curious about how trading works and motivated to understand the business impact behind the technology you build

Technologists who are passionate about software and not only like to learn about it at work, but also like to get involved in their own projects at home

Team players who love working with like-minded peers and are always looking to learn and improve
Experience with making architectural recommendations on IT solutions, design & approach

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Content Understanding & Moderation
jobs.description:
Unity Ads serves billions of ad requests across hundreds of thousands of mobile games. Every one of those requests involves content on both sides: an ad creative we are about to show, and a game we are about to show it for.

Understanding that content — what is in it, who it is appropriate for, and whether it belongs on the network at all — underpins both the safety of the marketplace and its relevance. The Content Understanding and Moderation charter covers representation, turning creatives and games into signals our models can use, and enforcement, detecting and acting on content that violates policy, regulation, or advertiser and publisher expectations. These are deliberately a single charter: the same multimodal understanding that improves relevance is what makes moderation possible at scale.

The Role

We are seeking a senior machine learning engineer to define how Unity understands and moderates the content flowing through its ad network. You will work closely with a world-class modeling team to power the recommendation for billions of users, while keeping them safe from bad content.

What You'll Do

Execute on the multimodal content representation strategy across video, image, playable, audio, and text, so that one set of foundations serves both relevance and moderation rather than two divergent stacks
Partner with product, engineering, science teams to translate regulatory and contractual obligations into objectives an ML system can be measured against
Define what good looks like where labels are scarce, noisy, and genuinely contested, and build the evaluation and labeling infrastructure that makes it measurable
Build the shared foundations other teams depend on, including content embeddings, game level features, evaluation harnesses, and labeling pipelines

What We're Looking For

Experience in multimodal machine learning combining vision and language, with video experience especially relevant
Experience owning a trust and safety, content moderation, brand safety, or policy enforcement system in production, where being wrong in either direction carried real consequences
Experience operating where labels are scarce, ambiguous, or disputed, and where the definition of a violation shifts over time
Experience adapting foundation models for production use, including fine-tuning, distillation, and optimization for latency and cost
Strong programming skills in Python and experience running production ML systems on a serving path, with fluency in latency, throughput, and cost tradeoffs
Experience reviewing and remaining accountable for production code, including code produced with AI assistance

You might also have (optional)

Familiarity with regulatory and policy regimes affecting advertising content, such as DSA, child-directed treatment, and regional advertising standards
Strong systems thinking, with the ability to reason about performance, scalability, reliability, and cost tradeoffs in distributed systems

Base Salary Range: ¥341,000 - ¥943,000 CNY gross

This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in our company incentive plans (such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions). The final offer amount will depend on several factors, including geographic location and the candidate's relevant experience, professional background, and skill set.

Life at Unity

Unity [NYSE: U] is the world's leading game engine, powering play for more than 3 billion consumers each month. The top mobile games in the world, the most played PC indie titles, the most innovative console games, and virtually all of the top XR and Web Games are developed, deployed, and grown in Unity. Unity also enables teams across industries like automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare to design, simulate, and collaborate in 3D — closing the gap between ideas and reality.

jobs.title: Senior AI Inference Infrastructure Software Engineer (MJ000579)
jobs.location_raw: 中国 北京市 北京市
jobs.description:
该职位来源于猎聘。About the Role: Own and advance the core of AI inference infrastructure — systems that serve large models at scale (inference only, no training). Set technical direction in one or more focus areas (inference serving, ML compilers, GPU kernels, communication libraries), ship high-impact performance work, make architectural decisions that move cluster-level inference cost and performance, from research idea down to PTX.

What You'll Do: Own a critical part of the stack end-to-end and drive its roadmap: Inference/serving: continuous batching, paged/prefix KV cache, speculative decoding, prefill/decode disaggregation, quantization (FP8/INT8/INT4). Compilers: MLIR/TVM/XLA/TorchInductor passes, fusion, layout selection, autotuning, codegen for GPUs/accelerators. Kernels: CUDA/CUTLASS/Triton, Tensor Cores (WMMA/WGMMA), FlashAttention-class kernels, Hopper/Blackwell features (TMA, warp specialization). Communication: NCCL internals, custom all-reduce/all-to-all, RDMA/InfiniBand, NVLink/NVSwitch topology, comm/compute overlap, tensor/pipeline/expert parallelism for inference. Deliver measurable wins in latency, throughput, cost, reliability at scale. Set engineering standards (perf reviews, benchmarking, regression gates). Mentor engineers; represent team in design reviews and optionally externally.

Minimum Qualifications: 7+ years building high-performance systems software. Expert-level C++ and CUDA; strong systems fundamentals. Deep expertise in at least one focus area and working knowledge of the others. Track record shipping performance-critical systems to production. Experience profiling and optimizing GPU workloads with measurable significant impact.

Preferred: High-QPS low-latency LLM inference serving at scale. Contributions to vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, Triton, CUTLASS, NCCL, PyTorch, MLIR/TVM/XLA. Low-precision (FP8/INT4) and modern GPU architectures (Hopper/Blackwell). Technical leadership/mentoring. MS/PhD in CS/CE or equivalent depth. Nice to have: publications/patents in ML systems/HPC; conference talks; experience bringing up new hardware or custom accelerators.

Offer: Ownership of frontier-scale AI infrastructure, senior-heavy team, real technical autonomy, highly competitive compensation with significant equity.

Your primary responsibility is to build production-ready "Golden Path" starter kits, develop reusable SDKs/frameworks for cross-cloud middleware compatibility, and partner directly with pilot product teams to refactor and onboard representative services. Cloud-Native & Kubernetes Fundamentals: Deep understanding of containerized application patterns on Kubernetes (stateless workload design, lifecycle probes, Gateway API, and service discovery).

Secret Management & Keyless Security: Familiarity with HashiCorp Vault, External Secrets Operator (ESO), and OIDC dynamic credential rotation. (Nice to have)

Participate in the formulation of technical specifications, development standards and interface specifications; perform code reviews, resolve technical difficulties and improve R&D quality. Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related majors; at least 5 years of Java back-end development experience, including minimum 3 years of Oracle EBS custom-development experience. jobs.description:
Job Type

Full Time

Job Reference #

City

Shanghai

Key Responsibilities

Experienced in writing low latency software stacks in Java for Electronic Trading for Cash Equities and FX.
Hands on Development for Client and Exchange Connectivity platform, Prop Algo trading, Regulatory Reporting gateways. Fully hands on role writing low latency code with emphasis on – using off-heap memory, producing less garbage, using object pools, avoiding unnecessary copying of data, lock free critical path.
Developed inhouse pure Java FIX Engine, sub 20 micro latency using Zero GC techniques and the reactor pattern. Developed lock free data structures to avoid locking in main loop. Utilized this to build a liquidity aggregator across multiple swap venues and provide a consolidated feed to Rates SOR using Chronicle Queues for IPC.
Lead development of prop algo trading systems –Built Algo Container using Java micro services/Lock Free processing/ Zero GC approach/ Chronicle Map for fast IPC. Utilized this to implement automated position trading strategy/ broker algo selection.
Led the design and development of a lightweight, headless OMS for Structured Derivatives, focused on separation of concerns, asynchronous processing, and clean code principles. Integrated seamlessly with multiple endpoints, incorporating compliance checks, position management, locates, order marking, limits, frontrunning prevention, and command/control. Built a fully automated end-to-end regression testing suite that significantly accelerated deployment cycles.
Hands on experience with SOR tactics, Agency Trading Algorithms, Agency Crossing – VWAP Cross, Mid/Passive/Aggressive Cross using Conditional and Firm orders as applicable.

The team

The CRB trading team is at the forefront of innovation in automated trading in cash equities and has a large mandate in the bank. We aim at maximizing automation and driving trading revenues. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.location_raw: 中国 广东省 深圳
jobs.description:
Company Overview
KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. KLA invests 15% of sales back into R&D.

岗位职责 / Responsibilities

设计、开发并维护面向 PCB 制造与几何处理场景的核心 DFM 软件模块，主要使用 C/C++。 Design, develop, and maintain core DFM software modules in C/C++ for PCB manufacturing and geometry-processing applications.
构建并持续增强可制造性分析、规则检查、补偿、优化与特征变换等算法能力。 Build and enhance algorithmic capabilities for manufacturability analysis, rule checking, compensation, optimization, and feature transformation.
将制造工艺知识和工程需求转化为可靠、可扩展、可维护的软件解决方案。 Translate manufacturing knowledge and engineering requirements into robust, scalable, and maintainable software solutions.
参与处理高几何复杂度的问题域，包括间距、净距、蚀刻补偿、过孔与焊盘处理、信号优化、铜面与表面处理等相关 DFM 工作流。 Work on geometry-heavy problem domains such as spacing, clearance, etch compensation, via and pad handling, signal optimization, copper and surface processing, and related DFM workflows.
持续提升大型长期维护型生产代码库的性能、稳定性和软件质量。 Improve system performance, stability, and software quality in a large, long-lived production codebase.
定位并解决算法、数据处理和工作流集成中的复杂技术问题。 Debug complex technical issues across algorithms, data handling, and workflow integration.
与领域专家、产品团队和其他工程师合作，定义需求、验证行为并交付可投入生产的功能。 Collaborate with domain experts, product teams, and other engineers.
参与代码评审、技术方案讨论、可测试性提升以及工程栈的持续演进与现代化。
支持边界场景和客户影响问题的分析与修复，强调根因定位与高可靠性交付。

Minimum Qualifications

计算机科学、软件工程、电子工程、数学或相关专业本科及以上学历。
5 年及以上软件开发经验，具备扎实的 C 和/或 C++ 实战开发能力。
在数据结构、算法以及面向性能敏感型系统的软件设计方面具备扎实基础。
有复杂工程软件、算法系统或几何密集型应用的开发或维护经验。
具备在大型代码库中进行复杂问题调试和根因定位的能力。
具备计算几何、规则处理、CAD/CAM/EDA 系统或类似技术领域经验者优先。
有 PCB、DFM、CAM、制造工程软件或其他工业/工程类软件背景者优先。
熟悉单元测试、回归分析、代码评审和受控发布等软件质量实践。
有在遗留系统与演进中架构并存环境下工作的经验。

个人能力要求

具备很强的分析思维，能够将复杂工程问题拆解为可落地的软件方案。
具备较强的责任心、主人翁意识和质量导向。
具备良好的沟通能力，能够与软件工程师及领域专家高效合作。
好奇心强、注重细节，愿意深耕技术复杂度高的问题领域。
具备务实的工程判断力，能够在正确性、性能、可维护性和交付效率之间做出合理权衡。

KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Beware of fraudulent job postings posing as KLA employees; KLA never asks for financial compensation. Confirm legitimacy via talent.acquisition@kla.com.

Required: 5+ years in DevOps, build or platform engineering; npm/pnpm for React/TypeScript; Maven/Gradle; production Terraform on AWS; Harness and/or GitHub Actions; Linux administration and scripting; Docker and Kubernetes/ECS/EKS; Git workflows. Preferred: regulated financial services experience; secrets management; security scanning tools (SonarQube, Black Duck, Checkmarx); Liquibase/Flyway; AWS/HashiCorp certifications.

jobs.title: Senior Performance Software Engineer, Deep Learning Libraries
jobs.description:
The place to find available career opportunities at NVIDIA for you and people you know. We are now looking for a Senior Performance Software Engineer for Deep Learning Libraries! Do you enjoy tuning parallel algorithms and analyzing their performance? If so, we want to hear from you! As a deep learning library performance software engineer, you will be developing optimized code to accelerate linear algebra and deep learning operations on NVIDIA GPUs. The team delivers high-performance code to NVIDIA's cuDNN, cuBLAS, and TensorRT libraries to accelerate deep learning models. The team is proud to play an integral part in enabling the breakthroughs in domains such as image classification, speech recognition, and natural language processing. Join the team that is building the underlying software used across the world to power the revolution in artificial intelligence! We're always striving for peak GPU efficiency on current and future-generation GPUs. To get a sense of the code we write, check out our CUTLASS open-source project showcasing performant matrix multiply on NVIDIA's Tensor Cores with CUDA. This specific position primarily deals with code lower in the deep learning software stack, right down to the GPU HW.

What You'll Be Doing

Writing highly tuned compute kernels to perform core deep learning operations (e.g. matrix multiplies, convolutions, normalizations)
Following general software engineering best practices including support for regression testing and CI/CD flows
Collaborating with teams across NVIDIA:
CUDA compiler team on generating optimal assembly code
Deep learning training and inference performance teams on which layers require optimization
Hardware and architecture teams on the programming model for new deep learning hardware features

What We Need To See

Masters or PhD degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Applied Math, or related field

jobs.title: Senior Compiler Performance Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Details

Job Description:

The Compiler Engineering team in Intel's Data Center Group is looking for talented and passionate senior compiler engineers.

At Intel, we are building the next generation of software technologies that unlock the potential of heterogeneous computing. Our compiler technologies help developers harness CPUs, GPUs, and accelerators through high-performance, portable software. You will contribute to an ecosystem that advances performance, scalability, reliability, and developer productivity for AI, HPC, and other demanding workloads, while supporting Intel's commitment to contributing to and collaborating with open-source communities.

The Intel Compiler Engineering team develops LLVM-based C, C++, SYCL, Triton, MLIR, Domain Specific Language (DSL), and Fortran compiler technologies for Intel processor platforms, including CPUs and GPUs. The team works across the compiler stack and in close collaboration with hardware architecture teams, covering language front ends, intermediate representations, optimization, code generation, debug information, runtimes, offload support, quality, and developer tooling. This work connects Intel hardware and compiler capabilities with AI frameworks and software ecosystems such as PyTorch, inference engines, and machine-learning models.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Compiler Engineer, you will play a critical role in advancing compiler technologies that deliver exceptional performance and scalability across Intel architectures. You will own problems end to end rather than tasks. You will:

Lead performance analysis of real-world applications, AI/HPC workloads, and industry benchmarks; identify bottlenecks spanning the compiler, runtime, libraries, and microarchitecture; and drive the work that closes the gap.
Identify, design, and productize compiler optimizations and code generation that expose new Intel CPU and GPU capabilities, taking features from prototype through to shipping quality.
Own performance for a compiler component or workload domain - set the targets, track them through continuous integration, and be accountable for both regressions and gains.
Advance heterogeneous and offload compilation across SYCL, OpenMP, Triton, MLIR, and DSL paths, improving portability without sacrificing performance.
Collaborate closely with hardware architecture teams to influence how future Intel silicon is defined and exposed through the compiler and language stack.
Contribute to and collaborate with upstream open-source communities: drive designs through public RFCs, upstream patches, and review community contributions.
Influence technical direction and architecture, review designs and code, and raise engineering standards across the team.
Mentor and coach junior engineers, and represent the team's work to partners, customers, and the broader ecosystem.

As a senior engineer you will have significant opportunity for technical depth and for shaping the vision of future compilers and software tools.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field with 5+ years of relevant industry experience; or a Bachelor's degree with 8+ years.
Strong knowledge base and hands-on experience in modern C++, data structures and algorithms, and compiler theory.
Production experience in at least one area of the compiler stack: middle-end optimization, backend code generation, language front end, or runtime and offload support.
Demonstrated experience in performance analysis and tuning of real-world applications on CPU and/or GPU.
Proven track record of analyzing and solving complex technical problems and delivering features through a full product cycle.
Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate technical details and concepts to engineers, architects, and stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Substantial experience with LLVM compiler infrastructure, including upstream contributions; experience with MLIR is a strong plus.
Deep knowledge of Intel x86 instruction set architecture and Advanced Vector Extensions, or of GPU architecture and execution models.
Experience with heterogeneous and parallel programming models - SYCL, OpenMP offload, Triton, OpenCL, or CUDA.
Experience optimizing AI/ML workloads or integrating compiler technology with frameworks such as PyTorch and inference engines.

jobs.location_raw: 中国 北京市 北京市
jobs.description:
该职位来源于猎聘。岗位职责：1. 数字化系统开发：基于 Spring Boot 微服务框架，负责冶金生产企业软件研发：MES生产执行、能源碳排系统、质量管理系统、设备管理系统、IIOT平台以及AI应用等。2. 高并发接口实现：实现高吞吐量的数据采集与查询接口，应对车间级高频数据上报场景；参与系统性能压测与调优。3. 数据层优化：基于 PostgreSQL 编写高效的SQL及存储过程，处理复杂业务联表查询，制定索引策略以保障大数据量下的响应速度。4. 统一认证集成：负责与 SSO（单点登录）服务端对接，实现统一用户认证、权限拦截及会话管理功能。5. 业务组件沉淀：参与通用业务组件（如权限管理、报表引擎、规则引擎）的封装与维护，支撑前端应用的快速迭代。6. 项目实战交付：参与完整的制造业数字化项目，确保代码交付质量，配合架构师完成系统性能优化与问题排查。

任职要求：1. 经验背景：本科及以上学历，5年以上Java开发经验，至少深度参与过2个工业制造或企业级数字化项目，有冶金/有色加工行业经验者优先。2. 技术要求：扎实的Java基础，精通 Spring Boot、Spring Cloud、MyBatis等框架；精通 PostgreSQL 数据库，具备SQL调优、执行计划分析及分区表使用经验；熟悉Redis缓存及分布式锁应用；精通时序数据库（如InfluxDB）、非关系型数据库（如MongoDB）及对象存储（如MinIO）；具备高并发处理经验，熟悉线程池、连接池配置优化，有处理每秒数千级TPS接口的实际项目经验；熟悉 Kafka 消息队列，能够处理异步削峰填谷及系统解耦；了解微服务下的分布式事务解决方案（如Seata）。3. 安全认证：熟悉基于 SSO 的OAuth2.0/JWT鉴权流程，能安全实现前后端分离下的身份令牌管理。4. 工程素养：熟练使用Git、Maven/Gradle，熟悉Linux环境下的应用部署与日志排查。5. 业务理解力：能快速理解冶金/有色行业的特殊业务逻辑，并将其转化为技术实现。6. 语言能力：具备良好英语读写和听说能力，德语是加分项。7. 其他要求：具备良好的文档编写能力（系统设计文档、API接口文档、部署手册）；具备极强的跨部门沟通能力，能适应项目期间的现场调研、调试及频繁的团队协作。
jobs.notes: 西马克（冶金工业装备）北京的制造业数字化 Java 微服务岗：Spring Boot/Cloud + PostgreSQL/Kafka/时序库，做 MES、能源碳排、IIoT 平台，要求数千级 TPS 高并发经验。传统工业数字化方向，AI 仅涉及应用模块不算核心；资深岗 5+ 年判 senior，薪资 12-35K 中规中矩，来源猎聘、站外申请。

jobs.title: 高级Java工程师
jobs.description:
岗位职责

负责 aPaaS 平台开发者平台核心后端能力建设，覆盖开发态工具能力与运行时执行治理：

业务逻辑扩展引擎建设：平台级自定义业务逻辑扩展能力技术设计及开发，以支持开发者编写并运行基于业务对象、流程自动化等标准模块的扩展代码。
开发者 SDK 与工具链构建：开发平台SDK能力建设，为平台开发者提供稳定、易用、可扩展的工具集，包括数据 CRUD、HTTP 请求、异常处理、本地测试、基础工具接口及业务扩展接口封装，持续提升开发者开发效率。
平台高阶开发能力落地：研发并优化开发者所需的平台级基础服务，例如：十万至百万级数据处理接口（BatchJob）、异步任务调度（FutureTask）、租户级缓存服务及高并发场景下的分布式锁控制，租户级消息队列等。
开放平台与 API 网关研发：Open API 的统一管控入口迭代演进，包括 API 的注册与治理、动态路由分发、限流鉴权、熔断降级，以及多租户场景下的调用监控与全链路追踪。
运行时治理与稳定性保障：持续优化多租户场景下的 JVM 运行管控与租户隔离机制；负责租户维度的资源（CPU时间、内存）用量监控管控，租户级脚本执行治理、超时控制等，保障多租的公平性，安全性及可靠性。
技术攻坚与系统演进：承担核心服务架构设计、技术方案设计，负责开发平台高并发、大流量场景下的性能调优，线上问题定位、容量评估和稳定性治理，持续优化所负责模块的系统架构。
研发规范建设：制定并优化现有研发规范、接口规范、设计规范和开发文档，进行核心代码评审，并指导初中级工程师解决关键技术问题。

任职要求

基本要求：
1.本科及以上学历（211或以上优先），计算机相关专业优先，6 年以上 Java 后端开发经验。
2.Java 基础扎实，熟悉 IO、多线程、并发编程、集合、网络编程、JVM 原理、类加载机制、内存模型和常见性能调优方法。
3.熟悉 Spring Boot、Spring Cloud、Spring MVC、MyBatis 等主流 Java 技术栈，理解常用框架核心原理，具备复杂系统设计和落地能力。
4.熟悉分布式系统设计，理解高并发、高可用、缓存、消息、限流、熔断、降级、链路追踪和可观测性建设。
5.具备元数据驱动系统设计或研发经验，理解元数据模型、配置化能力、动态解析机制、元数据版本管理、多租户元数据隔离等设计方法。
6.有复杂企业级业务系统、平台型产品、SaaS、aPaaS、CRM、低代码平台或开发者平台任一方向的开发经验。
7.具备 AI 驱动研发能力，能够熟练使用 AI 工具完成需求分析、技术设计、代码开发、代码重构、单元测试、开发测试和问题排查，并能推动团队 AI 实践。

素质要求：
1.优秀的工程质量意识，重视代码可维护性、接口设计、异常处理、日志规范、测试覆盖率和系统可观测性。
2.良好的平台化思维，能够从能力复用、开发者体验、系统治理和长期演进角度进行技术实现和持续演进。
3.优秀的Owner 意识：具备"把事情做成、做好"的强烈内驱力，保障端到端的整体运行效果，主动关注并推进线上稳定性、性能问题、偶发问题和历史技术债务的解决，并推动体系化预防机制的建立。
4.良好的沟通协作能力，能够推动跨团队协作，并通过技术文档、Code Review 和方案评审等各类方法的综合运营，不断提升团队研发质量。

具备以下条件者优先
1.底层技术：熟悉 JVM 运行时治理、类加载隔离、安全沙箱执行、线程模型、内存管控、CPU 时间控制等底层机制，并有相关平台化落地经验者优先。
2.多租户架构实战经验：具备大规模多租户 SaaS / PaaS / aPaaS 平台的开发经验，熟悉租户数据隔离、资源隔离、流量调度与精细化管控者优先。
3.扩展机制开发加分：开发过通用 SDK、开发者工具、脚本执行引擎、插件化架构者优先。
4.流程引擎加分：熟悉 BPMN 2.0 规范，具备 Camunda 或 Flowable 等开源流程引擎源码级改造、内核深度定制及运行时版本迁移经验者优先。
jobs.notes: 销售易（Neocrm，腾讯系 CRM）aPaaS 开发者平台高级 Java 岗：扩展引擎、SDK 工具链、多租户 JVM 治理、API 网关、Camunda/Flowable 流程引擎；明确要求熟练用 AI 工具驱动研发（AI 辅助开发，非大模型建模）。senior 依据 title+6 年要求。亮点：低代码/aPaaS 平台架构纵深；风险：月薪 30-40K 偏低、现场办公。

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.company: 阿斯麦（上海）光刻设备科技有限公司
jobs.description:
Introduction to the job

Are you motivated by solving complex software and computer-related problems on advanced e-beam machines? Do you enjoy applying solid computer science fundamentals to diagnose real-world machine issues, improve system reliability, and support critical products used by customers worldwide? We are looking for a Software Engineer with a strong foundation in computer science and hands-on software engineering skills to join the Diagnostics Tooling group. In this role, you will help diagnose, investigate, and resolve software and computer-related issues observed on customer e-beam machines, while designing and developing software tools that improve troubleshooting efficiency, automate diagnostics workflows, and strengthen our overall machine diagnostics capability. You will work closely with equipment specialists, architects, product owners, and stakeholders across multiple domains to analyze complex problems, identify root causes, and deliver reliable, maintainable software improvements.

Role and responsibilities

As a Software Engineer in D&E, you will act as a software expert for software and computer-related diagnostics on e-Beam machines. You will analyze issues reported by Field team from customer sites, provide technical feedback and troubleshooting guidance, and develop software tools and test applications that improve diagnostics efficiency and support internal module validation.

Your responsibilities include:

Acting as a D&E software expert for software and computer-related issues reported by Field from customer e-beam machines
Analyzing Field feedback, diagnosing symptoms, identifying possible root causes, and providing practical troubleshooting recommendations
Developing software tools to reduce the effort and complexity for Field engineers when investigating software, computer, and machine-related problems at customer sites
Building diagnostics and automation tools for log collection, system health checks, issue reproduction, data analysis, and root cause investigation on e-beam machines
Supporting the development of internal D&E module test software, including software for module communication, test execution, result analysis, and validation workflows
Contributing to software solutions involving module communication interfaces, image processing workflows, and image algorithm validation where applicable
Working closely with Field team, equipment specialists, architects, and software teams to translate technical problems into maintainable software solutions
Writing clean, maintainable, and well-tested code for diagnostic tools, test utilities, backend components, and integration software
Continuously improving diagnostics workflows, tool usability, and knowledge transfer between D&E and Field teams
Collaborating effectively across D&E, Field, application, and equipment domains to drive customer-impacting issues toward resolution

Education and experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation, or equivalent
At least 5 years of professional software development experience, preferably in equipment, diagnostics, automation, test software, or engineering tool development
Strong hands-on programming experience with Python and C++
Experience with at least one GUI framework or library, such as Qt, PySide, WinForms, WPF, or similar
Experience or exposure to image algorithms, image processing, general algorithms
Familiarity with computer and equipment interfaces such as RS232, Ethernet, PCIe, and related communication concepts
Basic understanding of Windows and Linux driver concepts, device communication, and system-level troubleshooting

Skills Essential:

Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills for software and computer-related issues on complex equipment
Ability to analyze logs, system behavior, communication traces, diagnostic data, and issue reproduction results
Ability to translate Field-reported customer-site issues into actionable technical investigation plans
Good software design and implementation skills for diagnostic tools, test utilities, automation tools, and integration software
Good understanding of operating systems, networking, device communication, and equipment integration troubleshooting
Experience with Git-based development workflows for engineering software or internal tools
Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to Field, DnE, application, and equipment stakeholders

Nice to have

Experience with e-Beam, semiconductor equipment, motion systems, imaging systems, or other high-tech equipment
Experience with image processing, image algorithm validation, motion control diagnostics, or module-level test software
Experience with equipment communication protocols, hardware interfaces, or module-level integration
Experience with remote troubleshooting, log analysis platforms, diagnostic automation frameworks, or customer escalation support

Personal skills

Curious and analytical problem solver who enjoys investigating complex technical issues
Able to understand system interactions across software, computer, communication, and equipment domains
Takes ownership and drives issues from investigation to practical resolution
Comfortable working with ambiguity in a fast-paced engineering environment
Communicates clearly and collaborates effectively across Field, DnE, application, and equipment teams
Team player who shares knowledge and supports continuous improvement
Open to AI-assisted development, open-source technologies, and new engineering practices

What success looks like

Within this role, you are expected to become a trusted software expert for diagnostics-related software and computer issues on e-beam machines by:
Providing clear and practical technical feedback for Field-reported customer-site issues
Developing useful software tools that reduce troubleshooting effort and improve diagnostics efficiency
Supporting internal module test software development for module communication, image algorithm validation, and related engineering workflows
Improving knowledge sharing and issue resolution efficiency between DnE and Field teams
Building a strong understanding of e-beam machine software, computer systems, and module-level interactions
jobs.notes: ASML 经猎聘渠道的 e-beam 设备诊断软件岗（与 4469106611 同方向，经验要求降为 5 年+且公开月薪 30-50K）：Python/C++/Qt、图像处理、RS232/PCIe 接口、日志与根因分析。不涉大模型/Agent。亮点：薪资透明、半导体设备龙头稀缺岗；风险：招聘实体为上海子公司、现场办公、偏设备支持方向。

Pre-sales technical consultation. Solution architecture design and software development: understand digital solution architecture principles; use one or more programming languages (C#, .NET, Python, Java, JavaScript) to develop basic software; good at leveraging AI technology to assist solution design, software development, technical problem-solving, and documentation. English written and oral communication. Can adapt to business trips.

Job Title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer

You will be responsible for the design, development, integration, and verification validation of embedded firmware for innovative Oral Healthcare products.

Your Role

Design, develop, test, and maintain firmware for MCU-based embedded systems used in oral healthcare and personal health products.
Develop firmware modules for motor control, sensors, user interfaces, BLE communication, RFID, data storage, and power management.
Independently own firmware modules from requirement analysis through validation development, verification and product release.
Participate in firmware architecture definition and software design reviews.
Collaborate with Electrical, Mechanical, Software, App, Test, Quality, and Manufacturing teams to ensure successful product integration.
Support app-level integration, system verification, and firmware verification validation activities.
Conduct root-cause analysis and drive resolution of firmware issues throughout development, verification, and mass production.
Lead Support cybersecurity implementation, risk management and product compliance activities.
Contribute to technical decision-making and continuous improvement of software development practices.
Support global collaboration and occasional travel to suppliers or manufacturing sites (up to 20–30%).

You're The Right Fit If

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related disciplines.
Minimum 8 years of embedded software or firmware development experience in consumer electronics, smart devices, IoT products, or medical devices.
Strong expertise in Embedded C/C++ development.
Hands-on experience developing firmware on MCU platforms.
Solid understanding of UART, SPI, I²C, GPIO, ADC, PWM, and related hardware interfaces.
Experience with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) development and debugging.
Knowledge of RFID, data storage, user interface firmware, and wireless communication technologies.
Familiarity with RTOS architecture and multitasking systems.
Experience with motor and pump control systems and battery management for low-power platforms.
Understanding of firmware architecture and system integration.
Experience working through the full product development lifecycle from concept to mass production.
Strong debugging, analytical, and root-cause analysis skills.
Good knowledge of embedded cybersecurity principles.
Strong ownership and ability to independently drive module delivery.
Effective communication skills in both English and Chinese.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with TI or ST BLE stacks.
Experience in algorithm development, signal processing, or control logic.
Experience with Python and software test automation.
ISO13485 knowledge or experience.
Knowledge of AI tools, Python for code development and test automation or data analysis.

About Philips
Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? If you're interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.description:
General Summary: Qualcomm Cloud AI is seeking an experienced AI Compiler & Kernel Engineer to develop and optimize high-performance AI operators for large-scale cloud inference workloads. You will work across model, compiler, runtime, and hardware layers to maximize inference performance while minimizing memory footprint and resource utilization on Qualcomm Cloud AI platforms.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop and optimize AI kernels and operators for Qualcomm Cloud AI platforms. Enable and optimize LLM, MoE, and multimodal models for large-scale cloud inference. Drive accuracy, performance and efficiency optimizations across the software stack. Improve model memory footprint and ROM/RAM efficiency through kernel, graph, and compiler optimizations. Collaborate with performance and modeling teams to deliver best-in-class inference efficiency. Analyze and resolve performance bottlenecks using profiling, benchmarking, and modeling methodologies.

Required Qualifications:
Master's degree or above in CS/AI/Math/EE or related fields. 5+ years of experience in Cloud AI inference, kernel/operator development, or AI compiler technologies. Good verbal and written English communication skills for global collaboration. Proficiency in C++, Python, and Linux development environments. Deep understanding of Transformer architectures, such as LLMs, MoE, and modern foundation models. Strong experience with compiler technologies such as MLIR, Triton, TVM, or similar frameworks, including graph transformation, operator lowering, scheduling, operator fusion, kernel auto-tuning, code generation and memory scheduling. Strong experience with parallel computing architectures and performance optimization techniques, including vectorization, tiling, memory hierarchy optimization, and workload scheduling. Strong experience with graph optimization, model accuracy validation, performance optimization, and memory optimization.

Preferred Qualifications:
Experience optimizing transformer-related operators such as Attention, FlashAttention, KV Cache, Embedding, GEMM, Softmax, and MoE routing is highly desirable. Hands-on experience developing custom operators and high-performance kernels, either manually or through compiler frameworks such as MLIR or Triton with AI accelerator platforms, such as GPUs, NPUs, TPUs, or custom AI hardware.
jobs.notes: 高通云 AI 推理内核/编译器工程师：开发并优化 LLM/MoE/多模态大模型推理算子，要求 MLIR/Triton/TVM 编译器栈与 C++/Python 能力，明确涉及 FlashAttention、KV Cache、GEMM 等大模型算子优化。深度涉及大模型推理与 AI 编译器，方向稀缺对口；按 5+ 年经验与 experienced 工程师定位判 senior。

General Summary:

Job Overview

Sensors‑based technology enables a wide range of applications, including navigation, gaming, advanced user interfaces, multimedia, and AR/VR experiences. This role offers hands‑on exposure to advanced sensor technologies used in smartphones, IoT devices, wearables, smart glasses, and other consumer electronics within the QCT Sensors Technology group.

We are seeking a hands-on Android XR Software Engineer to develop next-generation applications for AR glass form factors, enabling large-scale sensor data collection and sensors-based feature and context aware applications.

Initial Focus Areas Are:

Enable multi-device data collection across AR, mobile, and wearables
Develop AR glass context aware applications for early-stage platforms
Work with prototype hardware and evolving Android XR platforms

You will work on both early-stage hardware platforms and commercial devices, contribute to system design, and help bring innovative sensor-driven experiences from concept to commercialization.

The position spans the full product lifecycle—from research and development through validation and commercial deployment—and involves close collaboration with systems, software, and integration/test engineers within the QCT Sensors Technology group.

Job Responsibilities Include:

Design, develop and test Android XR applications for AR glasses, including:
Glass-resident applications (UI, voice prompts, sensor interaction)
Companion Android mobile applications for control, synchronization, and data logging
Real-time context state visualization
Voice-driven feedback and user interaction
Optimize applications for long-term stability, battery life and robustness in real-world environments.

Design and implement multi-device data collection systems enabling synchronized logging across AR glasses, smartphones, and wearable devices.
Develop scalable, production-quality applications using Kotlin/Java and Android SDK that follow industry‑standard design patterns, development methodologies, and deployment models.
Support integration of XR, wearable and mobile application in compliance with enterprise deployment and device management concepts, such as Android Enterprise, mobile device management (MDM), and mobile application management (MAM).
Design, implement, and test cross‑platform desktop tools with user interfaces (Windows and Linux) that interact with Android devices used for sensor data collection and user demonstrations, supporting workflows such as device control, data validation, visualization, and post‑processing, using languages such as Java, Kotlin, Python, C++, .NET, and C#.
Develop software on prototype and reference platforms covering mobile devices, wearables, and smart‑glasses form factors
Collaborate with global, cross‑functional teams to support the development and commercialization of sensor algorithms and features
Contribute to the design and evolution of end‑to‑end data processing pipelines, and monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing data workflows in production environments
Support internal data collection campaigns involving Qualcomm employees worldwide, including hands‑on participation in field data collection activities and resolving issues related to applications running in real-world environments on employees’ own devices
Support sensor feature commercialization across various form factors, including algorithm performance validation, customer data analysis, and direct customer triage support

The position is technology‑focused and involves participation in a broad range of sensor systems engineering activities within the Sensors Technologies group.

The role may involve occasional travel, physical or sports‑related activities, and handling of equipment with significant weight.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

2+ years of software engineering or related work experience in the following areas:

Strong hands‑on experience developing Android applications using Kotlin/Java and Android SDK, preferably with Android Studio (but not limited to it)
Proven ability to build production-quality mobile applications.
Strong object‑oriented programming skills in Java or Kotlin, with experience on multi-threaded, system-level application development.
Proficiency in developing system‑level applications and tools in C++ and Python for internal and customer‑facing use
Fluency with Git and GitHub
Ability to develop customer‑facing demo and test applications, including:
Rapid prototyping to support internal validation, trade‑show demonstrations, and customer trials
Delivering reliable, clear user experiences for non‑engineering audiences

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with strong written and verbal English proficiency
Detail-oriented with strong organizational and analytical skills, with the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast‑paced global team environment and coordinate across multiple stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

2+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas:

Previous experience with Android XR, AR/VR, Wear OS or embedded Android platforms.
Experience developing companion device systems (phone + XR/wearables).
Familiarity with enterprise deployment and device management concepts, such as Android Enterprise, mobile device management (MDM), and mobile application management (MAM), including tools like Intune.
Previous experience with React Native
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Experience developing applications for prototype or pre-commercial hardware
Ability to design UX for constrained interfaces (voice, minimal display, wearable/XR)
Experience developing desktop applications with graphical user interfaces (GUIs)
Ability to work effectively in a multi‑OS environment, including Linux and Windows

 Responsible for post-processing optimization of perception model outputs, including parking slots, object detection (OD) targets, and occupancy grid (OCC) results. Ensure stable target tracking, handle occlusion and target loss, and construct drivable areas.

 Optimize algorithm efficiency to meet computing power and real-time requirements on embedded platforms.


优化算法效率，满足嵌入式平台的算力和实时性要求；


 Define standards for perception post-processing algorithms and optimize interfaces.


负责感知后处理算法的规范定义和接口优化；

 Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Automation, or related fields.


本科及以上学历，计算机、电子工程、自动化等相关专业；


 Proficient in C++ programming, with a solid understanding of computer vision concepts.


熟悉C++编程，对计算机视觉相关知识有一定的理解；


 Experience in mass-production parking projects is preferred.


有泊车量产项目经验优先；


 Experience in multi-sensor fusion is a plus.


有多传感器融合经验加分；

We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. These tools help identify qualifications and experience that align with the role requirements. Please note that AI is used solely to support our recruiters. About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes - from emerging brands to Fortune 500s - use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The opportunity:

Flexport is a platform for global trade in an industry that comprises 12% of the global GDP. We are the first licensed freight forwarder and customs brokerage built around a modern tech stack.

Our engineers are top-notch software developers who love listening to the users, working as a team, and proactively taking the lead whenever necessary. The role involves learning the business of freight forwarding, modeling the work that people do to move freight, designing solutions to make it more efficient, and thinking innovatively to automate much of it. In this role, you will have an opportunity to own the design and development of key parts of our forwarding systems.

About the team:

We have multiple teams in Shanghai and Shenzhen working on a suite of core products and services that enable Flexport operation to scale, including Forwarding Application, Client Application, Shipper Application, WMS, Consol Planning Tool, Document Platform (AI empowered), Email Platform, Compliance Platform, Work Assignment Engine, Exception Management, AI Copilot, Insight Builder (AI Data Analytics) and so on.

In addition, we have a NAWS (Native AWS) team that develops infrastructure solutions for our products and services using the latest Infrastructure as Code (IaC) technology: CDKTF (Cloud Development Kit for Terraform). Our scope includes, but is not limited to, CI/CD, observability, DevX, data subsetting (TS3), IaC, template engines, and various open-source projects.

You will:

Build highly available, secure, distributed systems in a microservice architecture.
Build cutting edge infrastructure solutions to help improve development experience across the company.
Design, develop, test and maintain systems that represent the real-world intricacies of logistics entities, such as shipper, client, cargo, document, carrier, container, email etc.
Collaborate with some of the best engineers in the industry to work on complex business and technical problems.
Work closely with business partners and product managers to distill complex business problems into elegant technical solutions.
Build and launch products rapidly and incrementally. We ship to production dozens of times per day.

You should have:

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of experience writing software, and a strong engineering background.
2+ years of design and architecture knowledge as well as familiarity with object-oriented analysis and design patterns (OOA/OOD)
Knowledge of at least one programming language such as TypeScript, Ruby, C, C++, Java, or Kotlin
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field, or equivalent experience

Preferred Qualifications

A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.
Experience building large scale, high-performance systems in a complex, multi-tiered, distributed environment
Understanding of performance tradeoffs, load balancing and operational issues
Knowledge of professional software engineering practices & best practices for full software development life cycle
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as CDKTF, Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or similar.
Having basic concepts in AWS services, including IAM, EC2, ECS, S3, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, and VPC, or equivalent services from other cloud providers.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and monitoring/observability tools.
Ability to troubleshoot and optimize distributed systems and cloud deployments.

拳头游戏的工程师不仅在特定技术领域具备深厚的专业知识，也同样重视在更广泛、多样化的领域中工作的机会。作为一名软件工程师，您还将深入参与旨在增强团队凝聚力、实现跨团队目标的项目。您将主导游戏玩法功能的开发，并为其他工程师清晰地展示何为卓越的工程实践。

作为研发部门的一名Software Engineer, Services，您将运用自身在技术领域的精深知识，为拳头游戏激动人心的新作注入生命力。您将与产品负责人、设计师、艺术家及其他工程师在团队中紧密合作，共同探索产品的根本性问题，并打造出能将玩家的梦想变为现实的卓越体验。理想的候选人应充满热情、积极主动，并有志于引领该游戏领域的技术愿景。

岗位职责（Responsibilities）：


负责游戏服务端功能模块的开发与维护，保障服务稳定、高效与安全；
实现和优化服务端核心系统，包括用户数据、战斗逻辑等相关支撑模块；
持续改进服务端性能，定位并解决线上和测试环境中的技术问题；
参与服务端相关工具开发，提高开发与运维效率；
与客户端、策划等多团队协作，高效推动功能实现与体验落地；
跟踪主流服务端技术动态，并将优秀实践和新技术应用到项目中。


任职要求（Required Qualifications）：


本科及以上学历，2年以上服务端开发经验，计算机相关专业优先；
熟悉C++、Java或Golang等主流服务端编程语言，有扎实的编码和调试能力；
熟悉高并发、分布式系统、常用中间件（如消息队列、缓存、数据库等）的开发与优化；
能够独立负责细分模块或业务功能的开发、测试及维护；
具备良好的分析和问题定位能力，能高效响应并解决线上业务问题；
善于跨团队沟通与合作，把控开发进度，确保需求高质量落地；
有持续学习和自我提升意识，关注行业新技术动态。


加分项（Desired Qualifications）：


有客户端 / 服务端双端架构开发经验。
有 CI/CD 流水线经验（如 Jenkins）。
有容器化技术经验（如 Docker）。


用工性质：与专业人事服务公司 FESCO Adecco 签订劳动合同
jobs.notes: 拳头游戏未公开 R&D 新品的游戏服务端工程师，技术栈 C++/Java/Golang、高并发分布式、消息队列/缓存/数据库。seniority 依据：2 年以上服务端经验、独立负责模块，判为 mid。非 AI 岗位。亮点：Riot 新作 R&D 项目；风险：明确为合同制外包——与 FESCO Adecco 签订劳动合同而非 Riot 直签，且为转发帖。

You will deeply participate in the development of AI-driven intelligent banking core business systems, designing and implementing scalable microservices architectures to provide stable and reliable API support for frontend applications and AI services.

Key Responsibilities:
Lead the backend architecture design and development of the intelligent digital banking core business system. Design and implement high-concurrency, highly available microservices architectures to support financial-grade transaction processing. Collaborate with the AI team to build backend integration frameworks and data pipelines for AI model services. Develop core financial business logic, including account management, transaction processing, and risk control systems. Design and optimize database architectures to ensure data consistency and query performance. Write high-quality, maintainable code and establish robust unit testing and integration testing frameworks. Participate in system performance tuning, troubleshooting, and ensure stable system operation.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree or above in CS/SE or related fields. 3+ years of Java backend development experience with a solid programming foundation. Proficient in Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and other microservices frameworks. Familiar with NoSQL databases such as Elasticsearch and MongoDB. Skilled in PostgreSQL, Redis, and other database technologies, with database design and optimization capabilities. In-depth understanding of multi-threaded programming, JVM tuning, and distributed system design. Familiar with message queues (Kafka) and caching technologies (Redis). Experience in cloud-native development, with knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes. Excellent system analysis and problem-solving skills, with a strong commitment to code quality and best practices.

jobs.title: Middle/ Senior Backend Engineer (Golang&PHP)
jobs.description:
About Us

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

For more information, visit xsolla.com .

About You

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who is ambitious, undaunted by challenging tasks, and eager to grow to join our China Regional Engineering team. The best candidate will be someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and exceptionally dynamic setting and is excited to drive tailored solutions for our major partners in China through customized integration projects, localized product enhancements, and dedicated technical support to meet the unique needs of the local market.

Strong programming skills and a solid foundation in computer science are essential, along with experience in designing and developing large-scale distributed systems, with deep expertise in middleware such as message queues, Elasticsearch, Redis, and MySQL. The ability to think critically, solve complex problems, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams will be key to your success in this role.

If you’re passionate about working in the video game industry and delivering innovative payment solutions for the China market and love building scalable, high-performance backend systems that power game commerce at scale, we would love to hear from you!

Responsibilities


Design, implement, and optimize technical solutions based on the needs of users in the China region, continuously improving service performance and stability. 
Participate in research and discussions related to products in the gaming payment domain, and drive their implementation and promotion. 
Game industry experience required
On-site position only (remote work not available) 



Qualifications And Skills


Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field, with at least 3 years of backend development experience. 
Strong programming skills and a solid foundation in computer science, with familiarity in data structures and design patterns. 
Proficiency in at least one programming language (Go or PHP) and familiarity with relevant mainstream development frameworks. 
Experience in designing and developing large-scale distributed systems, with a deep understanding of middleware technologies such as message queues, Elasticsearch (ES), Redis, and MySQL, including their principles and optimizations. 
Excellent teamwork, communication skills, and a strong sense of responsibility. 
Strong problem-solving skills, clear logical thinking, and an ability to think critically, summarize, and synthesize information. 



Nice to Have


Experience working on cross-border or cross-cultural projects, particularly with Chinese partners or in the China market. 
Familiarity with the Chinese gaming industry ecosystem, including local payment channels, regulatory requirements, and player behavior. 
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Alibaba Cloud) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). 
Knowledge of gaming payment systems, virtual currency, and in-app purchase (IAP) workflows. 
Bilingual proficiency in English and Chinese to facilitate communication with regional partners. 



Job Description

This job description is intended to outline the general nature and level of work currently performed and is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications required.

Privacy Notice & Data Processing Consent

By submitting your application and uploading your resume/CV, you acknowledge and agree that Xsolla will process your personal information (including but not limited to your name, contact details, work experience, and educational background) for the purpose of recruitment, candidate evaluation, and internal record-keeping.

In accordance with the Personal Information Protection Law of the People's Republic of China (PIPL):

Purpose Limitation: Your data will only be used for current and future recruitment considerations within Xsolla.

Sensitivity: We will handle your personal information with a high duty of care.

Your Rights: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information, and to withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us.

If your application proceeds past the final interview stage, we may conduct a background check, subject to applicable laws and regulations, only after obtaining your separate written consent. Any such check will be strictly limited to information directly relevant to the employment relationship (e.g., educational background, employment history) and will comply fully with the PIPL. Your personal information will be used solely for recruitment and human resource management purposes, and we will implement rigorous security measures to protect your data.

Xsolla takes your privacy rights seriously. We are committed to protecting your personal information in accordance with Chinese data protection laws and will not sell, unlawfully provide, or disclose any personal data received during the hiring process without your explicit authorization. As a data processor, we uphold our obligations to safeguard your personal data and respect your privacy.

For any inquiries related to data privacy, please contact: [email protected]

Explore more opportunities at: https://xsolla.com/careers

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
jobs.notes: Xsolla（游戏支付/商务平台）中国区后端工程师，Go/PHP、消息队列/ES/Redis/MySQL、分布式系统，服务游戏支付本地化集成。标题 Middle/Senior 但仅要求 3 年经验，判为 mid（可覆盖到 senior 下沿）。不涉及 AI/Agent。注意：明确要求游戏行业经验且仅现场办公。

In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable software applications and AI-enabled solutions that drive business outcomes. You'll partner with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative products, enhance existing platforms, and build enterprise capabilities that enable the organization to leverage AI effectively and responsibly.

jobs.title: Service Engineer 2
jobs.description:
Overview

Make Bing Ads Technical Support at Microsoft Advertising part of your career story!

Microsoft Advertising helps advertisers connect with customers across search, browsing, shopping, gaming, and AI-powered experiences. It supports search, display, native, video, Connected TV, shopping, and AI-driven Advertising campaigns across Microsoft properties—including Bing, MSN, Outlook, Edge, Microsoft 365, and gaming—as well as partner networks.

We’re looking for an innovative Service Engineer II who enjoys building automation and full-stack tools while partnering closely with product engineering to improve reliability, quality, and customer experience on the Microsoft Advertising platform.

 

As a Service Engineer II, you will blend deep technical investigation with hands-on software development, often leveraging the latest AI-assisted development tools. You’ll build and maintain automation tools, diagnose complex issues across services and APIs, and partner with engineering teams to land fixes in production. The right candidate enjoys debugging distributed systems, writing clean, testable code, and iterating quickly based on data and customer impact.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50- mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25-mile commute of a non-U.S., country-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

Responsibilities


Perform deep technical investigations to solve complex reliability, performance, and data-quality issues across Microsoft Advertising platform, APIs, and customer workflows.
Design, build, and own AI-driven automation (scripts, services, and internal web tools) on an intelligent platform to modernize support workflows, with the goal of reducing time-to-diagnose, eliminating manual work, and improving operational efficiency at scale.
Write production-quality code; implement fixes, create monitoring/alerting improvements, and contribute to shared libraries and tooling via standard code review and CI/CD practices.
Drive root-cause analysis and post-incident follow-through (action items, automation, and engineering changes) in partnership with multiple Engineering teams.
Create and maintain automated test coverage (unit/integration/end-to-end) for key workflows; participate in bug bashes and release readiness activities.
Communicate clearly during live-site events: compose timely service alerts, share investigation status, and provide actionable guidance to stakeholders.
Analyze escalation data and trends to develop clear problem statements, propose engineering solutions, and influence product roadmaps to reduce escalations and product friction, ultimately increasing revenue.
Document knowledge base articles and build self-serve troubleshooting experiences for Tier 1/Tier 2 teams; mentor others on tools and debugging techniques.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:


Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or related field AND 2+ years technical experience in software engineering, network engineering, service engineering, systems engineering, or industrial controls
OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:


Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.


Preferred Qualifications


Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or related field AND 3+ years technical experience in software engineering, network engineering, service engineering, systems engineering, or industrial controls
OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or related field AND 5+ years technical experience in software engineering, network engineering, service engineering, systems engineering, or industrial controls
OR equivalent experience.
3+ years of technical experience in service engineering, software engineering, systems engineering, technical support, or a comparable engineering environment supporting online services, commercial platforms, or cloud services. 
Experience with Microsoft Advertising, ad tech, search, audience, retail media, display, video, reporting, conversion tracking, trust and safety, fraud, policy, or digital advertising support scenarios preferred. 
Experience designing, building, or improving automation, scripts, diagnostic workflows, dashboards, proactive checks, or alerting solutions that reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency. 
Proficiency with one or more programming or scripting languages such as Python, C#, JavaScript, PowerShell, Java, or similar languages used for automation, tooling, data analysis, or troubleshooting. 
Experience querying, analyzing, and visualizing large datasets using SQL or equivalent data platforms to identify trends, validate hypotheses, measure support impact, and generate actionable insights. 
Experience working with cloud, distributed systems, telemetry, monitoring, observability, or service health tooling, preferably in Azure or comparable cloud environments. 
Experience troubleshooting or integrating with modern web and API technologies, including REST, JSON, XML, authentication patterns, and related data exchange or platform integration scenarios. 
Experience using AI-assisted tools, Copilot-style workflows, or emerging automation capabilities to improve triage, investigation, summarization, knowledge discovery, or support productivity. 
Solid written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including customers, partners, engineering teams, and leadership stakeholders. 
Solid documentation and knowledge-management skills, including experience producing troubleshooting guides, diagnostic playbooks, case notes, bug reports, readiness materials, or technical training content. 
Ability to collaborate across remote, global, and cross-functional teams, influence through technical evidence, and operate effectively in ambiguous situations with solid ownership and judgement. 
Customer-focused, anticipating, resolving, and responding to customer and ecosystem needs.
Must possess solid English language skills (speaking, reading, writing, presenting) and ability to give instructions and directions, document, present, and communicate complex technical issues to both technical experts and non-technical audiences at all levels within organisations.
Occasional night and weekend on-call work.
