jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Software Engineer III - EA Enterprise Intelligence

The Challenge Ahead

Join our central engineering team to build the next-generation Lifecycle Management (LCM) Experimentation & Analytics Platform that powers live services across 20+ world-class game studios and millions of daily active players.

In this role, you sit at the high-impact intersection of Software Engineering, Data Science, Data Analytics, and Data Engineering. You will act as the primary platform bridge: taking cutting-edge statistical methodologies, experimentation designs (A/B/n testing, multi-armed bandits, variance reduction), and advanced analytics frameworks developed by our DS and DA teams, and transforming them into scalable, robust, and reusable platform services.

If you are an engineer who loves data, understands statistical / ML logic, and takes pride in building scalable, resilient, self-serve platform products, this is the role for you.

You will report to the Technical Director of Enterprise Insights Engineering.

Responsibilities


You will build configuration dashboards that empower game studio teams to launch and evaluate experiments independently.
You will develop and maintain low-latency APIs and microservices for real-time experiment assignment and player targeting at scale.
You will develop contextual analytics systems (batch and real-time processing pipelines) that inform on important metrics, detect anomalies, and forecast future results.
You will partner closely with DS, DA, and DE teams to platformize, package, and automate statistical or Machine Learning methodologies (e.g., A/B/n testing, variance reduction, causal inference, and metrics calculation).
You will standardize behavioral event schemas, configuration models, and metadata contracts across diverse game titles.
You will promote the value of the LCM platform, by providing in-depth data insights into players' engagement with content across live channels.


Qualifications


Master's degree or foreign degree equivalent in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in software development building data-intensive systems, distributed backend services, or platform APIs.
Strong experience collaborating with Data Science, Data Analytics, or Machine Learning teams to productionize analytical models or algorithms.
Solid conceptual understanding of A/B testing, hypothesis testing, and core statistical mechanisms. Experience with machine learning is required.
Expertise in Python and at least one compiled language (such as Java, Go, or Scala), along with advanced SQL skills.
Experience with distributed data frameworks (like Spark or Trino) and modern Lakehouse/Data Warehouse solutions (like Snowflake, Databricks, or Redshift).
Familiarity with cloud services (AWS preferred), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and pipeline workflow orchestrators (like Airflow).
Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication across regions/time zones.
Gaming industry experience or familiarity with game telemetry data is a strong plus.
Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional environment, with strong English communication skills to participate in international meetings, collaborate with global teams, and prepare clear and professional documentation in English.


About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering or equivalent experience.

jobs.title: APAC Agentic Data Cloud Architect, Google Cloud
jobs.description:
Note: Google will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require Google's sponsorship of a visa.

The Google Cloud APAC Agentic Data Cloud Architect team is a specialized team that guides customers in choosing, designing and accelerating adoption of Google Cloud's unified Data Cloud and AI capabilities. The team bridges the gap between platform primitives across data analytics, databases and storage, and the cohesive, high-value solutions enterprises demand. This group operates as a customer-zero laboratory, embedding deeply with lighthouse customers to co-develop breakthrough solutions, then translating engagements into scalable assets: validated product prototypes to engineering and repeatable go-to-market blueprints to the field.

Responsibilities
- Serve as the primary technical partner to customer CTOs and chief architects, leading high-stakes workshops to align their technology roadmap with Google's Data and AI strategy.
- Act as principal architect for Google's Agentic Data Cloud, setting engineering standards, winning complex workloads, and accelerating adoption across lighthouse engagements from evaluation through ramp.
- Capture repeatable patterns to build scalable Golden Path blueprints, reference architectures, and field-ready assets that drive broad adoption across thousands of customers.
- Synthesize customer friction points and cross-product gaps into authoritative engineering requirements to shape Google's unified Data and AI narrative.
- Mentor and guide subregional Datacloud Customer Engineers, remaining the experience for critical architectures while directing the team to deliver secure, scalable solutions.

Minimum qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
- 10 years of experience delivering data and analytics solutions in a customer-facing or support role.
- Experience building and deploying enterprise Generative AI applications and agentic workflows integrated with modern data platforms.
- Experience architecting distributed data systems (Lakehouse, Data Mesh), batch and streaming pipelines (Spark, Flink, BigQuery, Iceberg), and transactional databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, NoSQL).
- Experience in cloud-native data warehousing, ETL/ELT pipelines, real-time event streaming, governance, and end-to-end migrations.
- Experience partnering with, influencing, and presenting architectures to executive leaders and technical stakeholders.

Preferred: C-level interaction (CTO/CDO/CIO); knowledge of emerging agentic technologies; proficiency writing/refactoring/debugging Python, PySpark, SQL; ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow); distributed systems, data platforms, and AI/ML architectures at enterprise scale.

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description:
How you'll make impact
As a Staff AI Engineer, you'll define the technical direction for next-generation AI solutions that improve internal efficiency and transform how customers interact with Airwallex. You'll design and implement robust APIs and system architectures for AI applications, including agentic experiences, language-model-powered workflows, search and data analysis systems. You'll shape AI application roadmaps, research and apply emerging technologies, and partner with diverse cross-functional teams to turn product goals into reliable systems. You'll also help resolve application issues and software bugs with prompt, effective solutions while maintaining a high bar for customer experience.

You'll work from our Singapore office five days a week.

What we're looking for
Essentials
10+ years of experience in backend software development, with a passion for AI and language technologies.
A proven track record of delivering major impact.
Proficiency in Python, TypeScript or JavaScript.
Experience designing and developing large-scale distributed systems with high concurrency, high load and high availability.
Experience working with vector databases.
A relevant degree in Computer Science, Mathematics or a related field.

Preferred
Familiarity with MLOps practices and deployment pipelines for AI-driven products.

Learn more about your team
AI at Airwallex is building the path from financial software to autonomous finance. At the center of this vision is Kai, Airwallex's AI assistant and the intelligent interface to our global financial platform. Kai connects AI with capabilities across payments, accounts, transfers, cards, expenses, and other financial workflows—enabling customers to describe what they want to achieve while the system handles more of the complexity underneath.

You'll build intelligent financial products and autonomous agents that understand business context, plan and reason across multi-step workflows, execute actions within clearly defined controls, and learn from outcomes. The work spans agent architecture, orchestration, context and knowledge systems, ontology, evaluation, governance, monitoring, and reliability.

The challenge is uniquely demanding: AI systems are probabilistic, while moving money requires precision, permissions, auditability, deterministic controls, and regulatory compliance. You'll help define where AI should reason and where financial infrastructure must remain deterministic—turning frontier models into safe, controllable systems that businesses can trust.

Join exceptional engineers advancing Kai from assistance to action and, ultimately, toward autonomous finance—where customers define the outcome they want and intelligent systems securely execute more of the work required to achieve it.
jobs.notes: Airwallex Staff AI Engineer：为其 AI 助手 Kai 构建自主金融 agent（agent 架构/编排/评估/治理），概率性 AI 与金融确定性控制的平衡是核心挑战。标题 Staff + 10+ 年后端经验，判为 staff。仅 18 人申请、一周前发布，竞争窗口好；要求每周 5 天到新加坡办公室。

jobs.title: Agentic AI Engineer (Xora Portfolio Company)
jobs.description:
About Elemynt
ELEMYNT is an early-stage startup built by Xora Innovation. We develop applied intelligence that brings AI into the real world. Our platform combines advanced machine learning, high-performance simulation, and modern software engineering to accelerate the design, validation, and deployment of new materials. Our work sits at the intersection of AI, physics, and large-scale computation.

About The Role
This role builds the layer every LLM-powered feature on our platform is built on: one interface over many model providers, the agent orchestration that runs multi-step workflows, the retrieval and prompt systems that ground them, and the tracing and evaluation that keep them honest. It is foundational and deeply hands-on.

In this role, you'll design agents that plan, call tools, and reason over the results, then make them dependable in production: traceable, evaluated, and safe to run with a person in the loop where it counts. Because the platform runs inside customers' own secure environments, on their compute clusters, in their cloud, or across a hybrid of the two, the reasoning it produces has to stay auditable and its guardrails have to travel with the software.

What You Will Do
Build the provider abstraction that lets any workflow call, swap, or add a model provider by configuration, across commercial APIs and self-hosted endpoints, with structured-output validation, retries, and cost tracking.
Build the agent orchestration where a planning agent dispatches specialized sub-agents in parallel on a stateful framework, with durable checkpoints, conditional branching, and the context and memory management that keeps multi-step workflows coherent across long task horizons.
Build human-in-the-loop checkpoints so low-confidence or high-stakes steps route to a person before an agent proceeds.
Wrap existing platform capabilities as typed, registered tools the agents call, with a clean boundary between the agent layer and the systems it builds on.
Design retrieval end to end, from ingestion, embeddings, and chunking through hybrid search and reranking, and assemble the context that grounds each model call.
Build the prompt layer: versioned prompts, few-shot sets, and captured reasoning, so every change is tracked and every call is inspectable.
Expose agents and guardrailed model access as tools behind one integration point that backend services, the frontend, and notebooks all consume.
Instrument every model call, tool invocation, and agent run as traced spans with prompt, model, and tool lineage, so behavior and cost stay debuggable.
Build the evaluation framework, deterministic trace metrics alongside LLM-as-judge scoring for faithfulness, that gates changes and catches regressions before they ship.

What We Are Looking For
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related engineering field, and 5+ years building and shipping production software, with real depth building LLM or agent systems in production.
Strong Python and solid engineering practice: async code, typing, testing, modular design, and code review, plus a track record of shipping systems others depend on.
Hands-on experience building agentic or LLM systems in production: orchestration loops, tool-calling, structured outputs, and context and memory management for reliable long-running workflows.
Experience working across multiple model providers behind a single abstraction, with routing, fallback, and a feel for the cost and latency trade-offs.
Experience building retrieval systems end to end: embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, reranking, and vector databases.
Experience with LLM evaluation and guardrails: building eval sets and harnesses, LLM-as-judge scoring, regression gating, and output-quality and safety checks.
Experience instrumenting LLM systems for observability: tracing model and tool calls, versioning prompts, and using traces to debug and improve real behavior.
Comfort owning ambiguous systems end to end in a fast-moving early-stage environment.

NICE TO HAVE
Stateful agent-orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph or AutoGen, and durable-execution engines such as Temporal for long-running workflows.
Experience building MCP tools or servers, or similar tool-calling integration layers.
LLMOps and evaluation tooling such as MLflow or Langfuse for tracing, prompt versioning, and evaluation.
Human-in-the-loop and interrupt-driven agent patterns for review and control.
Applying LLMs to scientific or technical workflows, grounding reasoning in tool outputs and structured data.

LOCATION
Singapore or United States. We're hiring in both to reach the right person. Work model is on-site or hybrid, set per location.
jobs.notes: Xora Innovation（淡马锡关联深科技 VC）孵化的早期创业公司 Elemynt，做材料设计的 AI 平台。岗位是 agent 基础设施层：provider 抽象、LangGraph/Temporal 编排、HITL、MCP 工具、Langfuse 评估追踪——本批 JD 质量最高之一。要求 5+ 年生产软件+LLM/agent 系统深度经验，判为 senior。新加坡或美国均可，早期-stage 风险与股权上行并存。Easy Apply，申请人数少（15）。

jobs.title: AI Reimagination Engineer
jobs.description:
As an AI Reimagination Engineer in Micron's Generative AI Center of Excellence (GenAI COE), you have an outstanding chance to transform how businesses function. You will partner with different business areas to break down large, manual, multi-step processes and redesign them into effective, autonomous systems. This position combines process reimagination with AI systems engineering, making you a key part of the transformation journey. You will collaborate closely with the GenAI COE, IT architecture, security, and project teams. You will lead projects from the initial redesign to the final build, delivering solutions that business teams can adopt and scale.

Responsibilities
Decompose end-to-end processes: Map current-state flows, quantify effort and risk, and lead eliminate/simplify/agentify analysis before automation.
Architect the agentic solution: Build future-state flows and AI architecture, including task and agent decomposition, orchestration patterns, tool and data access, memory and context strategy, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Translate inventions into buildable solutions by developing agent workflows, composing prompt and context strategies, MCP/connector and integration requirements, and evaluation criteria. Follow Micron's "Secure by Design" and data-classification standards.
Prototype and build: Construct working agentic solutions, or direct their build with platform engineers, validating fit and value prior to full delivery.
Engineer trust and control: Define testable human-in-the-loop controls and least-privilege permissions for each process step.
Drive multi-functional delivery: Collaborate across the client function, IT architecture, security, platform engineers, and the Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) through first production release.
Measure value and codify patterns: Capture value baselines during discovery, support 30/90-day post-release measurement, and turn findings into reference flows, decomposition patterns, and playbooks. Mentor engineers and grow the network of agentic champions.

Minimum Qualifications
Education: Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, AI/ML, engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience blending technical delivery with business process work.
Hybrid Experience: Proven track record in both decomposing complex business processes and crafting or building technical solutions.
Agentic Delivery: 8+ years of overall experience and 3+ years in AI/ML. Recently, hands-on experience building agentic or LLM-based systems.

Preferred Qualifications
Process Redesign: Experience leading workshop-based process redesign and translating findings into requirements. Familiar with AI governance, responsible-AI, security fundamentals, and validation/testing strategies for autonomous behavior.
Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with enterprise AI and automation platforms, and proficiency across Python, .NET/C#, SQL, and APIs. Depth in agent orchestration and multi-agent development, context management, and long-horizon tasks.
Communication: Excellent facilitation, written, and executive interpersonal skills. Proficient in running discovery with business leaders and driving alignment across business, engineering, and risk teams.
jobs.notes: 美光 GenAI COE 的业务流程 agent 化改造岗：agent 编排、多 agent 开发、MCP/connector、HITL 控制、记忆与上下文策略，Python/.NET/C#/SQL。要求 8+ 年总体经验、3+ 年 AI/ML，判为 senior。偏企业流程重塑+架构，非纯模型岗。JD 未提新加坡工作权限制。

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Team
OpenAI's Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

About The Role
As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Minimum Qualifications

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer, Scribe
jobs.description:
Clickstream Intelligence Platform (Scribe) is Grab's in-house app instrumentation and insights platform. It captures and processes user clickstream activity across all Grab apps at petabyte scale, and powers observability, experimentation, real-time personalisation and business analytics. Through Project MEGA, Scribe has moved from a passive event transport layer to a platform that enforces typed, validated event schemas at the point of instrumentation, and is now building a governed clickstream data layer, self-serve funnel analytics and agent-assisted instrumentation tooling on top of it. The team is based in Singapore and Ho Chi Minh City and works closely with Mobile Platform, Product Analytics, Data Warehouse and Developer AI teams.

We are looking for a Technical Lead for the Scribe backend team with breadth across the following technical stacks:
- Web Portal: React.js and Golang backend.
- Ingestion and Streaming: high-throughput Go gateway services, Kafka, Apache Flink.
- Data Processing / Storage: Apache Spark, Trino, StarRocks, Hive, Iceberg / Delta Lake on AWS.
- Applied AI: LLM agents for code migration and spec generation, MCP servers, Python backend.

You will set the technical direction for the platform, own its architecture, cost and reliability, and mentor a team of senior engineers and interns. You will report to the Engineering Manager in Singapore and work onsite at Grab's Singapore office (One-North).

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
- Own the architecture and roadmap of Scribe's backend: ingestion gateway, event-lifecycle services (specs, ownership, versioning, deprecation), streaming and data-lake pipelines, and the APIs behind the Scribe Portal and Scribe MCP.
- Lead Project MEGA to completion as business-as-usual: typed specs, producer-side validation, CI guardrails, and agent-driven migration of legacy events across Grab's Tech Families.
- Design and deliver the governed clickstream data layer and event vocabulary that power funnel analytics and user-understanding use cases.
- Run the platform cost programme: event lineage, automated deprecation, retention policy, gateway right-sizing and legacy stream retirement, with clear chargeback to producing teams.
- Write RFCs, drive cross-team technical decisions to closure, and represent Scribe in architecture and operational-excellence reviews.
- Own operational excellence for a critical platform: on-call process, incident response, post-mortems, fire drills, SLA and data-loss monitoring.
- Lead an engineering team with diverse technical stacks and grow the next technical leads.

What Essential Skills You Will Need
- Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related undergraduate degree.
- Minimum of 7 years of experience in Software Engineering, including experience as a technical lead or architect for a platform used by many teams.
- Proficient in Go, or willing to learn it, with hands-on experience in Python or Scala.
- Experience developing large-scale backend and streaming systems, with a good understanding of the trade-offs needed for high-load, low-latency systems while maintaining reliability and cost efficiency.
- Experience defining and enforcing data contracts or schemas across many producer teams, including versioning, migration and deprecation.
- Experience owning cloud cost for a large data platform on AWS: attribution, retention, right-sizing and measured savings.

A Big Plus If You Have
- Experience with Apache Flink (real-time processing) and Apache Spark (batch processing), and table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake.
- Experience applying LLM agents to engineering workflows (code migration, MCP servers, evals and guardrails).
- Experience with mobile analytics instrumentation or clickstream analytics platforms.
- Proficiency in CI/CD tools, Terraform and Kubernetes.
jobs.notes: Grab 新加坡 Scribe（PB 级点击流智能平台）后端技术 Lead：Go/Kafka/Flink/Spark/Trino/Iceberg on AWS，负责架构/成本/可靠性并带高级工程师团队，7+ 年含平台 lead/架构师经验；lead 依据：Technical Lead 定位 + 带教团队。AI 相关且为亮点：Applied AI 是四大技术栈之一（LLM agents 做代码迁移与 spec 生成、MCP servers），且 LLM agents 工程经验列为加分项。现场办公（One-North）；已转发；无工作权限制表述。

- Testing: Continuously improve and maintain testing frameworks, development tools, and environments.
- Agile & CI/CD: Contribute to and champion Agile development practices and Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) processes.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Google Pay, Growth and Communications
jobs.description:
Google will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require Google's sponsorship of a visa.

Minimum qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
- 5 year of experience with software programming in C++, Java, Python or Go.
- 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.

Preferred qualifications:
- Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
- 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
- Mobile app, web, full-stack or backend development experience.
- Experience building systems that scale to millions of users globally.
- Experience working on DevAI for Agentic coding and productivity.

About The Job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Our mission at Google Pay is to make digital finance simple, safe, and universally accessible.

Operating at an unprecedented scale, our Singapore-based team is the engine behind the growth and communications (comms) platforms. Our Comms infrastructure powers the high-throughput messaging systems required to reliably engage hundreds of millions of users. Simultaneously, under Growth, we own high-volume user acquisition channels including our core referral and reward engines that drive massive-scale traffic and generate multi-million dollar business streams.

In this role, you will lead the technical execution of growth initiatives to scale our user base. You will have true ownership of the full feature lifecycle, building solutions that span entirely from robust backend systems to seamless frontend UI components, leveraging agentic workflows and DevAI tools to accelerate delivery and productivity.

Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

Responsibilities
- Take end-to-end ownership of feature design and deployment, operating seamlessly across the stack from backend infrastructure to frontend mobile and web ecosystems.
- Mentor junior engineers on reliable, scalable, and secure designs.
- Lead technical designs for robust backend services and data processing pipelines that support massive-scale growth experiments.
- Ensure long-term feature reliability by building comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and automated performance tracking.
- Contribute to engineering excellence by participating in design reviews, improving code quality, and leveraging DevAI and agentic coding workflows to accelerate end-to-end development.
jobs.notes: Google Pay 增长与通信团队全栈/后端岗，技术栈 C++/Java/Python/Go；senior 依据：5 年编程+1 年设计架构经验、标题含 Senior。明确涉及 AI：要求 DevAI / Agentic coding workflows 经验。风险提示：JD 明确优先有新加坡工作权、不需要签证赞助的候选人（right to work in Singapore, no sponsorship）。

About The Job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

As an Agent Engineer, you will be at the forefront of applying Google's cutting-edge Generative AI to solve real-world issues for our customers. The Cloud Applied AI (AAI) powers business growth with Gemini Enterprise. Our portfolio includes Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience (Shopping Agent, CX Agent Studio, Agent Assist, Vertex AI Search - Commerce, Customer Experience Insights), along with other vertical and domain packaged solutions. We enable high adoption and speed to value by building solutions that are quickly deployed, delivering new 0-to-1 capabilities with startup agility. Team members operate at the forefront of AI, collaborating directly with model builders with unprecedented speed. Join us to work on cutting-edge projects and shape the future of AI in a fast-paced, collaborative, and impactful environment.

Systematize your learnings from customer engagements by creating reusable tools, building documentation and accelerators, and establishing best practices that can be used across the organization.
Serve as a critical feedback loop to our core Product and Development teams. Synthesize insights from the field to influence product strategy, identify feature gaps.
Act as a subject matter expert, providing technical guidance and best practices to customers on agent improvement, performance tuning, CI/CD pipelines, and production readiness.

jobs.title: Software Engineering SMTS - Brain Team (REMOTE)
jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Engineering at Qualified

Engineering at Qualified is a high-ownership, high-velocity environment where engineers ship customer-facing product to real enterprises at scale. We're building at the frontier of AI + product: developing agentic software and embedding AI directly into our platform, using modern toolchains and processes that help engineers move faster while staying focused on high-impact problem solving.

Following our acquisition by Salesforce, we continue to operate with the pace and ownership of a startup, backed by the distribution, resources, and long-term runway of a global enterprise. Engineers have true end-to-end ownership from idea to production: scoping, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement based on real customer feedback.

You'll work alongside a high-talent-density team that cares deeply about craft, performance, reliability, and user experience, and that raises the bar through collaboration, code review, and strong engineering principles. You'll make architecture decisions, solve meaningful system design challenges, and see your work land quickly with customers, without layers of approvals slowing you down.

The Role

The Brain team owns the intelligence layer behind Piper, our flagship AI SDR product for qualifying leads and booking meetings. Our team is responsible for building, maintaining, and upgrading the agents that power Piper to support new capabilities and model releases. We own the system prompts, model configuration, context layer, evals, and harness that powers Piper behind the scenes.

What You'll Do

You will work closely with product teams to build the products and features that allow our customers to bring their customer GTM strategy, CRM data, and guardrails together to deliver an on-brand, personalized, muilti-modal AI SDR agent experience to their website and email.

You will work closely with the AI platform teams to build and maintain LLM evals that measure Piperʼs overall health, response quality, and ensure that those changes contribute to business outcomes like converting leads, booking meetings, and driving pipeline.

Who You Are

Minimum of 5 years of experience working in product engineering or related fields.

Customer-centric thinking: have a deep connection of our customers' needs and how that translates to the experiences that we build for them. Much of your work will be tuning the agent to cater towards that, so you must be comfortable working backwards from a customer's preference and finding ways to capture human judgment as success criteria for an agent.

Product engineering and ownership. Strong full-stack fundamentals and proficiency in frontend and backend development. Ability to work independently and engage with product and domain experts, spot gaps, and own the ideas through to production. Experience shipping real-time and text- based LLM products is nice to have. Weʼre language-agnostic; familiarity with Rails and React is a bonus.

Agent fundamentals. You understand the core building blocks of agents: traces, context and tokens, tools, system prompts, models, latency and reasoning tradeoffs, MCP, etc. You know how to troubleshoot a LLM response and identify the source of the issue in the trace. You have an opinion on the strengths and weaknesses of different frontier models. You know what agents are and are not good for. Hands-on work with an LLM observability system, building or contributing to an eval system is a plus.

Nice to Have

Agentic development. Comfortable building alongside agents and utilizing coding agents effectively in your daily development. You can recognize poor quality code and writing produced by agents and know how to steer them towards a high-quality outcome on large tasks. You know how to use them to automate easy/repetitive tasks and build your domain expertise.

Experience building software for marketing, sales, or go-to-market teams, particularly integrations with Salesforce and other CRM platforms. You understand how customer data, lead qualification, routing, and sales workflows fit together, and can translate that understanding into reliable product experiences.

Startup experience and rapid shipping.

Why Join Qualified

Foundational impact: Shape how our AI agents retrieve, reason, and answer, and the tooling every engineer here uses to build them.

Lead real initiatives: Own significant projects end to end, with scope and influence that grow as you deliver. You'll own the platform as it scales, from retrieval to model providers to agent orchestration, and set the performance and reliability bar that grows with the company.

AI as a core product surface: Turn new AI capabilities into dependable experiences that customers trust, with strong engineering around evaluation, observability, and iteration.

High bar, low bureaucracy: Work with a team that values craft and decisive execution, where strong ideas win and shipping is the default.

Room to grow: Take on larger technical and product scope over time: leading projects, influencing architecture, and leveling up quickly.

If you're excited to build retrieval systems and agent infrastructure at the intersection of AI and enterprise software, we'd love to hear from you.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence are at the heart of the Airbnb product. From Trust to Payments, and from Customer Service to Marketing we rely on ML to ensure that guests and hosts have the best possible experience with Airbnb.

The Core ML team in Assistance Engineering is the team responsible for adopting the Agentic AI technologies to enable an intelligent, scalable and exceptional customer service experience. We are responsible for developing the Chat AI assistant, Voice AI Assistant and more! The team is constantly exploring the SOTA Agentic architecture, develops and enhances various AI models, ML services and leverages tools including SFT, Reinforcement learning, Distillation, RAG/Search, LLM evaluation and testing automation, feedback-based learning and guardrail for a wide range of applications in Airbnb.

The Difference You Will Make

We believe our current customer experiences in these domains are only scratching the surface of the innovations that are possible, and that science is at the heart of delivering a step-function change for our Guest and and Host on Airbnb.

You will build and leverage cutting edge AI technologies to transform Airbnb’s customer service by delivering personalized, easy-to-use and proactive customer service experience.

Many of the initiatives you’ll tackle are in their early conceptual stages. You will have the opportunity to shape these ideas from inception to production, turning visionary concepts into impactful realities.

A Typical Day

Champion the development of novel ML systems, product integrations, and performance optimizations to solve real-world problems
Work cross-functionally with product, design, and other engineering counterparts to design and build efficient AI solutions for Airbnb CS products
Learn and share the latest AI/ML technologies with the team.

Your Expertise

PhD or Master's degree w/ 3+ YOE in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field — or equivalent industry experience
Hands-on expertise in LLM, including pretraining, fine-tuning (SFT, RLHF, GRPO), prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and LLM evaluation frameworks
Experience building Agentic AI systems — including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use, planning, memory, and autonomous reasoning pipelines (e.g., ReAct, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar)
Experience of shipping production-grade ML/AI systems at scale, with deep understanding of ML infrastructure, model serving, and MLOps best practices
Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across Engineering, Product, and Design organizations

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Tokens and Prompt Structures
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

The Encodings Infra team maintains the libraries that engineers and researchers across Anthropic use to encode text and multimodal data into a form that Claude can consume. It also determines Claude’s prompt shape: how a user’s turn is represented to the model, how Claude calls tools and receives tool results, and so on.

As a Software Engineer on this team, you'll own the design and maintenance of these libraries—keeping their APIs intuitive, their performance sharp, and their abstractions solid enough that most of the org never has to think about encodings or prompt structures at all. You’ll have the satisfaction of knowing that your work enabled Claude to learn new ways of understanding the world.

This role is unusually broad: your work will touch systems across the codebase, from pretraining to finetuning to the API, and you'll collaborate closely with both researchers and engineers to make sure new encoding ideas can move quickly from experiment to production.

Responsibilities

- Maintain and improve the encoding libraries used by engineers and researchers across Anthropic
- Run experiments to determine the optimal way to feed structured data into Claude without confusing it
- Design data structures and abstractions that shield most of the organization from the details of how encoded data works while enabling “power users”
- Adapt the encoding libraries to support new research directions as they emerge, and make sure that we can ship these research ideas to production
- Optimize encoding performance across the systems that depend on these libraries

You May Be a Good Fit If You

- Have 5+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful time spent maintaining libraries, SDKs, or developer-facing APIs
- Have familiarity with ML terminology and LLM architecture — you don't need to be an ML expert, but enough understanding to work effectively alongside researchers and understand the results of experiments
- Have experience carrying out complex refactors in large codebases
- Have strong communication skills and enjoy working closely with researchers and engineers to understand what they need
- Are results-oriented, with a bias towards flexibility and impact
- Pick up slack, even if it goes outside your job description
- Care about the societal impacts of your work

Strong Candidates May Also Have Experience With

- Tokenizers or other text/data encoding systems
- Maintaining a widely-used library over a long period of time
- Performance optimization
- Python and/or Rust
- Reinforcement learning or model training infrastructure

Representative Projects

- Working with a research team to ship a new multimodal data type (audio, video, etc) to production
- Redesigning a core abstraction so that we can change how data is encoded into Claude without breaking downstream teams

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary

$320,000—$405,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI
jobs.description:
About Clark

Every audit answers one question: can I trust this? For 150 years, people have answered it by hand. Clark is changing that.

We build AI that doesn’t just assist auditors. It does the audit work itself. More than 35 CPA firms already use Clark to run audit fieldwork faster and at equal or better quality. Audit is where we start. Our mission is to build the trust infrastructure layer for the AI economy, and we’re only getting started.

We’re a small, hard-working team backed by top investors. We take ownership and judge ourselves by results. If you want to change how an entire profession works, you’ll fit in here.

The Role

We are hiring Senior Engineers to grow the Ava team and build the AI systems that power Clark's core product.

You will design and ship production AI systems that automate complex audit and accounting workflows. This includes LLM-powered agents, retrieval systems, document intelligence, evaluations, validation, and the infrastructure required to make AI reliable in high-trust environments.

You will work closely with product engineers, Audit Engineers, customers, and company leadership to identify high-value workflows and build systems that can perform them accurately, securely, and at scale.

Why This Role Matters

Clark's ability to win and retain customers depends on the depth, reliability, and quality of Ava.

As customers ask Clark to automate more complex workflows, the Ava team must build AI systems that are both impressive in demos and reliable in production.

This role directly expands what the business can sell, deploy, and support.

What You'll Do

Build and improve LLM-powered workflows within Ava
Design agentic systems for audit and accounting workflows
Improve retrieval, reasoning, evaluation, and reliability of AI outputs
Partner with Audit Engineers to understand real customer workflows
Create evaluations, monitoring, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop review systems
Build production systems that can operate in trust-sensitive environments
Improve prompt, tool-use, orchestration, and evaluation systems
Improve the accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost of production AI workflows
Collaborate with platform engineers on reliability and observability
Debug AI failure modes and improve system performance over time
Ship product features that directly impact customer adoption
Debug failures in live customer workflows and improve system performance over time
Help establish Clark’s technical standards for building safe and dependable AI systems

Who You Are

5+ years of software engineering experience
Experience building production software systems
Strong backend or full-stack engineering fundamentals
Hands-on experience building applications with LLMs, agents, retrieval systems, or other modern AI models
Experience designing evaluations and improving AI-system performance using real production data
Comfortable working with probabilistic systems and designing around uncertainty and failure
Strong product judgment and an ability to identify the simplest system that delivers meaningful customer value
Comfortable working directly with domain experts and translating complex workflows into software
High ownership, strong communication, and excellent technical judgment
Excited to operate in person with a fast-moving, talent-dense team

Bonus

Experience building production LLM applications
Experience with agent frameworks, evals, retrieval systems, or tool-calling
Experience in fintech, compliance, accounting, audit, legaltech, or other trust-sensitive software
Experience with document-heavy workflows
Experience at a fast-moving startup

The Environment

5 days a week on-site in NYC — no remote or hybrid
Startup hours and pace — this isn't a 9-to-5
Flat structure, no hierarchy — everyone ships
High ownership — you own outcomes, not just tasks

Benefits

Unlimited PTO
Wellhub Platinum membership
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
Free company dinner every day

Compensation Range: $140K - $180K

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us:

Future is building a personalized guidance system for lifelong health. We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come.

About The Role

We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to help us build and ship AI-powered features that directly improve our product experience and business outcomes. This is a hands-on, product-focused role where you'll take ideas from concept to production — designing intelligent systems, validating them with real users, and turning them into reliable, scalable services.

You'll work at the intersection of AI, product, and engineering — partnering closely with cross-functional teams to identify high-impact opportunities, prototype quickly, and iterate based on data. This isn't a research-only role. You'll own the full lifecycle: experimentation, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate is excited about applying LLMs and modern ML tooling to real-world problems. You think in terms of systems, tradeoffs, and outcomes — not just models. You care about performance, quality, latency, and cost in production. Most importantly, you're motivated by shipping impactful AI experiences that customers actually use.

What You'll Do

- Build and ship AI agents that serve real users: tool-calling LLM systems with structured output, parallel API orchestration, and streaming responses.
- Design evaluation harnesses and quality scoring — we use Langfuse, rubrics to measure safety, effectiveness, and personalization.
- Own the full loop: prototype a new agent capability, validate it with evals, deploy it to staging and production, monitor traces, and iterate.

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Applied AI based in the United States.

We are seeking an experienced software engineer to transform how a fast-growing, profitable technology business operates through advanced AI and large language models (LLMs). In this role, you will design, build, and deploy intelligent agents that automate workflows across functions including sales, revenue operations, editorial, and people operations. You will own the entire development lifecycle, from identifying opportunities and defining specifications to building systems, creating evaluations, and rolling out solutions to internal teams. Rather than simply automating existing tasks, you will help establish a model in which workflows continuously improve as AI capabilities advance. Working closely with product leadership and business stakeholders, you will have substantial autonomy to shape technical and product decisions. This is an opportunity to make a company-wide impact in a lean, remote-first environment with minimal legacy constraints and a strong focus on experimentation, measurable outcomes, and rapid execution.

Accountabilities

- Build AI agents and platform capabilities: Design, develop, and deploy new agents, reusable skills, and foundational AI capabilities that improve workflows across multiple business functions.
- Own end-to-end delivery: Lead the complete implementation lifecycle, from identifying use cases and designing solutions to coding, evaluation, deployment, and adoption by internal users.
- Define quality standards: Write clear technical specifications, evaluation criteria, and test cases that establish measurable definitions of success for AI-powered workflows.
- Develop and maintain evaluations: Integrate evaluations into the development process, measure agent performance, identify weaknesses, and refine systems based on evidence and observed results.
- Identify automation opportunities: Collaborate directly with stakeholders in sales, revenue operations, editorial, and people operations to understand their processes and determine where LLMs can deliver meaningful improvements.
- Drive product and technical decisions: Partner with the Applied AI Product Manager to prioritize initiatives, while independently making smaller product decisions and determining the best implementation approach.
- Improve workflows continuously: Build systems that take advantage of improving model capabilities, enabling processes to become more effective over time without requiring repeated manual redesign.
- Promote AI-first operations: Help shift teams away from manual task execution toward defining specifications, establishing quality benchmarks, and supervising AI-driven workflows.
- Deliver measurable business impact: Focus on practical improvements in productivity, quality, and operational efficiency, ensuring AI implementations produce observable results rather than relying on anecdotal feedback.
- Operate with autonomy: Take ownership of projects from conception through production, identify what should and should not be built, and deliver solutions without waiting for every detail to be specified.

Requirements

- Software engineering experience: At least five years of professional experience in software engineering or a closely related technical role.
- Applied AI expertise: At least two years of experience building products or systems powered by large language models (LLMs).
- Production agent ownership: Demonstrated experience taking at least one AI agent into production and continuing to own and improve it.
- AI-assisted development: Strong coding proficiency with AI development tools such as Claude Code or Codex, using them effectively to accelerate implementation and improve engineering workflows.
- Evaluation-driven development: Experience designing and incorporating evaluations throughout the development lifecycle, with the ability to explain success criteria, measurement methods, and improvements made based on results.

- Stakeholder collaboration: Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with non-engineering teams to identify problems, understand operational workflows, and translate business needs into practical AI solutions.
- Adaptability and experimentation: Comfort working in a rapidly evolving technical landscape where established best practices may not yet exist, and a willingness to adapt approaches as model capabilities improve.
- Systems thinking: Ability to design scalable, reusable solutions that enable workflows to improve continuously rather than requiring repeated manual intervention.
- Ownership mindset: A proactive, resourceful approach to engineering, with a strong bias toward shipping useful solutions and taking responsibility for their ongoing performance.
- Interest in broad business impact: Motivation to work across multiple functions in a lean organization, with significant autonomy, direct access to senior leadership, and opportunities to influence how the business operates.

- Transparent compensation structure: Cash-based compensation through base salary and bonus, with annual pay reviews and opportunities for increases based on performance.
- Remote work flexibility: Fully remote work across the United States and Canada, with compensation bands based on Tier 1 city rates regardless of where you live.
- Flexible paid time off: Flexible PTO, with team members typically taking two to three weeks annually, in addition to holidays.

jobs.title: Software Engineer 5 – Agent Platform, AI Platform
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Machine Learning/Artificial Intelligence powers innovation in all areas of the business, from helping members choose through personalization, to making payment processing easier. Building highly scalable and differentiated ML infrastructure is key to accelerating this innovation.

The Opportunity

Agents are one of the ways work gets done at Netflix — and the AI Platform is building the foundation they run on. The Agent Platform team owns the durable, horizontal substrate every agent at Netflix is built on, no matter which team ships it or which business it serves: the runtime agents execute in, the SDK developers build them with, the memory that lets them carry context across runs, the identity and permissioning that lets them act safely, and the tool and service interfaces they reach the rest of Netflix through.

We are a small team with outsized leverage — what we ship becomes the foundation for agents across all of Netflix. The hardest problems we work on have no vendor answer and no textbook: how a non-deterministic system earns trust at member scale and how memory and evaluation become a loop that makes agents measurably better, not just bigger.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for an engineer who wants to build that foundation hands-on — to own a core primitive end-to-end and set its technical direction, in a domain that is still being invented and where the frameworks turn over in months. The defining work is judgment about what to build and what actually moves the business — expressed in code and contracts the rest of the company depends on.

You Will

Design, build, and operate a core agent primitive end-to-end — the runtime, the developer SDK, the memory layer, the tool and service interfaces, or the identity and permissioning substrate. You own it as a paved path other Netflix engineers ship production agents on, including the reliability and day-2 operations that non-deterministic systems running at very high — sometimes member-facing — scale demand.
Build the loop that lets agents improve from their own experience. Capture each run's full reasoning-and-tool-call trajectory as structured, replayable data; turn real-world outcomes into evaluation signal; make memory compound across runs; and close the feedback loop so improved behavior ships behind eval gates and safe rollout. These are the most durable problems in the space — make them first-class platform capabilities with real contracts, not afterthoughts.
Build the quality and safety surfaces teams can't ship agents without — the tracing, quality signals, and guardrail hooks that tell a team whether an agent is actually any good and contain non-deterministic behavior before it reaches production.
Aim the hard problems at business impact. A pull toward hard technical problems is the baseline here — the differentiator is aiming it at the ones that move Netflix's business, from personalization and content to payments and the member experience. Know where an agent actually changes a member or business outcome, and let that decide what the platform takes on and in what order.
Set technical direction and raise the bar. Make the hard architecture calls in your area, drive cross-team technical initiatives with ML scientists, product managers, and security, compute, and data partners, and define the clean interfaces a shared foundation depends on — leading through technical credibility, not authority.
Iterate fast with real users. Ship, learn from how agent developers actually build, and turn that into durable platform capabilities rather than one-off fixes.

If you want the distance between "a frontier idea about how agents should work" and "the substrate every agent at Netflix runs on" to be one team, this is the role.

Minimum Qualifications

Significant software engineering experience (typically 8+ years), with a track record of shipping and operating production systems — not just prototypes.
Hands-on experience building, deploying, and operating LLM agents in production — systems that plan, call tools, observe results, and iterate — beyond chat-completion apps or demos.
Experience evaluating agents the rigorous way: building eval suites, tracing, and quality signals, then iterating on the results to make agents measurably better.
Strong fundamentals in designing and operating scalable, observable, fault-tolerant distributed systems.
A track record of building SDKs, APIs, or libraries that other engineers build on — you think in contracts, versioning, and developer experience, not just features.
Working fluency with modern agent frameworks and the tool/function-calling and MCP patterns they share — deep enough to have an opinion about where they help and where they get in the way.
Proficiency in Python and its packaging tooling, plus one of Java, Go, C/C++, Rust, or Zig.
A track record of choosing what to build by business impact, not technical interest alone — you partner closely with the teams and stakeholders you serve, and can point to outcomes that moved the business, not just systems you shipped.
Strong written and verbal communication; comfort with ambiguity; able to drive both 0-to-1 and 1-to-100 work; effective across a distributed (US) team.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building memory or state systems for agents — context that compounds across runs — especially at high scale.
Experience with the emerging class of agent concerns: agent identity and permissioning, guardrails and safety, and cost governance for LLM and agent workloads.
Credibility in a relevant open-source ecosystem (agent frameworks, runtimes, evaluation, or developer tooling).
Familiarity with our stack — Temporal, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes — and with large-scale build, release, CI/CD, and observability practices.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $466,000.00 - $750,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off.

OpenAI's Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works. Enterprise deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

As an Enterprise Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations. This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI's products evolve.

This role is based in our SF or NYC office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Business Automation
jobs.description:
Location: San Francisco

On-site, five days a week
Department: Engineering
Employment type: Full time
Level: SWE II / Senior
Individual contributor
Compensation: $220,000–$260,000 annual base salary + equity

About Interface.ai

Our mission is to make intelligent, personalized financial services accessible to everyone. interface.ai builds AI agents for the banks and credit unions that serve everyday Americans, helping financial institutions deliver better service and making it easier for people to get the support they need.

More than 100 banks and credit unions use interface.ai, reaching over 10 million people. With $30M in Series A funding and a cash-flow-positive business, we're building toward an AI-powered contact center and a banking experience designed around intelligent agents. Our ambition is to help millions of people navigate their financial lives with greater confidence.

We're bringing that same ambition to how our company works: equipping every team with AI that helps people accomplish more, focus on meaningful work, and serve our customers better.

The Role

As our Applied AI Engineer, Business Automation, you'll build the systems that make every team at interface.ai more productive. Work across engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer success, finance, operations, and talent to understand how work gets done, identify the highest-impact opportunities, and turn recurring business processes into reliable AI-powered workflows.

You'll own our in-house business automation platform: the shared foundation that connects the best available AI tools, agents, company knowledge, and business systems to take work from request to completed outcome. Build on existing internal tools and develop reusable capabilities that each team can adapt to its own work. Evaluate what to build, buy, or integrate based on quality, reliability, cost, and employee experience.

This is a dedicated, hands-on engineering role with the company itself as your customer. You'll work directly with CEO Srinivas Njay, partner with CTO and Co-Founder Bruce Kim, and embed with teams to learn their domain-specific rules, exceptions, and decisions. Own the full journey from discovering a workflow to shipping it, helping employees adopt it, and improving it in production. Your goal is to make AI a dependable part of daily work in every department, with measurable gains in employee productivity.

What You'll Own

Workflow discovery and prioritization. Work alongside employees and team leaders to map recurring work, bottlenecks, handoffs, and exceptions. Establish baselines and prioritize a focused roadmap by time saved, quality improved, business impact, and implementation effort.
The business automation platform. Build and evolve shared integrations, knowledge access, agent orchestration, and employee-facing tools. Make successful automations reusable across teams while supporting each function's distinct processes and requirements.
Automation from start to finish. Connect intake, context gathering, execution, approvals, updates to business systems, and follow-through. Deliver workflows such as customer handoffs, account research, reporting, onboarding, and recruiting operations that reach a verifiable outcome.
Domain-specific judgment. Learn what a good result means in each department. Translate business rules, terminology, data dependencies, and edge cases into workflow logic and evaluations, with clear human review where judgment or authorization is needed.
The right tools for the job. Continuously evaluate frontier models, agent frameworks, automation platforms, and SaaS capabilities. Combine the best available tools with custom engineering, and evolve the stack as capabilities improve.
Production quality and ownership. Own architecture, APIs, data models, prompts, evaluations, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. Build in appropriate access controls, auditability, monitoring, retries, and recovery so employees can trust the systems they use.
Adoption and measurable results. Pilot with teams, train users, document workflows, and improve from feedback. Help colleagues use shared tools and templates to improve their own work. Track adoption, hours saved, cycle time, error rates, output quality, and operating cost; use those results to decide what to expand next.

What We're Looking For

3+ years of software engineering experience at SWE II / Senior level, with production systems you built and owned. You can explain your design decisions, tradeoffs, and results.
Strong applied AI/LLM engineering: experience with tool use, context and retrieval, prompt design, evaluations, and agentic workflows, plus judgment about where AI and conventional automation each add value.
Proficiency in TypeScript and/or Python, with the ability to build the integrations, services, and interfaces employees need to use your work.
Experience automating real workflows end-to-end across APIs, SaaS tools, and business systems, including exceptions, failures, and human handoffs.
The ability to learn unfamiliar business domains quickly, ask precise questions, and turn ambiguous needs into useful software. You work comfortably with both technical and nontechnical teams.
Product judgment and ownership: you prioritize valuable problems, ship focused solutions, and stay accountable for adoption, reliability, and measurable improvement.
Daily fluency with frontier AI tools in your own work, with concrete examples of how they improve your productivity.
Degree in Computer Science or a related field from a top-tier program; strong engineering fundamentals.
Self-directed and decisive: you identify problems before they're assigned, propose solutions before they're requested, and close loops without reminders.
Based in San Francisco and committed to working in the office five days a week with the founders and team.

Bonus Points

Built internal platforms or tools that employees across multiple functions adopted and relied on.
Delivered AI automation with measurable improvements in employee productivity, operating cost, or turnaround time.
Integrated systems such as CRM, customer support, finance, HR, recruiting, or internal knowledge platforms.
Experience building reusable agent capabilities, durable workflows, or evaluation systems for business processes.
Experience as an early engineer at a startup, taking products from initial discovery through sustained production use.

Compensation

The annual base salary range for this San Francisco role is $220,000–$260,000, plus equity and the benefits below. Base salary will reflect the role's level and the candidate's relevant experience, skills, and demonstrated ability to build and own production systems.

Benefits

100% paid health, dental & vision care
401(k) & financial wellness perks
Daily meals on us
Commuter benefit
Monthly wellness stipend
Claude Enterprise + frontier AI tools for every employee — build with the best
Brand-new 21st-floor SF office at 44 Montgomery — floor-to-ceiling views, worth showing up to
Discretionary PTO + paid parental leave
Mental health, wellness & family benefits
A mission-driven team shaping the future of banking

Why interface.ai

Build AI that expands what people can accomplish. In this role, your work will give colleagues more time for customers, better information for decisions, and dependable systems for getting work done. Every successful workflow helps the company move faster toward its mission of making intelligent financial services accessible to everyone.

You'll work directly with Srinivas Njay (CEO) and Bruce Kim (CTO / Co-Founder), with access to the teams using what you build and the tools to turn ideas into working systems. You'll have ownership of the platform, visibility into its impact, and the opportunity to shape how AI becomes part of daily work throughout the company.
